raw.title: AI Developer (Python/ Django)
raw.excerpt: About the RoleWe are seeking a skilled Python / Django Developer with strong full-stack development experience and a passion for AI-assisted software development.
raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Python / Django Developer with strong full-stack development experience and a passion for AI-assisted software development. You will build and maintain web applications, client automations, and SaaS products using Python, Django, and Claude Code.

This role goes beyond traditional software development. You will translate client requirements into clear specifications and step-by-step implementation plans, use AI coding tools to build features efficiently, and critically review, test, and refine the generated code to ensure quality and reliability.

You will work with an established application foundation and a library of reusable components, prioritising existing solutions over unnecessary redevelopment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fundamentals with sound engineering judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to identify and correct AI-generated code that does not meet requirements.

About the Client

You will be working with an Australian software consultancy that develops business automation solutions and SaaS products. The organisation helps businesses streamline document-heavy processes involving invoices, emails, spreadsheets, and other operational workflows.

The team follows a structured, AI-assisted development approach, using established application foundations, reusable software components, and systematic testing to deliver reliable solutions efficiently. This is an opportunity to contribute to practical software products while developing expertise in AI-assisted engineering practices.

Ideal Profile

Core Development Experience

  • At least 3 years of professional full-stack development experience, including a minimum of two years working with Python and Django.
  • Strong understanding of Django fundamentals, including ORM, models, migrations, views, forms, templates, and the Django admin interface.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL and writing accurate, efficient database queries.
  • Practical experience developing, maintaining, and debugging web applications.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Regular, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to review AI-generated code critically, identify errors, and make appropriate corrections.
  • Experience translating requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans before development.
  • A strong preference for reusable components and existing solutions rather than unnecessary custom development.
  • Willingness to use AI tools for code generation, testing, and documentation while maintaining responsibility for code quality.

Testing & Engineering Practices

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, with a strong commitment to test-driven quality practices.
  • Confidence using Git, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues systematically and ensure tests pass throughout development.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices, particularly permissions, multi-tenant data, and safe file uploads.

Communication & Work Management

  • Strong written English, with the ability to prepare clear specifications, development plans, handover notes, and client updates.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently from agreed plans.
  • A commitment to honest progress reporting, timely escalation of blockers, and clear documentation.
  • A proactive approach to identifying reusable improvements and preventing recurring defects.

Desirable Experience

  • Advanced familiarity with Claude Code, including skills, plans, and subagents.
  • Experience with SaaS Pegasus or similar Django starter kits.
  • Knowledge of Tailwind CSS, HTMX, and Alpine.js.
  • Experience with Celery, Redis, and background processing.
  • Familiarity with Stripe, Xero, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint integrations.
  • Experience with Docker, Render, or Azure Container Apps.
  • Experience building AI-powered applications using Claude or OpenAI APIs, including prompts, structured outputs, and document extraction.

Responsibilities

Application & Feature Development

  • Develop and maintain Python/Django applications, client automations, and SaaS product features based on agreed specifications and implementation plans.
  • Establish new projects using the organisation's existing application foundation and install appropriate reusable components.
  • Build user interfaces using established UI components, Django templates, Tailwind CSS, HTMX, and related technologies.
  • Reuse existing functionality wherever possible and develop new components only when necessary.

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use Claude Code as a core part of the development workflow to generate code, tests, and documentation.
  • Translate requirements into structured specifications and step-by-step development plans before implementation.
  • Guide AI-assisted development through manageable tasks, reviewing the output carefully at each stage.
  • Identify and correct inaccurate, incomplete, or unsuitable AI-generated code before it reaches production.
  • Apply sound technical judgement when evaluating implementation approaches and generated solutions.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write and execute automated tests using tools such as pytest and Playwright.
  • Run relevant tests after each development task and ensure the complete test suite passes before delivery.
  • Review higher-risk code involving financial transactions, permissions, data deletion, and security with particular care.
  • Participate in code reviews, identify defects, and minimise avoidable rework through thorough validation.

Integrations & Deployment

  • Integrate applications with external systems, including Xero, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, email platforms, and Stripe.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, and other components of the existing technology stack.
  • Deploy applications to Render and Azure Container Apps and troubleshoot issues affecting live systems.
  • Support the development and maintenance of reliable integrations and automated business workflows.

Reusable Components & Continuous Improvement

  • Investigate whether identified defects also affect existing application templates or reusable components.
  • Apply appropriate fixes to shared components to prevent recurring issues across projects.
  • Identify useful generic functionality and contribute it to the reusable component library.
  • Improve development templates, testing practices, and implementation processes over time.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain clear technical documentation, specifications, and implementation plans.
  • Provide accurate progress updates and promptly raise blockers or tasks that exceed their estimates.
  • Prepare written handover notes so work can be continued effectively by other team members.
  • Follow established development, security, and code-review practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

raw.description:
Wir sind eine schnell wachsende Marketing-Agentur aus Frankfurt und suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für den Bereich IT-Management, Digitalisierung, Automatisierung & Prozesse!

Was macht die Roman Mayer GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Marketing-Agentur, die Werbekampagnen für bekannte Coaches, Berater, Experten und Personenmarken konzipiert. Unser Fokus liegt dabei auf der Erstellung von Werbetexten für Websites, Print-Marketing, E-Mail-Marketing und Social Media.

Als Werkstudent/-in Wirtschaftsinformatik (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns dabei, Prozessabläufe zu systematisieren, Projekte umzusetzen und neue Prozesse in unserem Unternehmen zu implementieren. Du sammelst echte Praxiserfahrung neben dem Studium und arbeitest gemeinsam mit uns an der Zukunft unserer Agentur.

Aufgabengebiete:

  • Betreuung der genutzten (SaaS-)Anwendungen im Unternehmen

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation & Konzeption von digitalen Geschäftsprozessen

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software & IT-Lösungen

  • Standardlösungen via Schnittstellen verbinden

  • Automationen für alltägliche Aufgaben entwickeln & umsetzen

  • Anwenderschulung & -betreuung

  • Fehleranalyse & Störungsbeseitigung

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei der Roman Mayer GmbH haben möchtest, findest du diese auf .

Vergütung: 20 € pro Stunde bei bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche.

In den Semesterferien kannst du nach Absprache mehr Stunden übernehmen, in Prüfungsphasen bei Bedarf auch weniger.

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Sicheres Einkommen: Du verdienst deutlich mehr als in typischen Nebenjobs und sammelst dabei Erfahrung, die dich beruflich weiterbringt.

  • Übernahmeperspektive: Wir stellen ein, um langfristig zusammenzuarbeiten. Ziel ist es, dich nach deinem Abschluss fest zu übernehmen.

  • Praxiserfahrung: Statt Theorie arbeitest du an echten Projekten, die direkt Wirkung im Unternehmen zeigen.

  • Abschlussarbeit bei uns: Nach Absprache kannst du deine Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit über ein Projekt in unserem Unternehmen schreiben.

  • Tolles Team: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Spannendes Aufgabenfeld: Bei uns arbeitest du mit neuen Technologien und Tools und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir als Agentur effizienter und erfolgreicher werden.

  • 100 % Remote: Du wählst deinen Arbeitsort frei und arbeitest dort, wo du am konzentriertesten und produktivsten bist.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du teilst dir deine Stunden rund um Vorlesungen und Prüfungen selbst ein und arbeitest dann, wenn du am leistungsfähigsten bist.

Requirements

Stellenanforderungen:

  • Eingeschriebene/r Student/-in der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder BWL mit IT-Bezug

  • Abgeschlossenes Grundstudium (mindestens 4 Semester)

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin

  • Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit

  • Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch

  • Vorkenntnisse in den Themen Online-Marketing, Coaching, Beratung etc. sind von Vorteil, aber nicht notwendig.

Wenn die Stellenbeschreibung dein Interesse geweckt hat, klicke einfach auf den Bewerben-Button, fülle das Formular aus, und schicke deine Bewerbung ab. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

raw.description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Territory Sales Manager, Commercial Trucking - IL


LOCATION:

Candidates must currently reside near a major airport and be able to travel overnight within their geographic area.

  • Remote Position, must currently reside/live in: Chicago, IL
  • Territory - Region/States: IL
  • Overnight Travel: 30%

SUMMARY:

We are seeking a Territory Sales Manager, Commercial Trucking associate who will be responsible for growth of agency relationships to increase profit of GEICO and GEICO-affiliated products within an assigned area of responsibility. Under general direction, responsible for both growing revenue via the maintenance of 120 – 150 truck and commercial specialist accounts (territory). DEVELOPS, TESTS, and IMPLEMENTS best practices and processes to develop field and call sales resource proficiency.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prospects, interviews, and approves new appointments to expand GEICO’s agency distribution.
  • Manage agents within a designated area of responsibility using in person, virtual, phone, and email to build relationships, deliver trainings, and manage agency performance. Implements policies and procedures of the agency program.
  • Analyzes territory to understand and detail where to spend time and resources to detail and execute a strategic plan to achieve growth and profitability goals.
  • Understands and applies Commercial Insurance knowledge of Company’s commercial products, competitive placement, industry trends, sales tools, and agency technology to design and deliver an effective sales call using an effective sales model to assist the agency in solving problems and growing their revenue by increasing Company’s value within the agency.
  • Prepares and documents effective pre-call strategies and IDENTIFIES new areas to aid the agency in growing its Company written premium, properly documenting each sales call and agency strategy supporting the sales process therein.
  • Works with product management to identify new areas of opportunity. Compares and delivers competitive intelligence on ways to improve our industry position.
  • Documents the best process to prospect, qualify and onboard new commercial agencies to expand Company’s agency distribution footprint.
  • Documents the best processes to train principals, agents, and representatives to optimize their understanding and preference toward Company products and processes, providing feedback on competitive comparisons to product and the strategy team, as available.
  • Monitors agent performance to action plans, identifies and documents needed actions and takes them as needed to help our partners (employees and agents) grow their business with Company.
  • Creates and delivers annual, and semi-annual sales plans, regular updates and reporting to leadership to support strategic reporting.
  • Interacts with critical state and industry association groups to determine growth efforts in new, and existing states.
  • Develops the onboarding, training, and development (includes mentoring) plans of new Company sales and sales process teams.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to follow complex instructions, resolve conflicts or facilitate conflict resolution, and have strong organization/priority setting skills
  • Must be able to multi-task
  • Must be able to learn and apply large amounts of technical and procedural information
  • Prior experience with driving sales results
  • Prior experience working with different lines of insurance a plus (P&C, Commercial, Life/Health)
  • Must be able to, with or without accommodation, perform the essential functions which include, but are not limited to, seeing, hearing, typing, and speaking
  • Must be able to, with or without accommodation, perform the essential functions which include, but are not limited to, seeing, hearing, typing, and speaking
  • Must be able to speak in a clear, empathic, and professional manner via phone
  • Adheres to the GEICO Code of Conduct, company policies and operating principles
  • Compliance with GEICO’s driving standards and/or policy
  • Meets attendance standard at business location to perform necessary job functions and to facilitate interaction with subordinates and management
  • Valid driver’s license and auto insurance

PREFERRED:

  • 3 years of experience working with Independent Agents
  • Bachelor’s degree or 3 years sales or relevant insurance experience

Annual Salary

$104,550.00 - $161,950.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The GEICO Pledge:

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers:Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture:Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards:Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

The equal employment opportunity policy of the GEICO Companies provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

raw.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

Senior Cybersecurity Architect & Operations Specialist

We accept candidates from Brazil and Colombia.

Work model: 100% Remote
Working hours: Business hours, aligned with US-based stakeholders

The Senior Cybersecurity Architect & Operations Specialist will lead the evolution, optimization, and operational effectiveness of cybersecurity services for a US-based organization. This role combines security architecture, security operations leadership, incident response, threat intelligence, and third-party service management.

Working closely with executive stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams, this professional will serve as a senior technical leader, ensuring that security technologies, service providers, and operational processes work together effectively to protect the organization's environment, manage cyber risks, and meet applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

This position reports directly to the organization's Head of Security and works in close partnership with other cybersecurity leaders across the security program.

This position requires fluent English, as you will interact daily with US-based stakeholders and participate in technical discussions and executive-level meetings.

Your Main Activities

  • Cybersecurity Operations Leadership & Optimization: Lead the continuous improvement of the cybersecurity operations function, ensuring that security monitoring, detection, investigation, escalation, and response capabilities are effective, integrated, and aligned with business priorities. Identify operational gaps, improve processes, and drive initiatives that strengthen the organization's security posture.

  • Security Architecture & Technology Management: Evaluate and optimize the architecture, configuration, integration, and effectiveness of security technologies and services across the environment. Ensure that security capabilities are properly implemented, monitored, maintained, and continuously improved, maximizing their effectiveness and value.

  • Third-Party Service Management: Coordinate and oversee external cybersecurity service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, effective collaboration, service quality, and alignment with operational requirements. Consolidate activities across multiple providers, manage dependencies, monitor performance, and drive accountability for service delivery and continuous improvement.

  • Security Incident Management & Escalation: Act as the senior escalation point during business hours for significant security alerts, complex investigations, and cybersecurity incidents. Coordinate incident response activities, guide technical investigations, support containment and remediation decisions, and ensure appropriate communication, documentation, and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.

  • Security Monitoring & Detection Engineering: Oversee the effectiveness of security monitoring and detection capabilities, including SIEM, endpoint security, network security, identity, and cloud security. Drive improvements in log coverage, detection rules, alert prioritization, correlation, and response workflows to reduce false positives, improve visibility, and accelerate incident handling.

  • Threat Intelligence & Proactive Defense: Lead threat intelligence activities by evaluating emerging threats, relevant threat actors, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities that may affect the organization. Translate intelligence into actionable recommendations, detection improvements, preventive controls, and defensive strategies tailored to the organization's risk profile.

  • Security Projects & Continuous Improvement: Lead security-related projects, technology implementations, integrations, upgrades, and operational changes. Define priorities, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and ensure that initiatives deliver measurable improvements to security capabilities and operational maturity.

  • Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management: Present security posture, operational performance, significant incidents, emerging threats, risks, and improvement initiatives to senior stakeholders. Translate complex technical information into clear business implications, actionable recommendations, and prioritized decisions.

  • AI-Driven Security Operations: Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency, accelerate investigations, streamline reporting, reduce repetitive work, and enhance security analysis, while maintaining appropriate security, privacy, and governance controls.

You Need to Have Experience With

  • Significant experience in cybersecurity, with a strong background in security architecture, security operations, or a combination of both.

  • Proven experience leading cybersecurity initiatives, coordinating technical teams, and managing third-party security service providers.

  • Strong understanding of SOC operating models, including security monitoring, alert triage, investigation, incident escalation, and incident response processes.

  • Hands-on knowledge of security technologies and their integration, configuration, monitoring, and optimization, particularly SIEM, EDR, network security, and cloud security capabilities.

  • Experience managing complex security incidents, coordinating investigations, supporting containment and remediation, and communicating findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Experience with threat intelligence, threat detection, security monitoring improvements, and proactive defense strategies.

  • Ability to assess security architecture and operational processes, identify gaps, and translate findings into practical technical and organizational improvements.

  • Experience leading security projects, implementations, integrations, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to make informed decisions under pressure.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Fluent English, including the ability to lead meetings, discuss complex security topics, and deliver executive-level presentations.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands, and collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams.

  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel or other SIEM platforms, EDR solutions, endpoint protection, identity security, network security, VPN, DNS security, and related technologies.

You Will Stand Out If You Have Any of These

  • Experience in the healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience supporting US-based organizations and working directly with executive stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with healthcare-related regulatory and security frameworks, such as HIPAA and HITRUST, as well as NIST Cybersecurity Framework and ISO 27001.

  • Experience with AWS security services and cloud security architecture.

  • Understanding of cybersecurity risk management, operational controls, and applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.

  • Experience improving SOC efficiency through automation, orchestration, and security operations use cases.

  • Practical experience using AI tools or implementing AI-enabled solutions to improve cybersecurity operations, threat analysis, incident investigation, or reporting.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GIAC certifications, or equivalent credentials.

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

raw.excerpt: Looking for an opportunity to make an impact? Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals.
raw.description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with nearly $18B in sales and 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals. Our capabilities include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning services for electric power substations, transmission and distribution systems, protection and controls design, and electrification programs. Utilities nationwide rely on Leidos for trusted power industry expertise, demonstrated by our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and over 100 municipal and cooperative utilities, as well as a growing portfolio of private developer clients.


Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is hiring for a Senior Microgrid Automation Engineer to join our diverse and fast-paced organization. As a core team member, you will be interacting with other electric utility disciplines, playing a valuable part in leading and designing microgrid and renewable energy projects.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Utilize familiarity with microgrid control systems and automation technologies, such as supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, energy management systems (EMS), Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), Human Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Remote Terminal Units (RTUs).
  • Apply understanding of microgrid concepts, including islanding operation, grid-connected operation, energy management, control strategies, and power flow management within a microgrid system.
  • Participate in Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Test (SAT).
  • Perform Hardware in the Loop (HIL) testing.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of various renewable energy technologies such as solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, wind turbines, batteries, and other distributed energy resources (DERs).
  • Use experience with power electronics and their application in renewable energy systems and microgrids, including inverters, converters, and other power electronic devices to interface and control DERs.
  • Perform planning and engineering in support of telecommunication systems and telecommunication projects.
  • Establish project schedules and budgets.
  • Develop drawings and specifications for utility telecommunication system projects.
  • Coordinate with other internal engineering departments, external contractors, and utility construction crews.
  • Travel to project sites to collect information on existing conditions.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in CAD software for electrical system design, simulation tools for modeling and analysis, and programming languages commonly used in microgrid control systems.
  • Apply knowledge of commonly utilized communication protocols (DNP, SEL, MMS, Modbus, etc.).
  • Utilize experience with Protection & Control design concepts, including one-lines, three-lines, schematics, wiring, etc.
  • Use experience with commonly utilized system modeling software programs (ASPEN, CAPE, CYME, ETAP, SKM, etc.).
  • Employ experience with DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61131 Programming, AcSELerator RTAC, SEL 5030 Quickset, GE Cimplicity, and Protocol Test Software preferred.


What does Leidos need from me?

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with four to eight plus years of related microgrid experience.
  • Strong knowledge of microgrids and renewable energy.
  • Power system Protection and Control (P&C) experience.
  • Ability to quickly learn and effectively use a variety of client software applications and databases.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Outlook.
  • Ability to occasionally perform field work in rough terrain to access remote project locations.


Favorable if you have:

  • Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) certification.
  • Master’s degree in a related field.


In this role, you can expect to grow:

  • Technical and non-technical training.
  • Interface with utility clients.
  • Leadership Opportunities.
  • Mentorship and training Opportunities.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

October 29, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range:

Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

Role Title: Semiconductor Engineering Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay:$80- $185/hour

Commitment: Flexible — fits alongside your current role

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials, physics, or a closely related field, plus principal-level industry experience or a faculty appointment

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct

You'll be working on

The problems where the textbook answer isn’t enough, where the right approach depends on reading the constraints correctly, where a plausible-looking solution is quietly wrong. You’ll build those problems, provide the correct analysis, and define what separates a right answer from one that only looks righ

What you’ll do

  1. Design difficult technical problems from your own area — device physics, process integration, circuit design, lithography, packaging, yield and reliability — with realistic constraints and supporting data.
  2. Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.
  3. Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.
  4. Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.
  5. Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

  1. Master’s or PhD in electrical engineering, materials science, applied physics, or a closely related field.
  2. Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major semiconductor company, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.
  3. Deep technical depth in at least one semiconductor subdomain, with hands-on ownership of the work.
  4. Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another engineer could verify it.
  5. Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.
  6. AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

raw.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a Principal SOC Performance Analysis Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will own performance analysis for a satellite communication System on Chip (SOC) supporting the TeraWave program. This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope and no direct reports. You will set the performance analysis methodology from pre-silicon modeling through emulation based verification and post-silicon validation, and your results will directly shape architectural decisions across hardware, firmware, and software teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop pre-silicon performance models for satellite communication PHY IP and Arm core subsystem workloads
  • Analyze multi-channel LPDDR6 bandwidth, latency, and arbitration across concurrent SOC traffic flows
  • Define and verify performance requirements for L2 acceleration data paths
  • Characterize Ethernet throughput and packet processing rates under representative load
  • Execute performance verification and functional testing on emulation platforms before silicon tape out
  • Validate post-silicon performance against pre-silicon projections and document correlation results
  • Partition performance budgets across L1 PHY, L2 software and firmware domains
  • Collaborate with architecture, design, and software teams to resolve identified performance bottlenecks

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in SOC architecture, performance analysis, or verification
  • Experience with SOC performance modeling for multi-core processor based designs
  • Experience with memory subsystem bandwidth and latency analysis for DDR or LPDDR
  • Experience using hardware emulation platforms for pre-silicon performance or functional testing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
  • Experience with satellite communication or wireless physical layer signal processing and L1 functions
  • Experience with Arm multi-core subsystems supporting Linux SDK or board support package environments
  • Experience with LPDDR6 or next generation memory interface bring up and performance tuning
  • Experience analyzing high speed Ethernet performance and packet processing throughput
  • Proficiency with C, C++, SystemC, or Python for performance modeling and test automation
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for presenting analysis results to technical stakeholders

Base Pay Range for:

CA applicants is $269,175.00 - $376,843.95WA applicants is $269,175.00 - $376,843.95

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.


Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

raw.description:
Braincube est spécialisée dans l'optimisation des processus en temps réel qui aide les fabricants à améliorer leurs performances opérationnelles grâce à l'intelligence artificielle, à des capacités avancées en matière de données et à une expertise industrielle approfondie. Notre plateforme permet aux industriels d'augmenter leur rendement, d'améliorer la qualité, d'optimiser leur consommation d'énergie et d'accroître leur débit, à grande échelle et en temps réel, dans le cadre d'opérations complexes impliquant plusieurs sites.

Pour faire évoluer ces solutions, nous recherchons un·e Senior Back-End Software Engineer autonome, capable de prendre le lead sur un sujet et de le mener jusqu’à son aboutissement.

Le poste

Votre rôle : prendre un sujet et le mener à son terme

Vous travaillez au sein d’une équipe de développement et intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle, du besoin initial au suivi des résultats. Avec vos collègues et le produit, vous clarifiez les objectifs, challengez les options et construisez une solution adaptée. La collaboration au quotidien est essentielle : partager l’avancement, s’entraider, accueillir les retours et prendre les décisions ensemble pour réussir collectivement.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené·e à :

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout : cadrage, conception, développement, tests, déploiement et suivi en production.

  • Prendre le lead technique : proposer une direction, expliquer les compromis, coordonner les contributions et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Développer des services backend en Java et concevoir des modèles de données et des requêtes SQL performants.

  • Faire fonctionner vos applications dans un environnement Kubernetes et contribuer à leur observabilité, leur fiabilité et leur diagnostic.

  • Anticiper les difficultés, rendre les risques visibles et chercher de l’aide au bon moment.

  • Faire progresser le collectif par les revues de code, le partage de connaissances et l’amélioration des pratiques.

Pour nous, l’ownership signifie rester impliqué·e jusqu’à ce que la solution soit utilisable, observable et réponde au besoin. L’autonomie s’appuie sur la collaboration et une communication claire.

L’IA fait partie de notre façon de développer

Nous construisons un environnement de développement dans lequel les assistants et les agents IA prennent une place croissante. Nous attendons de vous une pratique active de ces outils et la capacité à en tirer un bénéfice concret.

Cela signifie savoir :

  • Utiliser l’IA pour explorer un code existant, préparer une implémentation, développer, tester, refactorer ou documenter.

  • Structurer le contexte et découper un sujet pour déléguer efficacement certaines étapes à des agents.

  • Vérifier les résultats : comprendre le code proposé, tester les comportements et évaluer les conséquences sur la sécurité, les performances et la maintenance.

  • Identifier les usages qui améliorent réellement le travail et partager ces pratiques avec l’équipe.

Votre jugement d’ingénieur reste central : vous êtes responsable de ce que vous livrez, y compris lorsque l’IA contribue à sa réalisation.

Les technologies clés du poste : Java, SQL, Kubernetes, IA Tooling.

Votre expérience sera réussie chez nous si…

  • Vous savez prendre en charge un sujet, clarifier le résultat attendu et l’amener jusqu’en production, en coordonnant les contributions nécessaires.

  • vous comprenez les usages des clients et savez proposer des solutions techniques adaptées, en expliquant les compromis ;

  • vous livrez des évolutions testées et maintenables, et mettez en place les métriques et alertes nécessaires pour suivre leur fonctionnement et leurs performances ;

  • vous portez la qualité et l’adoption de vos développements, partagez vos connaissances et faites progresser les pratiques de l’équipe, notamment avec l’IA.

Vous serez accompagné·e dans votre réussite grâce à :

  • Un collectif de travail inspirant

  • Une intégration technique complète pour comprendre notre environnement de prod et y trouver rapidement votre place

  • Une communication transparente : nous apportons le contexte et le sens nécessaire pour aborder les projets sereinement

  • Une culture managériale du BEEER (Bienveillance, Exigence, Écoute, Empathie & Respect)

Lieu

Vous êtes rattaché·e au siège social, campus R&D de la société, situé à Issoire (63 - Puy-de-Dôme)

Télétravail : ce poste est ouvert en full remote.

A quoi ressemble le·a Senior Software Engineer idéal·e ? 🤩

Si vous :

  • Cherchez à comprendre les enjeux des clients et de l’entreprise pour concentrer vos efforts sur ce qui compte vraiment ;

  • apportez du recul : posez les bonnes questions, challengez les évidences et proposez des solutions pragmatiques ;

  • êtes une personne sur qui l’on peut compter : vous prenez des initiatives, assumez vos engagements et alertez quand c’est nécessaire ;

  • savez construire avec les autres : écouter, confronter les idées avec respect et avancer vers une décision commune ;

  • faites grandir l’équipe en partageant votre expérience, en accompagnant vos collègues et en leur permettant de gagner en autonomie ;

  • restez curieux·se et ouvert·e au changement : vous expérimentez, apprenez de vos erreurs et faites évoluer vos façons de travailler.

… alors ce poste est fait pour vous, rejoignez-nous en proposant votre candidature !

Notre process de recrutement

Étape 1 ✅ : Un premier contact téléphonique d’une quinzaine de minutes avec l’équipe RH 📞

Étape 2 ✅ : Deux entretiens avec nos équipes

  • Entretien avec les RH

  • Entretien avec Simon, VP Engineering

  • Entretien avec des membres de l’équipe Engineering : échange sur vos réalisations, vos choix techniques, votre ownership et vos usages de l’IA

Étape 3 ✅ : Un temps d’échange avec Amaury, CTO

Le bien-être des Braincubers passe avant tout. Si vous nous rejoignez, nous vous proposons :

  • Un poste de travail récent et performant (Macbook Pro ou Dell selon les besoins des projets) 💻

  • Un incroyable cadre de travail dans un château 🏰

  • De nombreux événements internes avec les collègues (garden party🎸, pots et moments de convivialité)

  • Un contexte de travail international

  • De la flexibilité dans les horaires et un poste ouvert en full remote

  • Une mutuelle prise en charge à 100% en isolé

  • Un CSE d’entreprise avec de nombreux avantages et réductions 😉

  • Des cours de yoga et des cours de X-Fit 🧘

  • Des actions en faveur des parents (prime de naissance, accompagnement du retour de maternité…) 👶

  • La possibilité de réaliser un projet de vie personnel tout en conservant votre poste 🤩

  • Du café et du thé mis à disposition dans les locaux ☕

  • Un processus d’intégration complet

  • … et de “beaux” goodies ! 😉

Processus d’intégration

Nous sommes soucieux de l’intégration de nos collaborateurs et nous ferons tout pour que vous vous sentiez bien avec nous dès le début. 🤗

Des personnes en interne sont dédiées à la formation. 🎓

raw.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, you will join a growing multifamily real estate firm supporting a nationwide portfolio of residential properties. You will take hands-on technical ownership of the client’s Drupal CMS ecosystem hosted on Acquia, translating project briefs, visual assets, and content into robust, fully functioning property websites. Because the client’s web infrastructure requires customized configurations rather than simple drag-and-drop templates, you will balance custom backend coding with disciplined content management to deliver reliable digital experiences.

This is a high-ownership, execution-driven role for a disciplined technical specialist. You will become a core pillar of a nimble, high-focus web team, driving new website implementations from scratch, managing ticket queues against strict SLAs, replicating established configurations across expanding property portfolios, and ensuring rigorous quality assurance before handoff. If you excel at autonomous troubleshooting, structured file management, and leveraging modern AI workflows to accelerate backend development, this role will offer direct ownership and substantial impact.

Accountability

As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to accurately build, maintain,and expand property websites within a customized Drupal and Acquia environment while independently managing ticket queues against SLAs and maintaining flawless QA readiness.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Drupal Implementation & Custom Backend Development

  • Build, configure, and maintain residential property websites within the client's Acquia-hosted Drupal architecture.
  • Implement and adapt website templates and structured CMS components using supplied briefs and creative assets.
  • Perform custom backend coding and manual configuration when native CMS functionality or standard modules are insufficient.
  • Troubleshoot technical limitations, backend blockers, and implementation bugs, ensuring strict compatibility with existing environments.
    Follow established Acquia Cloud deployment, staging, and hosting workflows while maintaining clean technical documentation.

New Website Builds, Replication & Portfolio Expansion

  • Execute end-to-end new property website implementations based on briefs provided by project management.
  • Replicate established web architectures across expanding portfolio properties, efficiently reusing templates while customizing property-specific data and content.
  • Configure components, verify asset mappings, and ensure visual and functional consistency across all portfolio sites.
  • Prepare and stage newly built and replicated sites for formal testing, ensuring all features execute seamlessly prior to launch.

Website Ticket Queue & SLA Management

  • Serve as the primary owner of the incoming website support and maintenance ticket queue.
  • Triage, prioritize, and resolve change requests, content updates, and technical adjustments in accordance with established SLAs.
  • Maintain real-time, accurate ticket statuses, track resolution deadlines, and proactively flag potential service-level delays.
  • Balance daily maintenance tickets and recurring support requests alongside active, high-priority website builds.

Quality Assurance, Testing & Asset Governance

  • Conduct thorough functional and visual testing on all website builds and updates prior to QA handoff.
  • Validate content placement, responsiveness, cross-browser performance, and template consistency to eliminate avoidable rework.
  • Address QA feedback systematically, resolving defects and verifying that all technical requirements are fulfilled.
  • Maintain rigorous file and asset organization across repositories, following strict naming conventions and directory standards to ensure zero asset misplacement.

AI-Enabled Engineering & Continuous Process Improvement

  • Incorporate AI tools (such as Claude) into daily technical workflows to investigate code, troubleshoot bugs, and accelerate repetitive implementation tasks.
  • Rigorously review, test, and validate all AI-assisted code suggestions to ensure technical integrity, security, and performance.
  • Identify recurring implementation bottlenecks and propose structured improvements to standardize builds.
  • Develop and update technical setup checklists, SOPs, and repeatable documentation to improve team efficiency as the web platform evolves.

Colleagues

You will work directly with the Website Project Manager as your primary day-to-day operational lead, while collaborating with existing website developers and cross-functional technical stakeholders during standups, testing cycles, and deployments.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Senior Website Implementation Specialist, your vertical strength will be hands-on Drupal backend development and CMS implementation, while your horizontal capabilities should span ticket queue prioritization, QA discipline, AI-assisted development, and structured technical communication.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional web development and CMS implementation experience, with dedicated,hands-on expertise building and maintaining customized Drupal websites.
  • Tools & Systems: Extensive proficiency with Drupal backend architecture, modules, and configurations; hands-on experience operating within the Acquia Cloud ecosystem; familiarity with project management platforms (Notion or similar) and ticketing systems (Jira or similar).
  • Analytics & Process: Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume ticketing queues, monitor SLA commitments,and execute rigorous QA testing protocols. Strong track record of following disciplined documentation, checklist-driven workflows, and standardized file structures.
  • Mindset & Approach: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined execution style; comfortable operating with low to moderate extraversion in an autonomous, heads-down technical role. Proactive in asking clarifying questions before building rather than relying on unverified assumptions.
  • AI Fluency: Practical comfort integrating AI tools (e.g., Claude) to streamline code investigation, debugging, and task automation, paired with the engineering judgment to validate and test all outputs manually.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Drupal Architecture & Custom Backend Coding: How do you navigate, customize, and write backend logic within an established, non-productized Drupal CMS environment?
  • Acquia & Environment Troubleshooting: How do you diagnose and resolve hosting, deployment, or environment-specific issues across connected web infrastructure?
  • Ticket Ownership & SLA Prioritization: How do you balance active, multi-week website builds with incoming,time-sensitive maintenance tickets without missing delivery targets?
  • Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail: What systematic steps and checklists do you employ to ensure builds and asset placements are completely defect-free before QA handoff?
  • AI-Assisted Workflow & Verification: How do you safely leverage tools like Claude to accelerate technical problem-solving while validating accuracy and maintainability?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

eBay P&A Growth Advisor

Job Locations US-Remote

FLSA Status Non-Exempt

Type Regular Full-Time

Mission:

The eBay Growth Advisor is responsible for driving growth, retention, and account health for Hollander’s eBay Program sellers. As a subject matter expert on eBay Parts & Accessories and Hollander’s eLINK listing platform, the role works directly with sellers to optimize marketplace performance, address operational barriers, and ensure accounts meet platform standards. The eBay Specialist collaborates with clients and cross functional teams including Sales, Product, Technical Support, Marketing, and the eBay Motors team to drive measurable transactional revenue growth and long-term seller success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of eBay sellers, focused on GMV growth, retention, listing quality, and overall marketplace performance.

Location: UK, remote, with regular overlap with US East Coast hours. Travel to customer sites in the US and Europe, to international conferences, and occasionally to London and Manchester.

About the Role

You'll own a portfolio of mostly US accounts using Biorelate's Galactic AI platform, from large pharma companies to smaller biotech teams. Your job is to make sure their researchers get measurable scientific value from Galactic Data, Web, API, MCP and Co-Scientist, and to build the evidence for renewal and expansion.
This is a hands-on role between science and technology. You'll run workshops and QBRs, and you'll also set up API access, build and test prompts and workflows, and own support for your accounts.

What We Do

Research and Development in the pharmaceutical industry is time-consuming, expensive, and often overlooks valuable data insights. We’re changing that with AI-powered data science solutions that uncover hidden insights to support more efficient and informed drug discovery. Using AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP), our technology extracts and structures data from millions of scientific documents, identifying causal biological relationships and organising them into knowledge graphs. This advanced data science empowers bioinformaticians and biologists with a deeper understanding of the connections between diseases, proteins, and drugs.

Our team consists of biomedical and data science experts with real-world lab and pharmaceutical experience. These specialists ensure that our solutions are scientifically grounded, delivering accurate, reliable data to our customers.

The Company
Biorelate is a venture backed Series A startup (supported by established Tech investors). If you’re eager to collaborate with exceptional scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts from various fields in a supportive, ego-free environment, Biorelate is the place for you.

Key Responsibilities

What You'll Do

Adoption and Value

  • Own each account from kickoff and onboarding through to measurable scientific outcomes, with an adoption plan for each team and use case.
  • Run use case workshops that turn research problems (target identification, safety assessment, competitive intelligence, literature synthesis) into prioritised use cases.
  • Grow active and chargeable users by developing champions, reaching new teams, and getting researchers to their first real result quickly.

Renewals and Account Health

  • Own renewals and gross revenue retention (GRR), starting renewal planning at least 120 days before each renewal date.
  • Run QBRs and regular check-ins, and keep account plans and health scores current using usage data.
  • Spot declining usage early and lead the recovery plan when an account is at risk.

Technical Enablement and Support

  • Set up and troubleshoot API, MCP and Web deployments, and build prompts and example workflows around customers' own research questions.
  • Check the quality of outputs, and escalate issues to Engineering with clear reproduction details.
  • Answer security and governance questions, and route non-standard work to Forward Deployed Engineering.

Working Across Biorelate

  • Partner with the Account Manager, who owns contracting and expansion deals, by supplying adoption data, ROI evidence and expansion signals.
  • Feed customer feedback to Product, and help roll out betas, launches and training materials.
  • Support technical pre-sales conversations and represent Biorelate at conferences.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What You'll Bring

  • A PhD in biological or life sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience in a client-facing, post-sale role with pharma, biotech or life sciences customers, ideally in SaaS or data.
  • Familiarity with at least one of: target identification and validation, pharmacovigilance and drug safety, competitive intelligence, or literature synthesis.
  • Comfort working hands-on with APIs, LLM tools and prompt design, and the judgement to tell whether an AI-generated scientific answer holds up.
  • Confidence running workshops and training sessions with scientists and department leads.
  • A track record of moving usage numbers through structured plans, not only managing relationships.

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning renewals or GRR targets with enterprise customers.
  • Experience running QBRs with senior stakeholders.
  • Scripting experience, for example in Python.

How You'll Work

  • You own the plan for your accounts and drive it. Tasks aren't handed down.
  • You're curious about drug discovery, and happy to switch between customer meetings and focused technical work in the same day.
  • You're comfortable in a growth-stage company where processes are still being built, and keen to help build them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to join Biorelate at an inflection point in our growth – and to genuinely shape how the company is seen and heard in the market. You'll work in a supportive team but you will have real autonomy to make this new role your own.
We offer competitive salaries, enhanced family leave, sick leave and significant opportunities for professional development. You’ll work alongside some of the brightest individuals, contributing to meaningful work that has a direct impact on global healthcare.
In addition, you can expect:
  • Genuine Flexibility: We are a fully remote business with colleagues across the globe: manage your schedule, save time and money on commuting, and do your best work from the comfort of your home.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: You’ll work with the latest software tools and technologies; we’ll push you to genuinely be innovative and find new ways to solve the newest challenges.

About Veriff

Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works.

The role

Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound.

As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits.

This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development.

By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners.

By nine to twelve months, a shared-signal pilot is running with a set of platforms, as the first step toward a cross-platform fraud network.

By twelve months, the improved fraud products are generally available and are measurably helping us attract and close deals with our core customer segments.

What you'll bring
  • Fraud and risk expertise. You have shipped fraud or risk products, or you have been responsible for fighting fraud and managing risk at a scaled, digital-native company. You understand attack patterns, how fraud teams actually work day to day, and how the precision/recall trade-off plays out in the real world.
  • Network product experience. You have worked on network-effect or marketplace data products, where aligning incentives between participants and building feedback loops are central to the product.
  • Data and ML product craft. You can specify a signal, read a model evaluation, and ship and manage a rules engine. You know what to build yourself and what to leave to data science.
  • Customer discovery with fraud teams. You can get fraud and trust leaders at platforms talking openly, and you turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.

Nice to have

  • Experience building with operations teams. Our fraud operations experts are the source of truth on what fraud looks like in practice, and the right person turns their judgment into product. If you haven't worked closely with an operations team before, you'll need to show strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Commercial packaging. You have shaped how a product is priced and sold, and worked deals alongside Sales.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary
We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

raw.title: Lead Concept Artist (Stylized Games | Art Direction) Europe
raw.excerpt: Lead Concept Artist (Stylized Games | Art Direction)Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Lead Concept Artist with exceptional artistic taste, strong creative leadership skills, and a passion for establishing compelling visual identities for game worlds and characters.
raw.description:
Lead Concept Artist (Stylized Games | Art Direction)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead Concept Artist with exceptional artistic taste, strong creative leadership skills, and a passion for establishing compelling visual identities for game worlds and characters.

We believe great concept art is more than producing beautiful images. It is about solving design challenges, communicating ideas clearly, and defining a visual direction that inspires the entire production team.

As part of our creative team, you will work closely with Art Directors and artists to shape artistic direction, establish visual benchmarks, and ensure that concepts translate effectively into production.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines outstanding concept art skills with the ability to guide artists, make confident artistic decisions, and elevate the overall quality of the team's work.

Key Responsibilities

Concept Art & Visual Direction

  • Lead concept art development across characters, environments, props, and other game content.

  • Translate creative briefs, narrative ideas, and gameplay requirements into compelling visual concepts.

  • Establish clear visual language, shape design, composition, color palettes, and artistic consistency.

  • Create key art explorations, sketches, paintovers, and production-ready concept designs.

  • Develop visual references and artistic benchmarks to guide 2D and 3D production.

Hands-On Artistic Leadership

  • Actively contribute to concept production while supporting and mentoring other artists.

  • Provide high-quality paintovers, design explorations, and actionable artistic feedback.

  • Review concept work and identify opportunities to improve appeal, readability, originality, and design quality.

  • Guide artists through visual exploration, iteration, and production challenges.

  • Help establish art guidelines, workflows, and quality standards across the concept team.

Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, Game Designers, Character Artists, Environment Artists, and Technical Artists.

  • Ensure concept designs consider production feasibility, gameplay readability, and technical requirements.

  • Maintain consistency between early visual exploration and final in-game presentation.

  • Communicate artistic decisions clearly and proactively across distributed teams.

  • Take ownership of concept quality and contribute solutions to creative challenges.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience in concept art for game development.

  • Proven experience as a Lead Concept Artist, Senior Concept Artist with leadership responsibilities, or equivalent.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating outstanding artistic fundamentals, design thinking, and visual storytelling.

  • Strong understanding of composition, color, lighting, perspective, anatomy, and shape language.

  • Ability to establish and maintain a cohesive artistic style across different content types.

  • Excellent hands-on painting, sketching, and visual exploration skills.

  • Experience mentoring artists and providing clear, actionable feedback.

  • Ability to translate abstract ideas into production-ready designs.

  • Strong communication skills and experience working with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Strong background in stylized game art and visual development.

  • Experience creating characters with distinctive personalities and emotional appeal.

  • Experience with simplified, pixel-inspired, or highly stylized aesthetics.

  • Understanding of Unity3D or Unreal Engine production pipelines.

  • Experience with Blender or other 3D tools for concept exploration.

  • Experience supporting Art Directors on large, multidisciplinary productions.

  • Previous experience in cross-studio co-development.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful influence over the artistic direction and visual identity of game projects.

  • Opportunity to lead and develop a talented concept art team.

  • A hands-on creative role with high artistic ownership.

  • Collaboration with experienced artists and international creative leadership.

  • Remote-friendly working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Shape the Next Visual Direction?

Send us your portfolio and a short introduction. We would love to see work that demonstrates exceptional concept art quality, design leadership, and your ability to turn creative ideas into memorable visual experiences.
