Job title - Principal Engineer, Water/Wastewater
Location - Remote
Requisition ID - 11420

Stanley Consultants is seeking a Principal Water/Wastewater Engineer to support the continued growth and delivery of municipal and industrial water and wastewater projects throughout the United States.

This remote position will provide technical and project leadership throughout the complete infrastructure lifecycle, including capital planning, engineering design, design-build delivery, construction administration, startup, commissioning, operations, maintenance, and asset optimization. The successful candidate will have experience with municipal and industrial water and wastewater systems, capital improvement programs, treatment-process evaluation, operational performance, regulatory compliance, and owner-side representation.

Although the position is remote, the Principal Water/Wastewater Engineer will be expected to maintain regular communication with clients and project teams, travel to client and project locations, and collaborate effectively across multiple Stanley Consultants offices and disciplines.

What You Will Be Doing:

    Project and Technical Leadership

  • Lead the planning, analysis, design, construction, startup, operation, rehabilitation, and optimization of municipal, federal, and industrial water and wastewater systems.
  • Serve as Project Manager, Technical Lead, Engineer of Record, or Principal-in-Charge, as appropriate for individual assignments.
  • Develop facility master plans, capital improvement recommendations, lifecycle evaluations, budgets, schedules, and implementation strategies.
  • Lead design-build, design-build-operate-maintain, retrofit, rehabilitation, and conventional design-bid-build projects.
  • Perform or direct process analysis, treatment optimization, technology evaluation, chemical trials, equipment selection, and value engineering.
  • Lead projects involving:
    • Municipal, commercial, and industrial water and wastewater systems
    • Wastewater collection, pumping, treatment, and biosolids management
    • Treatment-plant rehabilitation, retrofit, and operational optimization
    • Industrial wastewater characterization, pretreatment, treatment, reuse, and discharge
    • Physical, chemical, and biological treatment processes, controls, and chemical-feed systems
    • Asset management, CMMS, condition assessment, resilience, and capital planning
    • System testing, startup, commissioning, and operational transition
    • Environmental permitting, NPDES compliance, and federal infrastructure contracts
    • High-strength wastewater, water reuse, recovery, and zero-liquid-discharge applications
    • Review project requirements following award and confirm scope, work procedures, schedule, budget, staffing, quality-management requirements, vendor needs, and project risks.
    • Prepare or oversee project work plans, project initiation documents, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and project closeout activities.
    • Lead preparation and review of calculations, technical reports, plans, specifications, cost estimates, permit applications, and construction documents.
    • Coordinate technical work across civil, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and controls, structural, architectural, environmental, and CADD disciplines.
    • Provide technical oversight during construction, including submittal and shop-drawing reviews, requests for information, change evaluations, progress meetings, site observations, startup, commissioning, and project closeout.
    • Apply Stanley Consultants’ quality-management procedures and applicable standards, including AWWA, WEF, Ten States Standards, state regulatory requirements, and client-specific design criteria.

      • Project Management

    • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, communications, resources, procurement, and risk.
    • Establish clear assignments, deliverable dates, review responsibilities, and communication protocols for geographically distributed project teams.
    • Monitor project performance and take timely corrective action when scope, schedule, budget, staffing, or quality concerns arise.
    • Maintain consistent communication with clients, project teams, subcontractors, and Stanley Consultants leadership.
    • Support contract negotiations, amendments, scope development, fee preparation, and project financial management.
    • Deliver projects in accordance with client expectations and Stanley Consultants’ project-management and quality requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • At least 20 years of progressive experience in water, wastewater, environmental, industrial, or public infrastructure.
  • Professional Engineer license in a U.S. jurisdiction, or ability to obtain one within six months; ability to obtain additional registrations as needed.
  • Experience delivering municipal and industrial water and wastewater projects through planning, design, construction, startup, operations, and rehabilitation.
  • Experience evaluating industrial wastewater characteristics, treatment, discharge, permitting, and water-reuse requirements.
  • Knowledge of industrial treatment technologies, including clarification, filtration, membranes, biological treatment, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, demineralization, and advanced reuse.
  • Ability to integrate water and wastewater systems with industrial processes, utilities, equipment, and site infrastructure.
  • Experience with alternative delivery methods such as design-build, progressive design-build, construction manager at risk, or engineer-procure-construct.
  • Experience collaborating with owners, contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Project-management experience overseeing scope, schedule, budget, quality, staffing, communications, and risk.
  • Strong communication and technical-writing skills, with proficiency in Microsoft 365.
  • Ability to work effectively and remotely and travel as needed, including overnight.
  • Participation in AWWA, WEF, or related state and regional organizations is desirable.

Remote-Work Expectations

The position is remote, but success will require active participation with clients and Stanley Consultants teams. The selected candidate will be expected to:

  • Maintain a professional and reliable home-office environment.
  • Be available for client and team meetings during established core working hours.
  • Use Microsoft Teams and other approved collaboration platforms for regular communication.
  • Travel to Stanley Consultants offices when needed for project workshops, training, interviews, and team-development activities.

  • Coordinate work across time zones and communicate availability, deadlines, and project risks proactively.
  • Comply with Stanley Consultants’ information-security, records-management, quality-management, and remote-work requirements.
Work-Life BalanceWe realize there’s more to life than just work. We help you meet the demands of work, family and personal life through several flexible options.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to help build brand awareness, create qualified demand, and engage the accounts and buying groups that matter most to Navan. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn strategy into campaigns—from audience planning and platform setup to creative testing, budget management, and optimization. You’ll help expand our paid media programs across paid social, video, programmatic, and merging channels, connecting brand building with long-term pipeline growth.

You’ll work closely with Creative, Content, Campaigns, Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales. You’ll also manage media vendors and partners to ensure campaigns reach the right audiences, deliver quality placements, and produce measurable results. The ideal candidate combines deep channel expertise, a strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM), and sound creative judgment. You understand that different campaigns serve different purposes and know how to measure success at each stage of the buyer journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Execute campaigns that build awareness and create demand
    • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit, YouTube, Google Demand Gen,programmatic display and emerging channels, including audience setup, bidding, budget pacing, tracking, and reporting.
    • Support major brand moments that build awareness, credibility, and consideration among relevant audiences in priority markets.
    • Activate demand-creation programs through content syndication, industry publishers, newsletters, and sponsored email, with clear audience requirements and lead-quality standards.
  • Put ABM strategy into practice
    • Translate priority account lists, engagement signals, and buying-group needs into actionable paid media audiences.
    • Build distinct campaigns to introduce Navan to unengaged accounts, reach missing buying roles within engaged accounts, and support progression where paid media can add value.
    • Partner with Marketing Operations to maintain audience syncs, exclusions, and suppression rules, and troubleshoot match rates and delivery issues.
    • Support one-to-one and one-to-few customer expansion campaigns in partnership with Customer Marketing and account teams, validating audience size and reach before launch.
    • Familiarity with 6Sense, Demandbase, StackAdapt or comparable programmatic and account-targeting platforms.
  • Partner with Creative and Content
    • Develop clear creative briefs that connect the campaign objective, audience, message, offer, and channel requirements.
    • Work with Creative, Content, and Product Marketing to produce paid social, display, and sponsored-content assets.
    • Run structured tests across messaging, concepts, formats, and landing pages, and turn results into clear recommendations for the next creative iteration.
    • Manage production timelines and asset refreshes so campaigns launch on time and stay relevant.
  • Measure, learn, and improve
    • Set campaign KPIs that match the objective, from qualified reach and consideration lift to account engagement, buying-group coverage, opportunities, and pipeline.
    • Partner with Analytics to design controlled tests, establish baselines, and evaluate incremental impact over appropriate measurement windows.
    • Validate account matching, placement quality, viewability, reach, and frequency, and resolve delivery issues before increasing investment.
    • Work with Marketing Operations and Sales to connect meaningful campaign responses with clear follow-up and feedback.
    • Communicate what is working, what remains uncertain, and where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including meaningful experience in B2B marketing.
  • Deep, recent hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads and multiple channels across paid social, YouTube, Google Demand Gen, and programmatic display.
  • Practical knowledge of ABM, including account segmentation, buying committees, audience activation, and long B2B buying cycles.
  • Experience executing both brand-awareness and demand-creation campaigns, with a clear understanding of how their objectives, creative, and measurement differ.
  • A track record of managing budgets, optimizing campaigns directly, and making thoughtful investment decisions.
  • Experience partnering with creative teams to develop briefs, test concepts, and improve campaign assets.
  • Strong vendor management skills and experience working with media partners, publishers, or agencies.
  • Confidence using campaign, CRM, and analytics data to assess audience quality and downstream performance.
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple campaigns and cross-functional partners.
The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity.

For roles with on-target-earnings (OTE), the pay range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping draw period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets. Candidates may receive more information from the recruiter.

title: VP, Revenue Marketing
description: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose.

raw.title: VP, Revenue Marketing
raw.excerpt: At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose.
raw.description:
At Bloomerang, we believe change happens on purpose. We champion the power and potential of nonprofits, igniting next-level impact with the team and technology built for purpose. Our powerful giving platform and stellar support enable tens of thousands of nonprofits to raise more, recruit more, and retain more, fueling maximum impact and raising the bar on what’s possible for the nonprofit sector. That's why, even as the nonprofit sector sees declines in giving, Bloomerang customers raise more year over year.

We're also in the business of creating thriving employees. Join a mission-driven culture built on our core values of Simplify, Care and Act. We know our people are the key to our success, and we're proud to be home to some of the most innovative and skilled individuals in the workforce today. Come feel invigorated and unstoppable with us!

The Role

The VP of Revenue Marketing reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and is accountable for how Bloomerang generates new business demand and revenue. Buyer journeys, integrated campaigns, account-based sales and marketing plays, search and AI visibility, paid search, the website, and conversion optimization are your pillars for growth.

Success in the role is driving month-over-month and year-over-year new account acquisition, pipeline, and bookings growth in partnership with Business Development, Sales, and Marketing leadership. You are responsible for the complete demand and conversion engine that takes nonprofits on their journey with Bloomerang.

You lead through the leaders on your team, you influence how the wider Marketing Team works, and you are a visible, trusted leader with your peers across the business.

Key Outcomes

Success in this role is not a set of responsibilities and checking boxes. These are strategic outcomes tied to nonprofit success and ultimately, Bloomerang’s success.

Our volume keeps growing, and it comes from more places than it has before. Paid search, organic and direct have served us well and they keep compounding. You get us (and the team) ahead of where volume will be next. By partnering with demand leaders, you enable our innovation in visibility via a multi-year view of where our volume comes from, and a funded plan to build it.

We win in market segments we have not pursued yet, while the core engine continues to expand. You identify, size, and build the go-to-market account-based marketing and sales playbooks for those segments with your team and GTM leadership. Your integrated campaigns team keeps Marketing in lockstep with the Sales and Business Development motions; activating and opting-in target accounts while the engine that carries the number keeps pacing to beat the plan.

Buyers get an experience built for where they actually are. Much of our funnel is built to catch buyers who arrive ready. You and the team build the next buyer journey layer that meets everyone else via modern integrated campaigns, nurtures, and personalization at scale; using the best tooling available. The results are seen via conversion and velocity performance through the funnel, not just volume at the top.

Marketing, Business Development and Sales run one plan, and together we drive it. You help build, refine and hold the reverse waterfall with your GTM peers as genuine partners and collaborators. It is one goal, one set of numbers, co-signed, that survives even if it is not perfect. When something needs attention, GTM leaders come to you because you will dig in and solve it with them.

Every bet we make has evidence. You know the channels, sources and run-rates cold. You continually run experiments with your team (and cross-functionally) to prove a play at a small scale, then execute what works. And just as important, cut what does not perform. When we fund a program, you show the work so GTM and Executive Leadership can support the reasoning, not just the idea.

Growth investment goes where it compounds, and everyone can see why. You are responsible for the full programmatic, demand software and demand campaign budget. Smart investment allocation is the primary growth lever to scale the business. You and the team decide where it goes, including moving it between channels and sources (even sometimes teams), and you align leadership before any significant shift.

Marketing produces higher quality outcomes next year than this year, with the same number of people. You help drive the AI agenda for the whole department, not just your team. Which workflows agents run, how much autonomy each earns, who stays accountable for the output. You help set the standard and the pace, and you inspire the other functions to come with you.

Your team grows, and your influence reaches beyond marketing. You are a leader first. The leaders on your team design the strategy and run the day-to-day, and you put your energy where it strengthens the team most. You earn the respect across the business that gets your team’s innovations backed. People grow under you, and the best marketers want to join your team.

The sector knows who you are. You present, you speak, and you take the stage. Your regular conversations with fundraising and nonprofit leaders bring insight back into the revenue marketing and product teams. At this level you shape how the market sees Bloomerang, not only how the business runs.

What You Will Do

  • You are both halves of the brain: an operator and a strategist. You are deep enough in the core engine that drives growth performance (GEO, organic, paid, website experiences, and campaigns) to refine it with the team, and creative enough to see quarters in advance and know what comes next. You have grown a demand engine through a channel shift: you spotted the change in the mix, worked through it, and got your team ahead of it. You can tell us the before, the after, and what you would do differently.
  • You lead leaders, and you are an energizer. You grew your leaders into stronger cross-functional leaders than when you found them. You have inherited a team, raised the bar, and had people follow you to the next thing. You bring pace and optimism, you stay level-headed when things are difficult, and people dig in and do their best work with you.
  • You have delivered growth at this rate before. You know what breaks at that pace, and you have built through it rather than around it.
  • You cannot imagine working without AI anymore. You have redesigned real marketing workflows with agents rather than attended a training. You can tell the difference between output that is good and output that is merely fast, and you get genuinely energized by what this makes possible for a team.
  • You prove it before you scale it. You make decisions from completed tests, not personal wants or conviction. You have cancelled your own good idea because the data did not support it, and you can tell us about it without flinching.
  • GTM leaders want you in the room. You have carried a shared number with a sales leader, and neither of you needed a mediator. Your Sales, Marketing, and Business Development peers would tell us you made their number easier to hit.
  • You are comfortable in front of the market. You can carry a stage, a webinar, a discussion with nonprofit executives and industry influencers. You are credible with the Senior Leadership Team and the Executive Team.
  • You respect a buyer who may not be a technologist. Our buyers are fundraisers and nonprofit leaders. They are passionate, time-constrained, mission-driven people who do not have time to decode jargon. Marketing should make them feel confident, hopeful and excited to learn from Bloomerang.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS growth, demand or revenue marketing, including 5+ years leading other leaders
  • Scaled a high-volume, high-velocity inbound engine where marketing sourced the majority of pipeline
  • Carried a number through sustained 30%+ YoY bookings growth and helped scale a business toward $200M or beyond
  • Owned a marketing-sourced pipeline number and delivered against it, under pressure
  • Built and held a reverse waterfall or equivalent funnel plan with Sales, Business Development and Revenue Operations leadership
  • Have hands-on depth across paid, website and conversion optimization, and organic and AI-driven discovery
  • Translated deep product knowledge and hands-on product experience into high-impact buyer journeys that convert
  • Owned a meaningful program, agency and software budget and made real allocation calls with it
  • Experience with a modern demand stack — CRM, marketing automation, ABM and intent, analytics, A/B testing, and AI tooling

Benefits

Health + Wellness

You’ll have access to generous health, vision, and dental insurance options as well as HealthiestYou, a healthcare service that offers convenient, confidential access to quality doctors 24/7, anytime, anywhere.

Time Off

You’ll get a competitive PTO package that includes 20 PTO days, 3 flex days, 4 optional volunteer days, 12 paid holidays, as well as paid parental leave. More is more!

401k

You’ll receive a 401k match to help invest in your future.

Equipment

Everything you need to be successful, shipped right to your door. You got this. We got you.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is: $175,500 - $292,500. You may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, as well as applicable employment laws.

Location

This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote position. Employees living in Indianapolis, IN are welcome to work from our company headquarters. We do not offer Visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Accommodations

Applicants who require accommodations may contact to request an accommodation in completing an application.

Bloomerang is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Individuals seeking employment at Bloomerang are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

raw.description:
Achievers is hiring a Global Payroll and Benefits Administrator on an 18-month contract to provide maternity leave coverage to run Canadian and US payroll and own benefits administration for both countries. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Global Payroll & Benefits, you will process bi-weekly payrolls in Workday (Canada) and ADP Workforce Now (US), manage remittances, year-end, payroll/benefits journal entries and back up global payroll delivery through Remote.

How you'll shape Employee Success at Achievers:

    Payroll Operations:

  • Prepare and submit Canadian bi-weekly payroll in Workday and US bi-weekly payroll in ADP Workforce Now (WFN).
  • Reconcile Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) source deductions and Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and state tax deposits each pay period.
  • Issue Records of Employment (ROEs) for terminations and leaves.
  • Complete Canadian and US year-end, including reconciliations, T4 and T4A slips, W-2 forms.
  • Prepare and file US workers’ compensation for Washington and Ohio and update Finance on new hires and terminations for the US workers’ compensation policy.
  • Resolve US federal and state tax notices with government agencies and ADP, and complete new US state registrations as required.
  • Backup as required for all other global payroll runs processed through Remote, monthly filings for Australian state payroll tax and annual Australian workers’ compensation true-up.
  • Communicate with government bodies and third parties as required.
  • Keep up to date with legislative changes affecting payroll and benefits in Canada and the US.
  • Ensure payroll and benefits enquiries from employees, managers, and cross-functional teams are addressed promptly, accurately, and consistently. Proactively communicate payroll issues, corrections, payment impacts, and required employee actions.
  • Maintain and regularly update Canada and US payroll and benefits SOPs to ensure processes, controls, and procedures are accurately documented, supporting operational consistency, effective knowledge transfer, and reduced key-person dependency.

    • Analysis and Reconciliations:

  • Reconcile payroll and benefit cost allocations and post related journal entries (JEs).
  • Support the year-end financial and third-party audits.
  • Complete payroll and benefits analysis and reconciliations as needed.

    • Benefits Administration:

  • Own benefits administration for Canada and US, including enrollments, invoice reconciliation, and employee support.
  • Act as the main backup for benefits administration in all other countries.
  • Administer the Canadian Group RRSP, including contribution reconciliations and maintain plan compliance.
  • Reconcile US 401(k) plan contributions.
  • Provide backup support for Australian superannuation and UK pension programs.
  • Support Canada and US benefits renewals.
  • Lead benefits information sessions for new hires in Canada and the US.

Experience we feel will set you up for success:

  • 5+ years of payroll experience, including hands-on processing of Canadian and US multi-state payrolls and year end (T4/T4A, W-2)
  • PCP certification (mandatory).
  • Working knowledge of US multi-state payroll tax, including resolving state tax notices.
  • 2+ years of Canada and US benefits administration experience, including group RRSP and 401(k) plans.
  • Experience with global payroll and/or benefits, including working with a global payroll provider such as Remote (an asset).
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, and reconciliations) and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Workday Payroll or comparable Canadian payroll-system experience is an asset.
Why Achievers is a Great Place to Work™
At Achievers, we believe recognition is a powerful driver of connection. With more than 4.3 million users across 190 countries, our employee recognition and rewards platform empowers organizations to build cultures where people feel seen and valued, everyday. We’re a team of passionate, thoughtful builders who care deeply about our product, our customers, and each other. Visit to see how we’re inspiring recognition everywhere.

Our Approach to Total Rewards

We’re committed to providing a fair and competitive offer based on what you bring to the team. Each A-Players' compensation is reviewed at least annually against performance and impact in role. We want you to see your path to growth, understand your impact, and feel valued every step of the way.
$70,000 - $83,000 reflects what we reasonably expect to offer for this role based on current market data. The final offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, experience, and any relevant certifications. As with all market-based ranges, these numbers may evolve over time, but we’re committed to providing a fair and competitive offer based on what you bring to the team.
Benefits and Perks for permanent full-time employees:
✨ Rewards for your impact through our Recognition and Rewards program
🤝🏽 Employee and Family Assistance Program offering mental health, legal, and financial counselling
🚀 Supported professional development and career growth (Linkedin Learning, mentorship)
👏🏼 Employee-Led Employee Resource Groups that celebrate our diversity
🧘‍♀️ Regular events designed to build connection, belonging, and well-being
🇨🇦 Hybrid flexibility, with time in our beautiful Liberty Village, Toronto office
Achievers is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.
Achievers is committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. raw.description:
Senior Technical Animator (Unreal Engine | Remote)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Project-Based / Contract

Open Positions: 2

Position Overview

We are looking for experienced Senior Technical Animators with strong Unreal Engine expertise and a passion for solving complex animation challenges for an unannounced game project with one of our partners.

We believe exceptional technical animation is about more than creating character rigs. It's about building reliable systems, developing efficient workflows, and empowering animators to bring characters to life with the highest level of quality and technical precision.

As part of our co-development team, you will work closely with animators, technical artists, and gameplay programmers to develop, integrate, and optimize character rigs, animation systems, and production pipelines directly in Unreal Engine.

This is a hands-on senior role for someone with strong technical animation fundamentals, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of complex animation systems within an established production environment.

Responsibilities

Character Rigging & Technical Animation

  • Create, maintain, and optimize character rigs for bipedal, non-bipedal, and mechanical characters.

  • Develop robust rigging and skinning solutions that support high-quality character performances.

  • Ensure character rigs are efficient, scalable, and suitable for real-time game production.

  • Collaborate with animators to resolve deformation issues and improve animation workflows.

  • Maintain technical consistency across character setups and animation assets.

Unreal Engine Animation Systems

  • Implement and maintain character animation systems directly in Unreal Engine.

  • Work with Animation Blueprints, State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Motion Matching workflows.

  • Support animation logic and integration involving Behavior Trees and State Trees.

  • Collaborate with gameplay programmers to develop reliable character animation behavior.

  • Investigate, debug, and resolve animation-related issues across in-game systems.

  • Optimize animation systems to meet real-time performance requirements.

Animation Pipelines & Tools

  • Develop and improve workflows connecting Maya, Blender, and Unreal Engine.

  • Build efficient processes for animation export, import, retargeting, and character integration.

  • Create reusable tools and technical solutions that improve animator productivity.

  • Identify pipeline bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation and share knowledge across teams.

Collaboration & Co-Development

  • Work closely with our partner's animation, technical art, and engineering teams.

  • Integrate into existing production pipelines and contribute to established technical standards.

  • Translate animation requirements into practical, production-ready solutions.

  • Take ownership of assigned systems and proactively identify technical risks.

  • Communicate technical challenges, progress, and solutions clearly across distributed teams.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional experience in game animation or technical animation.

  • Proven experience working on commercially released game productions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 5 and real-time character animation systems.

  • Excellent technical skills in character rigging, skinning, and deformation.

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, character mechanics, and real-time animation workflows.

  • Professional proficiency with Maya and Blender, including their integration with Unreal Engine.

  • Practical experience with Animation Blueprints, State Machines, Blend Spaces, and Motion Matching.

  • Understanding of Behavior Trees, State Trees, and their interaction with character animation systems.

  • Experience developing and maintaining DCC-to-engine animation pipelines.

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex animation integration and performance issues.

  • Strong understanding of technical constraints, performance optimization, and scalable production workflows.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with animators, technical artists, and programmers.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine Control Rig and procedural animation systems.

  • Knowledge of IK Rig, IK Retargeter, Full Body IK, and runtime animation solutions.

  • Experience with Python, MEL, or mGear for rigging and pipeline automation.

  • Experience creating custom animation tools and editor utilities.

  • Familiarity with high-fidelity character systems and complex character deformation.

  • Experience with procedural animation, physics-driven animation, or runtime rigging.

  • Experience optimizing animation systems for demanding real-time applications.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment with international teams.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to an unannounced game project with one of our partners.

  • Direct collaboration with experienced animation and engineering teams.

  • Meaningful technical ownership over character animation systems and production workflows.

  • Fully remote collaboration within an international development environment.

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and contract arrangements.

  • Potential opportunities for continued collaboration on future projects.

  • Supportive and experienced Beffio Studios team.

Ready to Bring Characters to Life Through Technology?

Send us your portfolio, technical breakdowns, or examples of animation systems you have developed.

We are especially interested in seeing Unreal Engine animation implementations, character rigs, technical tools, and production workflows that demonstrate your ability to solve complex animation challenges in real game development environments.

raw.description:
Pay: PHP 80k to 100k per month

Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.

You'll write the copy that sits at the center of our growth. It's work that goes live quickly and is measured by real results, so you'll know what worked within days.

For a gifted writer who's fascinated by persuasion and wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of the voice of a growing brand.

A few examples of your responsibilities

Write words that move people. Stories and copy that pull a skeptical reader in, build belief, and move them to act. You'll lead with the angle, the hook, and the proof that earn the click and the order.

Script video that holds attention. Write the scripts for the videos that carry our brand: the hook in the first seconds, the story that keeps people watching, and the line that closes it.

Own the brand voice. Make Cellexia Labs sound like itself everywhere a customer meets us: confident, clear, and credible.

Turn insight into messaging. Dig into customer reviews, support conversations, and ingredient science to find the language customers actually use, then build every piece around it.

Make complex things simple. Take formulation details and ingredient science and turn them into benefits a customer understands in seconds, while staying accurate and compliant.

Test relentlessly. Ship variations of angles, hooks, and openings, read the results with the marketing team, and double down on what wins. Your best work is the work the data backs.

What we look for

Command of the craft. You write sharply and clearly, and you can tell a line that lands from one that merely sounds good. You edit your own work hard.

A pull toward persuasion. You're fascinated by what makes people say yes: the customer's doubts, the offer, the proof, the words that earn trust. You don't need a background in sales or persuasion. You need real curiosity about how words move people, and the drive to learn from what the numbers tell you.

Ownership. You treat every piece of copy as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.

Curiosity. You research before you write. You're willing to understand ingredients, customers, and competitors until the words come from real understanding.

Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.

Relevant experience. [2+] years of professional writing, with a portfolio that shows it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or other consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.

What we offer

Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. You'll never wait on a chain of sign-offs. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.

Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.

Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.

Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you decide how to use it.

Impact you can see. Copy goes live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your words move the numbers.

A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.

A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the writer who shapes our voice is the writer best placed to lead it.

The selection process

We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.

Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link:

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.

We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.

If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.

Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.

If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.title: Sales Lead / Senior Sales Manager
raw.excerpt: Grow into Group Head of Sales: run revenue like a founder, across a small group of software companies Find where revenue is stuck.
raw.description:
Grow into Group Head of Sales: run revenue like a founder, across a small group of software companies

Find where revenue is stuck. Fix it with your own hands. Hand it on. Move to the next.

Remote on UK hours, within reach of Jersey · Full time · £100,000 base · About £175,000 on target, uncapped · £100,000 of equity

Who this is for

Somewhere right now there is a strong senior salesperson or sales lead who is ready to take the next step. They have closed significant deals themselves, helped improve sales processes, and are ready to take ownership of a sales function. They want the opportunity to build a team, grow into a Head of Sales role, and own part of the result. If that is you, read on. If you would rather inherit a team and a playbook, this is a good place to stop.

Where this is going

We are a founder-led group of B2B software companies serving the private wealth and governance world: WealthComply (FATCA and CRS compliance automation), MinuteMaster (board minutes and governance automation) and a third venture that is in stealth. We sell to trust companies, fund administrators and private wealth firms across Europe, the Middle East, Asia and the Caribbean.

Today the founder carries every deal from demonstration to signature himself, and a small business development team books the first meetings. Within a year we want revenue arriving every month without him. This role builds that, one stage at a time.

The role

You will grow into running revenue the way a founder would. You find the one place where it is stuck, do that work yourself until it flows, write down how, hand it to someone you hire or train, and move to the next. Today that place is the stretch between a good demonstration and a signed customer, so you start by selling, often in person in Jersey, Guernsey, London and Switzerland. Expect about seventy per cent of your week on whichever stage is stuck. You work closely with the founder, gradually take ownership of our business development team, and build the rest of the team as each stage starts to work. You report to the founder. Nobody has held this job before you.

You will be judged on five things

  1. Revenue collected every month, on both products.
  2. A pipeline that anyone can read and trust.
  3. The founder out of the sale within six months.
  4. Stages that keep working after you move on.
  5. Customers who stay and grow, with nothing sold that the product cannot do.

This role will not suit you if

  • You want a large team to manage from your first day. You start with a small BD team, and the rest is built one working stage at a time.
  • You want to stop selling and focus only on managing others.
  • Your answer to slow sales is more outbound volume. Our market is a few hundred firms that know each other.
  • You sell by promising. Our buyers work in compliance, and they check.
  • You want a guaranteed bonus, or you find it hard to be corrected.

Who you are

  • You are an experienced senior salesperson, sales lead or sales manager, ready to grow into a Head of Sales role. You may have coached or mentored other sellers, but you don't need to have led an entire sales function before.
  • You have helped improve a sales process, fix what was not working, or build something from nothing. You can show the numbers before and after.
  • You still sell. You have closed significant new business yourself in the last three years, sold to several people inside regulated firms, and you can name the customers.
  • You know how trust companies, corporate service providers and fund administrators buy, or you have sold to firms like them.
  • AI is already how you work, well past drafting emails. You know where it goes wrong, and you check.
  • Humble, hungry, happy. You would rather be corrected than be right, your forecast is honest, and people are glad when you join the call.

What we offer

  • A £100,000 base, and variable pay on all the revenue your team brings in and grows. At target your total is about £175,000. In a strong year it is £250,000 or more, and there is no cap.
  • £100,000 of equity, so you share in the value you help create. If we hit our plan, it will be worth many times that. If we miss, it could be worth nothing.
  • A team that is yours to build, a founder who will hand over his deals, and a written path to Group Head of Sales and eventually Group Chief Revenue Officer.
  • A CRM and tool stack being rebuilt so that you can question them, and act on them, in plain language.
  • Remote on UK hours, a week in Jersey each month for the first quarter, travel paid, budgets for home office, learning and wellbeing, and a pace we can keep.

How we hire

Four steps, then an offer, over about four weeks. After each step we tell you where you stand within two working days.

  1. Apply: your CV or LinkedIn and three short questions (about 30 minutes).
  2. A call with our recruiter (30 minutes).
  3. A working session with our founder and our head of product (about two hours, by video). In the first hour you walk us through a sales process you improved or a significant deal you closed, then sell to us. In the second you work through a real pipeline with an AI assistant beside you.
  4. A paid trial: two days of real work with us, arranged around your notice period. You meet the people you would lead and one of our co-founders, and we take your references.

The offer comes with a sixty-day review against outcomes we agree together. We mean that both ways.

How to apply

Apply through the link. Along with your CV or LinkedIn profile, we ask three short questions: a sales process you improved or helped build, what was stuck, what you did with your own hands and the numbers before and after (up to 300 words); three significant new customers you closed yourself in the last three years, with deal size and how each started (up to 200 words); and your location, notice period, pay expectation and weakest "who you are" point. No cover letter. If you are not sure you tick every box, apply anyway.

raw.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About The Role

Steer is building one of the fastest-growing GTM engines in automotive SaaS, and we’re launching a dedicated Mid-Market segment. We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to own a new business with full-service auto repair groups running 4–10 locations.

These are serious operators. They’ve built multi-million-dollar businesses, they’ve seen plenty of vendors, and they buy on results. You’ll run consultative, multi-stakeholder deals with owners, operations leaders, and finance, and you’ll win them with sharp discovery and a business case that holds up.

This is a builder role. You’ll carry a number while helping shape the Mid-Market playbook, and you’ll work directly with our CRO on how this segment grows.

We measure success three ways: MRR added, rooftops added, and how well you build the foundation for the team that follows.

You Will:

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle: Prospect, run discovery, demo, build the business case, negotiate, and close new multi-location accounts.
  • Build Your Own Pipeline: Generate pipeline with 4–10 shop groups through outbound, events, and marketing programs. Partner with SMB AEs and BDRs on accounts that grow into your segment.
  • Sell to the Whole Buying Group: Multi-thread across owners, operations directors, marketing managers, and finance, and align them on why Steer and why now.
  • Lead With Business Impact: Tie Steer to the numbers operators care about: car count, average repair order, customer retention, and location-by-location performance.
  • Build the Playbook: Help define our Mid-Market ICP, discovery framework, ROI model, and mutual action plans. Document what works so the team that follows can scale it.
  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Work with Customer Success on multi-location rollouts and expansion, and bring customer insight back to Marketing and Product.
  • Forecast With Precision: Keep HubSpot clean and deliver accurate forecasts.

You Have:

Must Have

  • 3+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota
  • Experience closing multi-stakeholder deals and building business cases that win approval
  • Strong discovery skills: you diagnose before you prescribe
  • Proven ability to build your own pipeline
  • Forecasting discipline and strong deal control
  • A builder mentality: you create process where none exists and don’t wait to be told what to do next
  • Direct, plain-spoken communication that earns the trust of business owners

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to multi-location businesses (automotive, home services, dental, veterinary, franchise, etc.)
  • Automotive aftermarket or shop management software experience
  • Experience as the first rep in a new segment or territory
  • Familiarity with HubSpot and Nooks

Interview Process

  • Initial Screen (Lead Recruiter) – 30 min
  • Hiring Manager Interview (CRO) – 45 min
  • Career Journey + Critical Thinking Exercise (Head of People) – 60 min
  • Mock Discovery + Demo (CRO, [Parker’s title]) – 45 min
  • Reference Checks

We also require completion of the Wonderlic Assessment before the end of the process. It’s done independently and takes about 20–30 minutes.

We Offer

  • Medical, Dental and Vision insurance within 30 days
  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance
  • Equity package
  • Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • FSA and HSA options
  • 401(k)
  • Learning Stipend
  • WFH Equipment
  • Chance to work with the latest technology
  • A collaborative, high-ownership culture
  • Opportunities for development and career growth

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light

We are Lumineers. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

  • Pursuit of greatness: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
  • Meaningful work matters: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
  • Elevate each other: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀

Job Details

  • 💼 Revenue team
  • 📍 Japan
  • 🕜 Full-Time Remote
  • 🌐 Fluent in English and Japanese

What you will do
You’ll be the face of Lighthouse for prospective clients, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close. This is a hunter role: you carry a quota, you build your own pipeline, and you’re accountable to outcomes and success. No excuses, just results.
What makes this different: you won’t do it alone. Lighthouse is deploying an agent AI infrastructure — Enablement, Pre-Sales, and Coaching agents — alongside a modern revenue stack. AI handles the prep, the sequencing, and the pattern recognition so you can focus on what matters — building relationships, running sharp discovery, and closing deals.
We work with structured sales methodology, like MEDDPICC to support high-quality deal execution. You’ll advance deals with evidence, protect pricing on value, and forecast with precision. We want to help you use modern tools to become a better seller and achieve great success.

Where you will have impact

  • Own your territory and your number. Build and execute a strategic territory plan to generate a net-new pipeline. Maintain 3x pipeline coverage, forecast honestly, and take full accountability for your results. Your quota is your commitment.
  • Hunt and build a pipeline. Source a meaningful share of your own pipeline through outbound sequences, ICP targeting, Lighthouse Connect events, and industry conferences. This is not an SDR-reliant role.
  • Run a disciplined sales process. Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. Use the AI Pre-Sales Agent to identify gaps before every major call. Advance deals through stage gates with evidence, not optimism. Leverage AI to make your days easier and focus on more selling time.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage the Enablement Agent for call prep, discovery frameworks, and positioning. Use the Coaching Agent to surface patterns in your pipeline and win rate. Push back on the tools when they’re wrong — help make the system smarter.
  • Become a hospitality expert. We will help you understand revenue management workflows well enough to run ROI conversations without a pre-sales overlay on every deal. Position an integrated platform versus point solutions. Know the competitive landscape inside out.
  • Drive results beyond net-new. Consistently meet and exceed sales targets through new business and by identifying expansion and upgrade opportunities within your accounts. Partner with Product to share market feedback and influence the roadmap. Represent Lighthouse at industry events to build the brand and your

About our team

You’ll join a global Revenue team of 150+ sales professionals across 24 countries. Our team works across the full Lighthouse product suite, helping hotels, chains, and hospitality groups achieve their commercial goals. It’s a collaborative, high-energy environment with real opportunities for career growth and the chance to learn from experienced leaders as we continue to expand our market share.

What's in it for you

  • Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
  • Career development: Workshops, frameworks, and training to maximize your professional potential.
  • Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
  • Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

Who you are

  • 5-7 years in a closing sales role, SaaS experience is a must but hunger and skill matters more than industry tenure.
  • Self-directed, coachable, and driven to continuously improve. You seek feedback on your calls, your pipeline, and your positioning — and act on it within the next deal, not the next quarter.
  • You treat AI tools as a core part of your selling motion, not a novelty. You adopt new tooling quickly and bend it to your style.
  • Experience with MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is that you bring discipline and structure to how you run deals.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to sell on value, not price. Confident engaging stakeholders from GMs to C-suite.
  • You want to win. You prospect when it would be easier not to. You follow up one more time. You’re not okay with a bad quarter.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.title: Compliance Lead - CMMC (NIST SP 800-171)
raw.excerpt: Role DescriptionWe are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations.
raw.description:
Role Description

We are seeking a CMMC Compliance Lead to join Commercial Cyber Operations. This person is the customer-facing lead for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 engagements and owns NIST SP 800-171 interpretation, scoping, documentation, and assessment readiness from kickoff through the C3PAO assessment and into sustainment. Compliance Lead decides what the systems must satisfy, can configure the controls personally in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 GCC High, writes the record that proves it, and verifies the result the way an assessor would.

This is not a coordination role. The Compliance Lead scopes the assessment boundary, authors the System Security Plan and supporting documentation, directs and where needed performs control implementation, assesses the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide, and stands next to the customer during the assessment. They are the day-to-day point of contact for their assigned customers and answer CMMC questions with authority and in plain terms. Customer environments vary: Windows and macOS fleets, GCC High and Google Workspace tenants, Jamf and Intune, cloud and on-prem enclaves. This person has to be versatile enough to work in all of them.

Responsibilities

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers for the life of the engagement: run kickoff, working sessions, and status reporting; answer CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 questions directly and accurately without escalation.
  • Scope the CMMC assessment boundary: trace FCI and CUI flows, categorize assets per the CMMC Level 2 Scoping Guide (CUI, Security Protection, Contractor Risk Managed, Specialized, Out of Scope), and produce the boundary, data-flow, and network diagrams.
  • Lead each engagement through the standard delivery process from intake to assessor-ready package, holding the stage gates and evidence standards.
  • Author and maintain the System Security Plan, policies and procedures, POA&M, and evidence library at the assessment-objective level; score self-assessments and SPRS submissions under the DoD Assessment Methodology and 32 CFR Part 170.
  • Implement the technical controls hands-on in the customer tenant: identity, MFA, and conditional access in Entra ID or Google Cloud Identity; least privilege and privileged-account separation; data protection in Microsoft Purview or Google Workspace DLP; FIPS-validated encryption; configuration baselines. Decide which requirement each setting satisfies and why, and split the heavier build work with the Technical Implementation Engineer.
  • Stand up and operate endpoint management across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise): enrollment, compliance policies, CIS or DISA STIG baselines, BitLocker and FileVault, patching, and removable-media control.
  • Build the logging and monitoring stack the AU, RA, and SI practices require: centralized audit logging and alerting in a SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar), log retention and review cadence, vulnerability scanning and remediation tracking, and backup and recovery verification.
  • Assess the finished environment against the CMMC Level 2 Assessment Guide using examine, interview, and test methods; run the pre-assessment readiness review and close gaps before the C3PAO arrives.
  • Prepare customers for C3PAO assessments and support them during assessment week: evidence presentation, interview coaching, assessor questions, and post-assessment POA&M closeout.
  • Run sustainment for customers: continuous monitoring cadence, change reviews, annual affirmations, and reassessment readiness.
  • Improve the practice: turn repeatable work into templates, checklists, and automation, and contribute domain content to the team's internal AI tooling.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

  • Experience taking defense contractors through NIST SP 800-171 / CMMC Level 2 end to end, from scoping through assessment, including at least one organization you personally led through a successful C3PAO or DIBCAC assessment as the consultant, assessor, or internal compliance lead.
  • Proven ability to write assessor-ready documentation: System Security Plans at the assessment-objective level, policies and procedures, POA&Ms, and data-flow and network diagrams.
  • Hands-on experience implementing NIST SP 800-171 technical controls yourself in Microsoft 365 GCC High (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Defender) or Google Workspace (Admin console, Cloud Identity, context-aware access, endpoint management): the admin-console work, not only the policy; able to validate what an implementation engineer built rather than accept a screenshot.
  • Endpoint management experience across Windows and macOS (iOS and Android a plus) with at least one of Microsoft Intune or Jamf: enrollment, compliance and configuration policies, disk encryption, patching, and hardening baselines.
  • Experience centralizing audit logs and alerts in a SIEM or log platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, Splunk, or similar) and operating vulnerability scanning, patch management, and backup to satisfy the AU, RA, SI, and MP practices.
  • Working knowledge of networking and perimeter controls (firewalls, VPN and secure remote access, segmentation, DNS, wireless), enough to scope the boundary and verify the SC practices.
  • Customer-facing lead: runs meetings, explains requirements in plain terms to executives and IT staff, documents decisions, pushes back constructively, and delivers without close supervision.
  • Ability to run multiple concurrent engagements (typically 4–6), track milestones, and report status in a remote, asynchronous environment (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace).

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

  • CMMC Certified Assessor (CCA) strongly preferred; CMMC Certified Professional (CCP) at minimum. Lead CCA designation or Registered Practitioner Advanced (RPA) a plus.
  • Hands-on implementation experience in both Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 GCC High, including GCC High migrations and Google Workspace configurations built to NIST SP 800-171.
  • Depth in Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, or Google SecOps; CIS Benchmarks or DISA STIG hardening; Windows Server and Active Directory in hybrid environments.
  • CUI enclave design and migration: GCC High, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, or on-prem enclaves, including FedRAMP Moderate equivalency evaluation of cloud service providers and scoping of external service providers.

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 10%–25% (customer kickoffs, on-site readiness reviews, C3PAO assessment weeks)

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA
$123,250—$166,750 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

Job Description:

3M Health Care is now Solventum


At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
Solventum enables clinicians to not just treat wounds, but to advance healing. To support that, you’ll serve as a consultative wound care expert and primary contact for post acute and transition of care decision makers. You’ll educate clinicians, drive adoption of Solventum solutions, expand therapy utilization, and ensure proper documentation for therapy authorization.


As a Post-acute Wound Healing Specialist you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Routinely consulting with clinicians on safe and effective use of Solventum products

raw.description:
The Director, Procurement Excellence is accountable for the enterprise operating model, governance, systems, data, analytics, and adoption capabilities that enable Procurement to deliver sustained value. This position leads three direct reports, the Procurement Operations Manager, Inventory Data Analyst, and Procurement Analytics Analyst, and owns the Procurement technology roadmap, the governance of Coupa and related capabilities as enterprise business platforms, and the standards, controls, service model, and performance cadence for a scalable Source-to-Pay (S2P) environment. This position works with the Director of Strategic Sourcing, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, Operations, and business leaders to align sourcing strategies with the operational capabilities, systems, data, and governance needed to execute them and to translate procurement strategy into scalable processes, controls, and measurable outcomes. This position reports to the Senior Director of Shared Services.

The budgeted salary range for this position is $150,100 - $187,600. Actual pay will be dependent on budget and experience; all our salaried roles are eligible for bonus.

Job Posting Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted until 12/1/2026

Essential Job Functions/Key Job Responsibilities

  • Set the enterprise Procurement Excellence strategy and multi-year roadmap, including the operating capabilities, governance, organizational priorities, annual planning and prioritization process, and continuous improvement initiatives that support business strategy and long-term value objectives
  • Define and evolve the Procurement operating model and governance framework, including decision rights, service ownership, cross-functional handoffs, escalation paths, resource alignment, and accountability for enterprise standards
  • Partner with the Director of Strategic Sourcing to establish aligned priorities, coordinate strategic initiatives, and ensure procurement systems, processes, supplier enablement, data, and operational resources support sourcing strategies, with consistent communication, coordinated decision-making, and shared accountability for results
  • Translate Procurement Modernization objectives into measurable business outcomes, balancing financial value, operational risk, user experience, standardization, control requirements, and organizational capacity
  • Own the Procurement technology strategy and roadmap, driving continuous optimization of Coupa and the broader Source-to-Pay technology ecosystem to expand functionality, improve user experience, increase automation, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency
  • Partner with the Director of Strategic Sourcing, Finance, IT, Accounts Payable, and business stakeholders to prioritize technology investments and enhancements, evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation, and establish performance measures for technology-enabled value, including increased spend under management, process efficiencies, improved compliance, and operational cost reductions
  • Provide strategic direction for Procurement Operations through the Procurement Operations Manager, who is accountable for Coupa administration, supplier administration, user support, training, documentation, and operational reporting, and establish the service model, including service ownership, intake and prioritization standards, performance expectations, escalation protocols, and accountability for timely issue resolution
  • Oversee platform and supplier enablement governance, ensuring Coupa capabilities, supplier onboarding, catalogs, access, workflows, and related services support business needs, policy requirements, and an effective user experience
  • Monitor operational health and organizational capacity through service-level measures, platform performance, demand and backlog trends, control exceptions, and recurring root-cause themes, and guide the prioritization of enhancements, stabilization needs, and support investments with IT, Finance, Accounts Payable, business leaders, and external service providers
  • Provide strategic direction for inventory data governance, procurement analytics, and performance management through the Inventory Data Analyst and Procurement Analytics Analyst, and establish expectations for item master integrity, inventory controls, analytics quality, and cross-functional data ownership
  • Set the enterprise Procurement KPI and value-realization framework, including Finance-aligned savings governance and visibility into spend, compliance, adoption, service, supplier, inventory, data-quality, and operational performance, and ensure performance reporting is governed by consistent definitions, validated data, and appropriate separation of duties
  • Sponsor dashboards, inventory insights, and decision-support capabilities that identify trends, risks, sourcing opportunities, replenishment needs, root causes, and corrective actions, and use performance insights to focus leadership attention and improvement priorities
  • Set the enterprise procurement adoption and change strategy for Coupa and standardized processes, including training, communications, business-readiness plans, adoption measures, and accountability mechanisms, and partner with business leaders and change champions to address resistance, remove adoption barriers, and incorporate user, supplier, and operational feedback into the improvement roadmap
  • Establish and maintain enterprise procurement policies, controls, standards, and exception governance that support compliance, usability, audit readiness, and accountability across the Source-to-Pay lifecycle, and define control ownership, monitoring expectations, and remediation protocols with Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, Internal Audit, and Operations
  • Lead cross-functional resolution of material process, control, and system issues, maintain a prioritized continuous improvement portfolio, and establish benefit measures and post-implementation reviews to confirm that improvements deliver intended outcomes
  • Represent Procurement Excellence in executive, governance, and cross-functional forums, build alignment across Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, Operations, property leadership, and suppliers, provide executive reporting and recommendations on value realization, adoption, service health, data quality, operational performance, risks, and strategic investments, and escalate significant risks and unresolved issues early
  • Develop a high-performing, service-oriented, control-conscious, and data-driven team by establishing clear priorities, accountability, development expectations, and succession considerations
  • Other duties as assigned
  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, finance, information systems, operations, or a related field Required
  • MBA or advanced degree Preferred
  • 7 years of progressive experience in procurement, procurement operations, Source-to-Pay, supply chain, shared services, business transformation, or related functions, including 3 years of people leadership Required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to set direction, establish governance, define decision rights, and convert strategy into sustainable operating capabilities
  • Deep understanding of Source-to-Pay processes, including requisitioning, approvals, purchasing, receiving, invoice dependencies, supplier enablement, catalogs, master data, and adoption
  • Ability to set priorities, establish controls, guide enhancements, and oversee operational performance through accountable functional leaders while maintaining focus on business outcomes
  • Strong command of spend analytics, KPI design, dashboarding, savings measurement, data quality, root-cause analysis, and executive reporting
  • Ability to oversee item master standards, inventory data integrity, replenishment insights, transaction controls, valuation considerations, cycle-count governance, and operational inventory risk
  • Ability to set enterprise training and adoption strategy, influence behavior through business leaders, and sustain standardized processes across varied stakeholder groups
  • Strong coaching, delegation, prioritization, performance management, workforce planning, and team-development capability
  • Ability to build trust and drive decisions across senior leaders, operational teams, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT, Procurement, and suppliers
  • Ability to identify control gaps, evaluate tradeoffs, design practical guardrails, and maintain audit-ready processes and documentation
  • Clear, concise, and credible written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex system, data, and process issues into business decisions
  • Structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize initiatives, manage change, measure benefits, and institutionalize improvements
  • Demonstrated experience providing business governance and strategic oversight for an enterprise procurement or S2P platform, with direct Coupa experience a plus
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary capabilities spanning procurement operations, analytics, master data governance, supplier enablement, training and adoption, process controls, and continuous improvement
  • Experience in distributed, multi-property, hospitality, retail, food service, or other operationally complex environments

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Ability to stand, type and sit at desk/computer for most of the work shift executing repetitive movements
  • No adverse or hazardous conditions
  • Not required, but preferred to be able to occasionally lift, push or pull 25 lbs. individually or with assistance
