Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As a Growth Marketer, you will join a prominent digital motorsport and sports media company operating a high-reach portfolio across digital publishing, podcasting, web, and video platforms. Reaching millions of global fans monthly, the business is poised to convert its vast organic audience engagement into owned community relationships and premium subscription revenue.

In this role, you will act as an autonomous growth operator partnering directly with executive leadership to identify funnel inefficiencies, run conversion experiments, scale newsletter acquisition, and drive paid subscription adoption. You will bring a rigorous experimentation mindset to optimize user journeys across multiple digital touchpoints, bridging the gap between high-volume audience reach and measurable member conversion.

This is a hands-on execution role requiring sharp analytical judgment, high-converting copywriting skills, and systems-level thinking. While your initial focus will center on organic channels and owned audience growth, you will also help lay the groundwork for paid acquisition channels as initiatives scale.

Accountability

As a Growth Marketer, your success will be defined by your ability to maximize conversion efficiency and subscription growth from the client’s existing audience ecosystem into owned subscribers and paying members.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Organic Audience Conversion & First-Party Data Capture

  • Identify and optimize conversion opportunities across high-traffic digital touchpoints, including podcasts, YouTube, websites, and newsletters.
  • Convert anonymous audience engagement into identified, owned first-party subscriber relationships.
  • Design and implement high-converting calls to action across platforms to accelerate newsletter sign-ups.
  • Partner with editorial, audio, and video production teams to seamlessly integrate conversion opportunities into recurring content.
  • Monitor organic channel conversion performance, identify underutilized traffic streams, and recommend actionable capture improvements.

Subscription & Paid Membership Growth

  • Drive conversion initiatives supporting the launch and scale of the premium paid membership platform.
  • Design and execute targeted campaigns to convert free newsletter subscribers into recurring paid members.
  • Support customer acquisition across free-trial funnels and evaluate introductory pricing structures.
  • Coordinate with the subscription content team to leverage premium editorial benefits in promotional messaging.
  • Systematically track free-to-paid conversion rates, trial conversion velocity, and subscriber retention signals.

Funnel Optimization, Experimentation & CRO

  • Map and evaluate end-to-end customer journeys across digital properties to identify drop-offs and funnel bottlenecks.
  • Diagnose conversion friction across acquisition, engagement, trial, and checkout stages.
  • Build, prioritize, and manage a structured A/B testing roadmap across landing page layouts, headlines, CTAs, and promotional offers.
  • Implement winning conversion experiments and maintain comprehensive documentation of testing outcomes.

Lifecycle & Newsletter Marketing

  • Manage newsletter subscriber acquisition, audience segmentation, and automated nurture sequences using modern email platforms like Beehiiv.
  • Write conversion-focused email messaging, test subject lines, and optimize promotional placements.
  • Identify high-value placements within regular newsletters to feature and cross-sell premium memberships.
  • Coordinate cross-channel subscriber journeys between newsletters, websites, and digital media assets.

Conversion Copywriting, Creative & AI-Assisted Operations

  • Write compelling, direct-response marketing copy, ad headlines, and action-oriented CTAs with a focus on conversion performance.
  • Collaborate with design and creative teams to produce high-impact promotional assets.
  • Leverage AI tools, including Claude, to accelerate copy ideation, generate testing variations, and optimize campaign workflows.
  • Evaluate creative asset effectiveness using performance data to continuously refine visual and narrative hooks.

Growth Analytics & Systems Reporting

  • Analyze cross-channel performance and conversion data utilizing customer data platforms and multi-channel dashboards such as PolyBox.
  • Maintain structured reporting on key growth metrics including subscriber growth, trial-to-paid rates, and funnel drop-offs.
  • Provide executive leadership with data-backed insights, testing outcomes, and prioritized operational recommendations.
  • Support future paid social marketing initiatives, targeting, and customer acquisition cost (CAC) analysis as advertising budgets expand.

Colleagues

You will report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, executing growth priorities and conversion initiatives under their strategic guidance. You will collaborate daily with cross-functional team members across editorial, video production, design, technical development, and paid subscription operations to ensure conversion strategies align seamlessly with content delivery. At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a Growth Marketer, your vertical strength will be conversion rate optimization and funnel experimentation, while your horizontal capabilities should span lifecycle email marketing, analytical reporting, and conversion copywriting.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Proven track record in growth marketing, marketing operations, or conversion rate optimization, with hands-on experience turning organic traffic into subscribers and paid customers.
  • Funnel & Testing Expertise: Practical experience diagnosing customer journey bottlenecks, designing structured A/B tests, and improving free-to-paid subscription funnels.
  • Copywriting Judgment: Strong direct-response copywriting skills with a deep understanding of what makes messaging, headlines, and calls to action convert.
  • Tools & Systems: Proficiency with email marketing platforms (preferably Beehiiv), spreadsheet modeling (Excel/Google Sheets), A/B testing software, and familiarity with modern Customer Data Platforms or BI analytics tools (such as PolyBox).
  • AI Fluency: Comfort utilizing advanced AI tools (such as Claude) to support copy generation, campaign acceleration, and workflow efficiency.
  • Channel & Paid Marketing Exposure: Solid foundational understanding of organic audience mechanics (podcasts, YouTube, digital publishing), with the ability to execute paid social acquisition campaigns as scope evolves.
  • Mindset & Execution: Strong independent execution capability, high accountability, analytical rigor, and comfort working in a founder-led environment.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Funnel Diagnosis & CRO: How do you identify drop-offs across a multi-channel user journey and design practical experiments to resolve them?
  • Conversion Copywriting: How do you approach crafting headlines and calls to action that drive measurable clicks and conversions?
  • Lifecycle & Newsletter Growth: How have you utilized newsletter platforms and audience segmentation to nurture subscribers into paying customers?
  • A/B Testing & Analytical Rigor: How do you structure testing roadmaps, evaluate statistical outcomes, and translate data into operational improvements?
  • AI-Assisted Growth Operations: How do you leverage AI tools to increase campaign velocity and optimize repetitive workflows?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

3M Health Care is now Solventum

As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of quality documentation systems that support our products, processes, and operations. Here, you will make an impact by:

High School Diploma/GED or higher education from an accredited institution

• Associate's degree or higher in Business, Quality, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline

• Experience working within a regulated environment such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, manufacturing, or quality systems

• Familiarity with ISO standards, FDA regulations, or other regulatory requirements

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

Les missions porteront sur une ou plusieurs des thématiques suivantes :

  • Mécanismes des marchés retail de l’électricité et du gaz (B2C/B2B) : typologies de contrats ; segmentation clients ; pricing et structures tarifaires ; taxes et coûts de transport et de distribution (TURPE, tarifs d’acheminement gaz…)
  • Mécanismes des marchés de gros de l’électricité et du gaz, et des services réseaux : formation des prix ; typologies de contrats ; mécanismes d’ajustement et équilibrage ; effacement…
  • Enjeux liés aux « nouveaux » vecteurs énergétiques : hydrogène ; biogaz ; captage et valorisation du CO2…
  • Gestion de la Relation Client et implémentation des systèmes d’information associés
  • Gestion du Meter to Cash dans le cadre d’activités de commercialisation électricité et/ou gaz
  • Gestion du Front to Back et des systèmes d’information associés dans le cadre de salles de marché Energie et matières premières.

En tant que consultant expérimenté et/ou senior, vous : 

  • Encadrez une équipe de consultants juniors
  • Participer à l’élaboration des propositions commerciales en y apportant votre savoir-faire et garantissez le bon déroulement des missions qui vous sont confiées.
  • De formation ingénieur ou école de commerce, vous possédez plus de 2 ans d’expérience en gestion et optimisation des processus opérationnels liés à la chaîne de valeur de l’Energie et des matières premières – acquises dans le cadre de cabinets de Conseil ou d’acteurs de marché. Cette expérience porte plus particulièrement sur la structuration des marchés français de l’électricité et du gaz
  • Vous disposez des connaissances réglementaires relatives aux « énergies vertes » ou encore aux normes d’efficacité énergétique
  • Vous maîtrisez l'anglais et possédez un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse ainsi que des capacités relationnelles et pédagogiques
  • Vous êtes mobile géographiquement

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Faire partie d'une équipe à taille humaine, soudée, constituée de consultants expérimentés, soudée, encourageant la diversité des profils et des expériences et favorisant l'initiative de chacun
  • Contribuer au développement de nos offres et leur mise en place
  • Participer à un projet entrepreneurial, s'intégrant dans une dynamique de forte croissance et de développement de notre marque de conseil.

A propos du groupe Inetum

Inetum est un leader européen des services numériques. Pour les entreprises, les acteurs publics et la société dans son ensemble, les 28 000 consultants et spécialistes du groupe visent chaque jour l'impact digital des solutions qui contribuent à la performance, à l'innovation et au bien commun.

Présent dans 19 pays au plus près des territoires, et avec ses grands partenaires éditeurs de logiciels, Inetum répond aux enjeux de la transformation digitale avec proximité et flexibilité.

Porté par son ambition de croissance et d'industrialisation, Inetum a généré en 2023 un chiffre d'affaires de 2,5 milliards d'€.

Répondre à un marché en croissance continue depuis plus de 30 ans, Inetum a fait le choix délibéré de se recentrer sur 4 métiers afin de gagner en puissance et proposer des solutions sur mesure, adaptées aux besoins spécifiques de ses clients le conseil (Inetum Consulting), la gestion des infrastructures et applications à façon (Inetum Technologies), l'implémentation de progiciels (Inetum Solutions) et sa propre activité d'éditeur de logiciels (Inetum Software).

Inetum a conclu des partenariats stratégiques avec 4 grands éditeurs mondiaux - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft et SAP et poursuit une stratégie d'acquisitions dédiée afin d'entrer dans le top 5 européen sur ces technologies et proposer la meilleure expertise à ses clients.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Inetum Consulting est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie et transformation. Avec un collectif de 400 consultants pluridisciplinaires, nous sommes présents en Europe (France, Espagne, Portugal, Belgique) et en Afrique (Maroc).
Inetum Consulting accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leurs projets stratégiques autour de quatre offres majeures : CIO Advisory, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.
Guidés par une approche de conseil sectorielle enrichie par l'innovation et les solutions technologiques, nous aidons nos clients à piloter leur transformation vers une performance durable et une société plus résiliente et responsable.
Nous valorisons une culture d'entreprise unique et forte, empreinte des valeurs d'excellence, qui contribue de manière significative à la réussite des organisations.
Dans le cadre du développement du secteur Energy, Utilities & Chemicals, nous recherchons à renforcer l’équipe.

raw.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Varian is seeking a Network Engineer position in support of our Managed Services global business. Our goal is to provide good operational practices and support for the operations, maintenance, and refinement of Varian’s public and private Cloud environments and services. Providing support for new and legacy applications and services hosted in the cloud, and continuous improvement of Varian’s Cloud infrastructure. The candidate will support Varian’s cloud operations to enhance, optimize, and maintain computing capabilities across our entire global cloud solution. Including collaboration with Service, Operations, Product Management and Security. The Network Engineer must have expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) & Microsoft Azure. Additional responsibilities for delivering support to the infrastructure and deployment of Varian’s applications as a Managed Service, and provide input in developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and standards. The position will receive direction from the Manager of Global Cloud Operations.

You are responsible for:

  • Providing network operations and support for Varian’s FullScale Infinity Cloud (FSIC) solutions. Private, public and hybrid infrastructure, network and security.
  • Leading network onboarding for FSIC designed product adhering to FSIC configuration standards.
  • Maintaining a strong knowledge of Varian’s suite of applications.
  • Configuring various cloud solutions including monitoring, application access, security, Citrix NetScaler, Citrix ADC, Palo Alto Networks, etc.
  • Configuring and supporting backbone connections over ExpressRoute (Azure), and direct connection and VPN architecture.
  • Maintaining allocation of IP CIDR block, perform maintenance involving modification of network, subnets, vlans, routes etc.
  • Verifying and action on events aggregated from network monitoring tools and Web Application Firewall using Varian approved tools.
  • Troubleshooting and determining root cause of issues.
  • Collaborating to quickly resolve any network related outages and resolve customer impacting issues quickly.
  • Contributing to the successful execution of projects.
  • Creating, updating, and completing documentation.
  • Investigate root cause analysis of incidents with follow up reporting and final content generation.
  • Collaborating with network engineers on procedures, techniques, tips & knowledge to improve operations, security and work performed.
  • Providing the highest level of customer service.
  • Advance understanding of vendor and telco/exchange/service providers support escalation paths and being able to escalate support requests to these vendors in a typically urgent and timely fashion.
  • Appling network system updates, patches, configuration changes.
  • Planning network layouts and configures systems to user environments.
  • Serving as a technical mentor to colleagues as necessary.
  • Staying up to date with assigned Learning Management System courses.
  • Eagerness to provide the highest level of customer service.
  • On call support as required.
  • Working schedule North American business hours.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s or preferably Master’s Degree in computer science is required plus three years’ minimum relevant experience.
  • Varian FSIC, TPASS and CloudPlanner infrastructure product knowledge.
  • Strong knowledge of Varian’s suite of applications.
  • Extensive experience supporting and managing networks in enterprise public, private, and hybrid cloud environments, preferably supporting large multi-subscription Microsoft Azure estates.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, VNet peering, user-defined routes (UDRs), network security groups (NSGs), network interfaces, NAT, DNS, and cross-subscription connectivity.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, ARP, addressing, subnetting, CIDR, DNS, LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, RPC, routing, and return-path validation.
  • Strong routing and switching expertise, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VLANs, STP, Layer 2/3 concepts, route propagation, path selection, redundancy, convergence, and failover.
  • Hands-on experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting Azure ExpressRoute connectivity, including BGP advertisements, learned routes, provider handoffs, scheduled maintenance, and customer/provider route exchange.
  • Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting site-to-site IPsec VPNs, including IKE/IPsec, tunnel interfaces, proxy IDs, BGP or static routing, and hybrid connectivity patterns.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls, including security policies, NAT and dynamic IP and port NAT, zones, interfaces, virtual routers, routing, VPN, URL filtering, logging, application connectivity, licensing, device certificates, and PAN-OS lifecycle management.
  • Experience using centralized next-hop routing through virtual firewalls to inspect ingress, egress, inter-VNet, and cross-subscription traffic.
  • Hands-on experience with Citrix NetScaler/ADC, including Gateway and load-balancing virtual servers, services and service groups, monitors, persistence, LDAP authentication, session, rewrite and responder policies, SSL profiles, certificates, and backend connectivity.
  • Experience validating end-to-end application delivery across client access, Citrix Gateway/ADC, firewalls, StoreFront or application services, and backend systems.
  • Strong network security knowledge, including firewall policy, IDS/IPS concepts, ACLs, PKI, SSL/TLS, certificate chains, cipher and protocol compatibility, URL filtering, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening.
  • Advanced network performance and root-cause analysis skills using packet captures and diagnostic tools such as Wireshark, firewall captures, tcpdump, iperf, or SolarWinds; ability to analyze retransmissions, duplicate ACKs, zero-window conditions, resets, packet loss, MTU/MSS, TLS negotiation, session aging, and application-response delays.
  • Experience troubleshooting business-critical and highly available applications, including cloud platform services, application integrations, SMB/application performance, syslog, telemetry, and monitoring paths.
  • Experience supporting network monitoring, observability, and SIEM integrations, including troubleshooting logging loops, missing telemetry, and connectivity to platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Experience implementing and troubleshooting Active Directory integrations and one-way domain trusts, including DNS, LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, RPC, domain-controller reachability, routing, and firewall requirements.
  • Experience working directly with customer IT teams, telecommunications carriers, exchange/service providers, and technology vendors to review requirements, coordinate changes, and resolve urgent connectivity issues.
  • Ability to develop customer-specific connectivity and ACL documentation covering source and destination networks, ports, protocols, NAT, routing, certificates, identity, and application use cases.
  • Experience creating and maintaining cloud and network architecture documentation, Microsoft Visio or Lucidchart diagrams, as-built documents, operating procedures, implementation notes, configuration templates, troubleshooting guides, upgrade-validation procedures, and change-validation or rollback steps.
  • Experience reviewing vulnerability findings, assessing operational impact, defining remediation and rollout plans, and validating network software upgrades, patches, content updates, configuration changes, and policy updates.
  • Strong incident, problem, and change management experience, including ticket handling, root-cause analysis, follow-up reporting, production troubleshooting, and customer-impacting outage resolution.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to customer, business, security, product, service, operations, and implementation stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a senior technical escalation resource, mentor colleagues, define technical approaches for complex changes, and provide implementation guidance across teams.
  • Ability to provide on-call support as required and work North American business hours.

Desired Experience

  • Varian FSIC, TPASS and CloudPlanner onboarding and infrastructure support knowledge.
  • Strong knowledge of Varian’s support and engineering processes.
  • Knowledge of the networking components of Varian applications, including ARIA and Eclipse.

raw.description:
As Blend’s Databricks Field CTO, you will help grow our Databricks business across North America, combining executive advisory, technical pre-sales, and architecture leadership. You will work with Blend Client Partners, Business Development leaders, and Databricks field teams to identify opportunities, shape engagements, and help clients translate their data and AI ambitions into production solutions.

You will serve as a senior technical authority for Databricks engagements, guiding platform decisions and helping delivery teams navigate complex architecture, integration, governance, and operational challenges. Internally, you will work with architects, data engineers, and AI practitioners globally to establish standards, strengthen technical capabilities, and develop reusable solutions and accelerators.

You bring deep technical credibility, commercial judgment, and enthusiasm for data and AI. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding with engineers, leading a client executive discussion, and working alongside delivery teams to resolve a difficult technical problem.

Responsibilities

Platform Architecture and Technical Pre-Sales

  • Partner with Blend’s Client Partners and Business Development leaders to shape Databricks opportunities, supporting discovery, proposals, architecture workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on labs.

  • Translate client priorities into solution architectures, delivery roadmaps, effort estimates, and clearly defined business outcomes.

  • Design architectures spanning lakehouse modernization, batch and streaming data engineering, analytics, machine learning, and generative and agentic AI.

  • Establish approaches for governance, security, data quality, interoperability, performance, and cost management.

  • Work directly with Databricks account teams, Solutions Architects, and specialists to develop joint solutions and support co-sell opportunities.

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Guide critical architecture decisions and validate proposed solutions against enterprise scale, reliability, security, and operational requirements.

  • Help teams resolve complex challenges across data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, integrations, governance, and production AI systems.

  • Maintain continuity from pre-sales through delivery, ensuring that scope, assumptions, architecture decisions, and success criteria are understood.

  • Provide hands-on support for strategic proofs of concept, reference implementations, architecture reviews, and delivery escalations.

  • Help clients move from experimentation to production with appropriate evaluation, monitoring, deployment, and support practices.

Practice Development and Databricks Community

  • Work across Blend’s global teams to establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, accelerators, and delivery guidance.

  • Mentor architects and engineers, support technical hiring, and help build a collaborative Databricks community within Blend.

  • Coordinate with Databricks counterparts on technical enablement, certifications, and emerging platform capabilities.

  • Turn successful engagements into repeatable offerings, demonstrations, case studies, and thought leadership.

Executive Engagement and Go-to-Market Alignment

  • Advise client CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, and business leaders on data and AI strategy, platform modernization, and adoption priorities.

  • Explain architectural tradeoffs in terms of business value, implementation effort, cost, risk, and time to value.

  • Partner with Blend’s practice and alliance leaders to align technical investments with client demand and joint Databricks opportunities.

  • Represent Blend in client workshops, partner discussions, and relevant industry events.

Required

  • 15+ years of experience in data, platform, or cloud architecture, including at least five years focused on Databricks, modern data platforms, or related solution engineering and technical pre-sales.

  • Deep hands-on Databricks experience, with a track record of designing and delivering enterprise production solutions.

  • Strong expertise in Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and batch and streaming architectures, with practical Python and SQL skills.

  • Experience with Databricks data engineering and orchestration capabilities, including Lakeflow, and the design of reliable, governed data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI and agentic solutions on Databricks, using capabilities such as Agent Bricks, Mosaic AI Model Serving, Vector Search, and Genie for document retrieval, conversational analytics, and business workflow automation.

  • Experience connecting agents to enterprise data, tools, and APIs through MCP and Unity Catalog functions, with appropriate identity, permissions, and governance.

  • Experience taking AI solutions into production, including MLflow evaluation and tracing, deployment through Databricks Apps or serving endpoints, and security, monitoring, and cost controls through Unity Catalog and Unity Gateway.

  • Strong cloud architecture experience on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, including identity, networking, storage, security, and deployment automation.

  • Experience leading data platform migrations or modernization programs, including architecture, workload transition, performance, and cost considerations.

  • Demonstrated success working alongside sales teams and engaging directly with senior client executives.

  • Experience collaborating with Databricks field teams on joint opportunities and technical solution development.

  • A background in consulting, professional services, or an embedded technology partner role.

Preferred

  • Relevant Databricks professional certifications, including data engineering, machine learning, or generative AI.

  • Experience with enterprise governance, data sharing, federation, and open table formats.

  • Familiarity with Databricks partner programs, Marketplace, and the development of repeatable industry solutions.

  • Experience establishing technical communities, mentoring senior practitioners, and developing reusable delivery assets.

Who You Are

You ask practical questions about value, scale, cost, security, and delivery before committing to an approach. You communicate clearly, hold informed views, and update them when better evidence emerges. You earn credibility through technical depth and collaborative problem-solving, helping clients and teams reach sound decisions and deliver working solutions.

The starting pay range for this role is $260k - $275k. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 offers a competitive benefits program designed to support the health and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Benefits vary by role and eligibility and may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, paid holidays, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts, life and disability insurance, and employee assistance programs.

Blend360 is a high-growth, AI-forward company at the forefront of data science, analytics, technology, and agentic AI solutions. We partner with leading enterprises to transform business performance by combining consulting expertise, world-class talent, and scalable technology solutions. Our mission is to fuel bold visions and deliver measurable transformation through the seamless alignment of human expertise and artificial intelligence.

Kaptio builds the operating platform for multi-day travel companies. Tour operators, rail, river and expedition cruise brands run their businesses on it. Built on Salesforce and our Edge Platform, Kaptio gives ambitious travel companies the tools to run and grow.

This is a customer-growth role focused on existing accounts. You’ll own the commercial relationship across a portfolio of Kaptio customers in North America: understand their business, help them get value from the platform, and turn that understanding into strong renewals and thoughtful expansion. You’ll work with customer leaders and bring the right Kaptio teams together around their priorities. Keep account plans clear, raise risks early and follow through on commitments.

What success looks like:
Customers understand the value they get from Kaptio and renew with confidence. Risks are surfaced early and owned through to resolution. Growth is tied to customer priorities. Account plans, pipeline and forecasts give the team a clear view of what’s happening.

What you’ll do

  • • Build trusted relationships from day-to-day users to senior decision-makers, and understand what matters to each customer.
    • Create account plans that connect customer priorities to adoption, retention and growth.
    • Lead renewals and commercial conversations, and identify expansion opportunities where Kaptio can create meaningful value.
    • Bring the right people across Kaptio together to resolve risks and deliver a joined-up customer experience.
    • Lead useful business reviews, maintain a reliable Salesforce pipeline and forecast, and share customer insight with Product and leadership.

What you’ll bring

  • • 5+ years in enterprise account management or customer-facing B2B SaaS sales.
    • Experience working with multi-day tour operators, either within the industry or as a provider to it.
    • A track record of retaining and growing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
    • Confidence leading commercial conversations with senior customer stakeholders.
    • Strong CRM habits and a structured approach to account planning and forecasting.
    • Ability to work well across distributed teams and North American and European time zones.

    Salesforce or travel-technology experience is a plus. Equivalent experience matters more than a particular degree.

raw.description:
Job Summary:

The Director of Marketing is responsible for leading and managing the overall marketing strategy, initiatives, and team to achieve the company's business objectives. They will create and execute a comprehensive marketing plan that includes product marketing, digital marketing, brand development, and public relations. The Director of Marketing will work closely with other teams such as sales, product development, and customer success to drive revenue growth and increase brand awareness.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing plan that aligns with the company's goals and objectives
  • Build and manage a team of marketing professionals to execute the marketing plan
  • Conduct market research to identify customer needs and preferences, and use that information to shape marketing initiatives
  • Develop and implement strategies for customer acquisition and retention
  • Oversee the development and execution of advertising and promotional campaigns across various channels
  • Develop and manage the marketing budget, ensuring that resources are allocated effectively
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure brand consistency across all channels and touchpoints
  • Develop and execute a content strategy that supports the marketing plan and engages customers
  • Monitor and analyze marketing performance data to measure success and make data-driven decisions
  • Maintain knowledge of industry trends and competition to inform marketing strategies

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, or related field; MBA preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role
  • Experience developing and executing successful marketing campaigns across various channels
  • Proven ability to lead and manage a team of marketing professionals
  • Strong understanding of market research, customer segmentation, and marketing analytics
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Experience in B2B marketing is a plus
  • Proficient in marketing automation, CRM, and analytics tools
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment
  • Working Conditions: Remote with highspeed internet

Location:

  • PH - Remote
  • Hours 6am to 3pm Pacific Time

raw.description:
Job Description:

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Solution Architect and Implementation Lead to spearhead enterprise-level SaaS deployments with a primary focus on the Qualtrics ecosystem. In this client-facing role, you will bridge technical execution and strategic consulting—translating complex business objectives into scalable, efficient data architectures and automated workflows. You will partner directly with enterprise clients in the public sector and cross-functional engineering teams to drive successful, end-to-end implementations that deliver long-term value.


Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 3 months (with potential to extend or go permanent)

Location: Remote (East Coast preferable but not required)


Core Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Understand a client’s business goals and translate them into scalable Qualtrics solutions.
  • Manages complex data integration, such as seamlessly connecting Qualtrics data with platforms like Salesforce to create a unified customer view.
  • Design survey architectures, data models, workflows, and integrations that align with client objectives.
  • Ensure solutions are efficient, maintainable, and follow best practices.

Technical Implementation

  • Lead enterprise-level implementations of SaaS platforms (e.g., Qualtrics).
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technology, people, and processes.
  • Configure the Qualtrics platform — surveys, dashboards, distributions, automations, and embedded data logic.
  • Build integrations between Qualtrics and other systems (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, Slack, CRM, HRIS tools, or data warehouses) via APIs and web services.
  • Write custom scripts (e.g., JavaScript for survey customization or Python for automation).

Client Consultation & Stakeholder Management

  • Work directly with clients to gather requirements and present technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and business analysts to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Educate clients on Qualtrics capabilities and best practices.
  • Drive strategic planning and execution across multiple projects.
  • Maintain rigorous attention to detail and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Manage competing priorities with precision and accountability.
  • Practice active listening and communicate with clarity and empathy.
  • Navigate difficult conversations with professionalism and confidence.
  • Maintain a positive tone and build trust with stakeholders.

Quality Assurance & Optimization

  • Test and validate survey logic, data flows, and integrations before go-live.
  • Troubleshoot complex platform issues and optimize performance.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance user experience or reporting accuracy.

Evaluate Feasibility

  • Assess whether proposed solutions fit within budget, time, and technical constraints.
  • Identify potential risks and recommend mitigations.

Enablement & Training

  • Train clients and internal teams on using Qualtrics effectively.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and configuration guides.

Customer Experience & Service Orientation

  • Champion the customer’s needs and advocate for their success.
  • Own the customer experience end-to-end, ensuring satisfaction and long-term value.
  • Demonstrate empathy, follow-through, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Take personal accountability for outcomes and team success.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in leading complex technical programs, ideally in a services company or SaaS environment.
  • BA / BS in in Experience Design, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience (preferred)

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Qualtrics CoreXM, CustomerXM, EmployeeXM, or BrandXM modules preferred
  • Experience with APIs, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and possibly SQL or Python
  • Setup automated workflows within Qualtrics to trigger aligned actions across the tech stack
  • Familiarity with data integrations (AEP, Salesforce), automation (event triggers), and analytics tools (like Tableau or Power BI)

Business & Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication — able to explain technical details to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking — aligning technology with business outcomes.
  • Project management and client relationship skills.
  • Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms in enterprise implementations.

The hourly pay range for this position is $88-$100. The hourly pay rate for the successful candidate is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Temporary employees are eligible for paid holidays in accordance with dentsu policy, as well as safe and sick time. This position is not eligible for any other benefits or other compensation.

Gigstreem, a leading Internet Service Provider based in the US, provides innovative technology solutions to residential (Single Family, MDU) and commercial (MTU) clients across various markets nationwide.

SUMMARY

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing maintenance and field service projects to ensure operational reliability and customer satisfaction. This role focuses on managing preventive and corrective maintenance initiatives, service upgrades, and field operations projects, delivering all work on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards. The Project Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle, including scope definition, resource planning, implementation, and post-project performance review. Reports directly to the Director of Field Services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  • Develop and manage project plans for maintenance and field service initiatives, including documenting requirements, setting objectives, and achieving milestones to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance schedules, ensuring minimal service disruption and compliance with operational standards.
  • Manage cross-functional stakeholders—such as engineering, procurement, and field technicians—through regular communication and project meetings to keep all parties informed and aligned.
  • Assign and delegate responsibilities to field teams; provide direction, motivation, and oversight to ensure efficient use of resources and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including progress reports, milestone tracking, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Evaluate existing maintenance processes and systems; identify opportunities for improvement and implement cost-saving measures without compromising quality.
  • Generate reporting and visibility for leadership to ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Travel occasionally to field sites to inspect work progress, resolve issues, and ensure adherence to project specifications.
  • Communicate directly with clients and property managers to provide updates on maintenance schedules, service interruptions, and project timelines.
  • Review financial data and prepare project budgets to optimize costs and maintain profitability.
  • Collaborate with HR and operations teams to develop and implement guidelines for technician training, performance evaluations, and resource allocation.
  • Achieve strategic goals and KPIs related to maintenance efficiency, service uptime, and customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee telecommunication construction projects, including fiber optic and structured cabling installations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and local regulations.
  • Coordinate permitting, utility locates, and right-of-way requirements for construction activities as necessary.
  • Monitor contractor performance and enforce quality assurance for construction deliverables.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Field Services and Vice President of Operations.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong understanding of maintenance operations, field service workflows, and customer experience principles.
  • Ability to identify and resolve project-impacting issues quickly and effectively.
  • Knowledge of technologies and materials used in telecommunications and field service environments.
  • In-depth knowledge of telecommunication construction practices, including fiber installation, splicing, trenching, and aerial plant work.
  • Familiarity with permitting processes, construction safety standards, and local/state regulations related to telecom infrastructure.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage teams and drive results in a dynamic environment.
  • Familiarity with budgeting, invoicing, purchase orders, and cost-control practices.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced setting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for interacting with all organizational levels.
  • Proficiency in CRM, ERP, and maintenance management systems.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite: Project, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

BENEFITS

  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement

Salary:$75,000-100,000

Location: Remote

raw.excerpt: About Code3Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike.
raw.description:
About Code3

Code3 is an integrated marketing agency, powering business growth for digital disruptors and Fortune 500 leaders alike. Our power is at the intersection of Connections, Creative and Commerce – that’s what is in our DNA. By harvesting insights and utilizing audience data, we work with our clients to develop scroll-stopping content and creative that performs and elevates the brands we work with across all digital media platforms.

Our people are energized by challenges and sprint to find unorthodox solutions. We plan, activate and measure as one team, and we’re not afraid to push boundaries and test our way to success. Coders are Relentless, Gritty, Nimble humans who are always striving to be better.

With teams across the U.S., you’ll find more than a job at Code3. You’ll find a place to grow, make an impact, and do your best work alongside a team that’s invested in your success.

Paid social has evolved far beyond media buying. Success today requires understanding consumer behavior, creative performance, platform innovation, and how culture influences the way people discover and buy products. Our team partners with clients to build full funnel strategies that connect all of those pieces — combining data, creativity, testing, and measurement to drive meaningful business results.

We believe the best ideas come from people who are endlessly curious, willing to challenge conventional thinking, and excited to experiment. We work collaboratively across media, creative, measurement, strategy, and platform partnerships to continuously push our clients and ourselves forward.

About The Role

The Paid Social Director is responsible for leading paid social strategy, client performance, and team development across a portfolio of eCommerce brands. This person brings deep expertise in performance marketing, a strong understanding of the eCommerce landscape, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into actionable strategies that drive measurable growth.

We're looking for a confident, proactive leader with strong opinions and the expertise to back them up. Someone who takes ownership, challenges conventional thinking, and isn't afraid to push clients and teams toward better solutions. They bring exceptional executive presence, inspire confidence in high-stakes conversations, and balance big-picture thinking with the technical depth to diagnose performance challenges and guide teams toward solutions.

Beyond client leadership, this role plays a critical part in elevating the quality of work across Code3's Paid Social practice. The Director will develop strong managers, establish clear standards for accountability and execution, and foster a culture of curiosity, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role requires someone who can lead with conviction, operate with urgency, and empower teams to consistently deliver exceptional work.

Note, hands on keys experience within social UIs is a requirement for this role.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead paid social strategy, performance, and client health across a portfolio of eCommerce brands, overseeing full funnel media planning, creative strategy, testing, measurement, and long-term account growth.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders, confidently leading executive-level conversations, navigating complex challenges, and delivering clear, data-backed recommendations that drive business outcomes.
  • Bring deep technical and strategic expertise to diagnose performance challenges, pressure-test account strategies, identify optimization opportunities, and guide teams toward stronger results across major paid social platforms.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing managers and teams, establishing clear expectations, driving accountability, addressing performance gaps, and fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous learning.
  • Establish and scale best practices across campaign execution, budget management, strategic planning, reporting, and client communication while proactively identifying risks and improving operational efficiency across teams.
  • Champion innovation, creative effectiveness, and thought leadership by translating emerging platform capabilities, consumer trends, and measurement advancements into actionable opportunities for clients and the broader agency.

Who will love this role:

  • A highly organized, action-oriented leader who thrives on ownership, brings structure to complexity, and holds themselves and others to high standards.
  • A bold, opinionated strategist who has strong, informed perspectives, challenges the status quo, and isn't afraid to push back when there's a better way forward.
  • An exceptional communicator who commands a room, builds credibility with senior stakeholders, and genuinely enjoys leading complex client conversations.
  • A people-first leader who is passionate about developing talent, building a high-performing team culture, and creating an environment of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • An endlessly curious eCommerce and paid social enthusiast who loves digging into performance, exploring emerging trends, and sharing knowledge to make the entire team stronger.

You should have:

  • 8+ years of paid social experience, including significant agency experience leading strategy and performance for eCommerce brands.
  • Extensive eCommerce expertise, with a proven track record driving profitable growth for DTC and retail brands, and a deep understanding of customer acquisition, ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion optimization, and full funnel measurement.
  • Advanced hands-on expertise across major paid social platforms, particularly Meta and TikTok, with strong working knowledge of Pinterest, Snapchat, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms.
  • Proven experience managing and developing teams, holding direct reports accountable, addressing performance challenges, and consistently elevating strategic and operational quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently audit accounts, diagnose performance trends, develop actionable optimization strategies, and connect media performance to broader eCommerce business outcomes.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and confidently navigating high-pressure situations.
  • Strong understanding of creative strategy, testing methodologies, attribution, incrementality, and performance measurement, with the ability to turn complex data into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables required); experience with eCommerce analytics and attribution platforms such as GA4, Northbeam, or Triple Whale is strongly preferred. Relevant platform certifications are a plus.

Position also offers a bonus based on company and client success.

The base salary range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for a bonus, with eligibility and details discussed during the recruitment process. For candidates that are based in California, we encourage you to review this important information for California residents here. For best results, open the link in a new tab.

Salary Range
$134,500—$160,000 USD

Working at Code3

At Code3, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to do their best. We’re proud to offer a competitive rewards package, meaningful opportunities for growth, and a culture that’s collaborative, inclusive, and—most importantly—human.

Here’s what you can expect as a Coder:

  • Remote-first workplace designed to support flexibility and connection
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus a generous retirement program
  • Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program
  • Flexible Time Off, sabbatical opportunities, paid holidays, quarterly Company “Recharge” Days, and a holiday closure in December
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities to help you grow your skills and career
  • A commitment to transparent DEIB practices and building a workplace where everyone can thrive

A Few Things to Know

All candidates who receive an offer will be required to successfully complete a background check.

Want to get to know us a little better? Check out Life at Code3 to learn more about our people, culture, and what it’s like to be a Coder.

Our Interview Process

During this first call, we’ll get to know you, learn more about your experience, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next opportunity. We’ll also explore alignment with our company and values, and depending on the role, we may ask a few technical or role-specific questions. From there, the process can look a little different depending on the role. You can expect to meet several members of the team and, for some positions, complete a skills assessment such as a Take-Home Assignment or Live Exercise. We’ll make sure you know what to expect every step of the way. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk you through the full process during your initial conversation.

Inclusive Workforce

At Code3, we’re committed to creating a culture where people from all backgrounds feel welcome, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We want every Coder to feel included and have the opportunity to contribute fully to our vision and goals. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic in the location where the candidate is applying.

If you have an accessibility need or would benefit from an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know at . We’re happy to work with you to make the process as comfortable and accessible as possible.

For more information about the data we collect and how we use it, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

We use AI technology to help streamline parts of our hiring workflow. People are at the heart of our hiring process, and all candidate decisions are made by our Talent Acquisition Team.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruitment firms.

Description

We are looking for a Customer Success Engineer to serve as a trusted technical partner for our customers throughout their post-sale journey. This role combines customer success, technical expertise, troubleshooting, and product enablement to help customers successfully adopt our solutions, overcome technical challenges, achieve business outcomes, and realize long-term value from our products and services.

As a Customer Success Engineer at Cyolo, you will play a key role in ensuring our customers successfully deploy, adopt, and maximize the value of our solutions.

You will work closely with Customer Success Managers and cross-functional teams to understand customer goals, technical environments, and challenges, while providing hands-on technical guidance throughout the customer lifecycle.

The role combines proactive customer engagement with deep technical problem-solving. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, help resolve complex technical issues, support implementations and integrations, and provide recommendations that drive adoption and long-term customer success.

Cyolo secures every connection across critical infrastructure and operational technology (OT) with a full-stack Secure Connectivity Platform that unifies remote privileged access and zero trust microsegmentation. Purpose-built for the world’s most critical operations, Cyolo makes secure connectivity surprisingly simple.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and primary post-sale technical contact for customers
  • Partner closely with Customer Success Managers to understand customer goals, success criteria, workflows, and technical environments
  • Guide customers through onboarding, implementation, integration, configuration, and product adoption activities
  • Provide proactive technical recommendations and best practices to increase product usage, value realization, and customer maturity
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues and coordinate with Support, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to drive timely resolution
  • Translate customer technical feedback and recurring issues into actionable insights for Product and Engineering teams
  • Create and maintain technical success plans, solution documentation, implementation notes, and customer-facing technical guidance
  • Support renewal and expansion efforts by demonstrating product value, resolving adoption barriers, and increasing customer confidence
  • Deliver technical training, workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations for customer stakeholders
  • Identify technical risks and adoption blockers and proactively work with customers to address them
  • Help customers optimize their use of Cyolo’s solutions and ensure they are achieving their desired business and security outcomes

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Technical Support, Support Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role
  • Strong understanding of on-premises platforms, cloud technologies, APIs, IAM, operating systems, networking, and third-party software integrations
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to analyze complex technical issues and drive them toward resolution
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and guide customers through practical next steps
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Customer Success teams
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer priorities, technical tasks, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting enterprise or strategic customers in a B2B technology environment
  • Familiarity with Linux and operating systems, security principles, identity management, databases, networking, observability, and cloud providers
  • Experience with cybersecurity products or working in a cybersecurity environment
  • Experience working with OT / IT environments or critical infrastructure
  • Experience with remote access, Zero Trust, or identity and access management solutions
  • Ability to identify adoption blockers, recommend solutions, and contribute to customer growth through technical discovery and value-based consultation
  • Experience working in a SaaS company or high-growth startup environment

Success Measures:

  • High customer satisfaction and strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders
  • Successful onboarding and implementation of customers
  • Increased product adoption, usage, and customer value realization
  • Reduced technical blockers and faster resolution of complex customer issues
  • Strong renewal support through successful adoption, risk mitigation, and demonstrated product value
  • Clear internal visibility into customer needs, technical risks, recurring issues, and product feedback
  • Effective collaboration across Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering teams

Marketing Coordinator (Part-Time)

Hours: 20–25 hours/week Department: Marketing Reports To: VP of Marketing

About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized Marketing Coordinator to manage project workflows for a fast-paced, high-volume marketing team. This role is the operational backbone of the team — keeping campaigns, content, and deliverables on track through Jira, while communicating clearly with stakeholders across the business. The ideal candidate combines strong project management instincts with genuine marketing fluency, so they can prioritize work intelligently rather than just track it.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage day-to-day project management in Jira for a busy marketing team, including ticket creation, workflows, boards, sprints, and backlog grooming
  • Build and maintain project schedules, timelines, and deadlines across multiple concurrent marketing initiatives
  • Serve as the point of contact for stakeholder communications — providing status updates, flagging risks, and keeping cross-functional partners aligned
  • Triage and prioritize incoming requests based on marketing goals and team capacity
  • Track deliverables from intake through completion, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
  • Partner with content, design, and campaign owners to understand task context well enough to manage it effectively
  • Identify and troubleshoot bottlenecks in workflows and recommend process improvements
  • Prepare and distribute a daily task roll-up, proactively flagging red flags, blockers, or at-risk deadlines
  • Co-run the weekly marketing team call alongside the VP of Marketing, helping set the agenda and drive follow-ups

Required Qualifications

  • Expert-level proficiency in Jira — comfortable configuring workflows, boards, automations, and reporting, not just entering tickets
  • Baseline marketing knowledge — able to understand the purpose and context of marketing tasks (campaigns, content cycles, creative requests, etc.)
  • Excellent schedule/timeline management skills
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills — clear, proactive, and professional across all levels
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications

  • Baseline experience in copy editing, copywriting, or design
  • Prior experience supporting a marketing team specifically (vs. general PM experience)

Details

  • Part-time, 20–25 hours per week
  • Remote

raw.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Head IS Enterprise Architecture

__



Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to define, operate, and continuously improve the enterprise architecture governance framework, standards, and compliance mechanisms. Each day you will ensure architectural consistency, risk reduction, and strategic alignment across ABB’s decentralized operating model, while enabling local autonomy and innovation. You will also act as the custodian of architectural decision making, standards, and guardrails. You will be balancing enterprise coherence with domain and product team agility, making sure that EA rules and practices are embedded into the organization’s operating model. This role has three/ four people reporting into it.

The work model for the role is: #Li_hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Architecture Governance
    • Governing and operating the enterprise architecture governance model, including decision rights, escalation paths, and review forums.
    • Ensuring architecture choices are transparent, traceable, and aligned with enterprise strategy.
    • Embedding governance into delivery processes (e.g., portfolio, product, and investment lifecycles).
    • Overseeing governance boards across the organization and making sure that relevant decentralized governance is in place.
  • Practice Development
    • Defining and maintaining EA practice standards, frameworks, and methodologies aligned with industry best practices (e.g., TOGAF) and organizational strategy.
    • Establishing governance processes for architecture reviews, compliance and selection.
    • Training and support for architects and business consumers.
  • Enablement & Community Building
    • Driving initiatives to strengthen the EA community through training, knowledge sharing, and collaboration platforms.
    • Promoting adoption of EA tools (e.g., Ardoq) and ensuring effective onboarding and usage across domains.
    • Acting as a champion for the EA repository and toolset and driving cultural change by fostering a “community-led architecture” mindset.
  • Standards & Reference Architecture
    • Owning and maintaining enterprise architecture standards and policies across business, data, application, technology, security, and integration domains.
  • Continuous Improvement
    • Measuring governance effectiveness using defined KPIs (e.g., reuse, compliance, time-to-decision), continuously improving standards, governance processes, and tooling and staying current with industry best practices and evolving architectural trends.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, or related field
  • 8+ years in Enterprise Architecture or related roles, with at least 3 years in practice enablement or governance
  • Proven experience in implementing EA frameworks, tools, and governance processes in a global organization
  • Experience in decentralized, multi-domain, or federated operating models
  • Strong understanding of EA domains (business, application, data, technology)
  • Familiarity with architecture modeling tools (e.g., Ardoq, ArchiMate)
  • TOGAF or equivalent EA framework certification preferred
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong governance, risk, and standards management capability


This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Merkle is seeking an Analytics Consultant to work hands-on in Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, combining in-depth knowledge of quantitative marketing analytics with a strong grasp of customer data to answer real business questions for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative data using software and manual manipulation
    techniques. Interpret and present results to staff and stakeholders using graphs, charts, or
    visualization mapping.
  • Extract and shape data from internal and external sources on a routine and ad hoc
    basis to develop and deliver usable reports and presentations.
  • Understand how to make data visually appealing and simple to both navigate and comprehend for end-users
  • Aggregate data from various sources to construct streamlined data pipelines and integrate data from multiple systems
  • Build and maintain Customer Journey Analytics data views, segments, calculated metrics, and Workspace projects that let clients analyze behavior across channels
  • Identify key metrics and build exec-facing dashboards to track progress of the business and its highest priority initiatives
  • Identify key business levers, establish cause and effect, perform analyses, and communicate key findings to various stakeholders to facilitate data-driven decision-making
  • Own the quality of your deliverables end to end: validate the data, sanity-check the numbers, and QA the output before it reaches clients
  • Stay current on industry trends and emerging analytics technology
  • Proactively identify opportunities to introduce and improve Merkle's analytical tools, techniques, and processes
  • Package selected interim and final deliverables for later re-use by other Merkle teams, including rationale for why options/tactics were chosen (i.e., provides metadata for the documents)

Key Skills and Experience

  • Able to move past observations to data-backed insights and recommendations. Also able to reach a defensible answer independently, without relying on AI to do the analytical thinking
  • Be able to contribute to innovation, process improvement, and standardization
  • Deliver high-quality analytical solutions on time
  • Maintain a project plan; manage day-to-day tasks; and meet project deadlines
  • Work effectively across teams to ensure client satisfaction
  • Presentation skills, whether in front of small groups or large audiences, on camera and/or occasionally in person
  • Comfortable using AI tools and adapting to new tech for the job role as it hits the market
  • Familiar with how to debug a webpage to identify data being passed into web analytics tools

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a US citizen and be prepared to pass a US Government background check, including physical fingerprinting at a US Passport office
  • Bachelor's degree (B.S. or B.A.) or equivalent experience in statistics, analytics, economics, or a related quantitative field
  • Hands-on experience with BI and digital analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI)
  • 2+years of experience in quantitative analysis, ideally in a marketing or agency context
  • Adobe Certified Professional – Adobe Customer Journey Analytics Business Practitioner (exam AD0-E608) or higher, and/or 1+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience with Adobe CJA
  • Advanced Excel and strong PowerPoint skills: able to build a clean analysis and turn it into a client-ready deck

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years using Adobe Analytics to build Workspace projects, segments, and calculated metrics, and to surface insights from them
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform data collection or schema design
  • Agency or consulting experience working across multiple concurrent clients

Ideal Candidate:

  • You have a curious nature and are willing to provide tough recommendations to clients, tactfully, when necessary
  • Your ability to discover hidden insights to unstructured business problems makes you an integral part of our growing analytics team
  • You can independently execute analytical work end to end by producing outputs that earn rave reviews and drive ROI for our clients
  • You have a keen eye for detail and use it to produce consistent, high-quality work that will build trust with clients

  • Strong organizational skills

Physical: Computer keyboarding

Auditory/visual: Hearing, vision and talking

About the role

The Electronics Engineer - AI Trainer will help train and evaluate frontier AI models on realistic circuit- and system-level engineering problems. This contract role requires at least 3 years of electronics engineering or circuit design experience, strong expertise in circuit analysis and engineering tools, excellent written communication, and the ability to assess technical reasoning against professional standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design challenging, realistic electronics engineering problems based on practical experience, including circuit specification, signal-chain debugging, analog circuit analysis, and power-stage sizing.
  • Author professional supporting files for assignments, including schematics, simulation setups, datasheets, measurement data, and design calculations.
  • Run engineering problems through frontier AI models and evaluate the outputs against professional engineering standards.
  • Compare model versions using identical prompts, determine which model performs better, and document the strengths and limitations of each version.
  • Critique model-generated derivations, component selections, topologies, and calculations with detailed written rationale.
  • Identify and document concrete technical failures, including incorrect assumptions, sign and unit errors, unphysical results, invalid topologies, fabricated datasheet values, and misread plots.
  • Apply domain expertise across analog circuits, electronic devices and materials, RF, photonics, and signal processing.
  • Use engineering judgment to distinguish technically sound reasoning from plausible but incorrect AI-generated answers.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of industry experience in electronics engineering, circuit design, or related fields.
  • Current or recent experience performing technical work as an individual contributor.
  • In-progress Bachelor's degree or higher in electronics engineering, electrical engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Strong command of circuit analysis, electronic devices, and design tradeoffs, with the ability to defend component-level decisions.
  • Fluency with simulation and engineering tools, including SPICE, schematic capture, PCB tools, lab instruments, MATLAB, and Python.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to explain precisely why a technical answer is incorrect.
  • Professional or native-level English.
  • General familiarity with AI and LLM tools, or the ability to learn them quickly.
  • Location in the United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Ireland, or New Zealand.
  • Availability for at least 10 hours per week.

Benefits and Perks

  • Ultimate Flexibility: Fully remote, project-based contract work with the ability to choose projects and work times.
  • Competitive Pay: Compensation of $40–$120 USD per hour, with bonus rates available on some projects.
  • No Overhead: Access to Claude and ChatGPT is provided, with no personal subscriptions required.
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible multi-day task timers, no shift work, and no weekly maximum after the 10-hour minimum.

  • Circuit analysis

  • Photonics
  • Signal processing
