Why Choose Kindbridge:

Develop a Specialized Clinical Skill Set — Gain hands-on experience treating gambling, gaming, and other behavioral addictions while building expertise in one of behavioral health's fastest-growing specialties

Receive Clinical Training & Mentorship — We provide ongoing education, clinical consultation, and support pursuing the International Certified Gambling Counselor (ICGC-I) credential through mentorship from a nationally recognized, Ph.D.-trained, ICGC-II-certified gambling addiction clinician

Join an Accredited Behavioral Health Organization — Work with a Joint Commission-accredited organization committed to the highest standards of quality, safety and patient care

Focus on Clinical Work — We handle credentialing, billing, insurance claims, collections, and other administrative tasks so you can focus on providing care

Build a Flexible Remote Practice — Set your own schedule and maintain a caseload that aligns with your availability and professional goals

Work Alongside Experts in the Field — Join a collaborative team of clinicians who are passionate about advancing care for individuals and families seeking support for compulsive or overuse behaviors, or emotional dysregulation struggles through compassionate, evidence-based treatment

What We Provide:

  • ICGC-I certification support
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Clinical consultation and peer support
  • Insurance credentialing support
  • Assistance with and funding for additional state licensure
  • Administrative and billing support
  • Flexible scheduling and remote work
  • W-2 employment
  • 401(k) with employer match

Who We're Looking For:

  • Active clinical licensure in the state of North Dakota: LPC, LPCC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent license
  • Interest in gambling disorder, gaming disorder, and other behavioral challenges
  • Desire to pursue ICGC-I certification with company support
  • Commitment to evidence-based, client-centered care
  • Interest in collaborating with a team that’s driving innovation in teletherapy
  • Spanish fluency is a plus

Join Our Mission:

At Kindbridge, you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise into a highly specialized area of behavioral health while helping individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related behavioral challenges.

If you're looking for meaningful clinical work, ongoing mentorship, and the opportunity to become a leader in an emerging field, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Overview

Your AI strategy is only as strong as the data behind it. Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies, including 90% of the Fortune 500, trust Quest to solve their most critical challenges.

As a Customer Success Manager at Quest, you will help customers achieve value from their investment in our solutions. You will manage a portfolio of accounts, driving adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will work closely with customers throughout their lifecycle, helping them achieve business outcomes while identifying opportunities for growth and expansion.

Responsibilities

  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as their primary point of contact for success and adoption initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain Success Plans aligned to customer goals, business outcomes, and value milestones.
  • Drive product adoption and value realization through proactive engagement and regular business reviews.
  • Monitor customer health, identify risks and opportunities, and coordinate internal resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Renewals, Support, Product, and Professional Services teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Support retention and renewal efforts while helping identify opportunities for cross-sell and upsell conversations.
  • Advocate for customer needs and provide feedback to internal teams to improve customer experience and business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Sales Engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Experience managing enterprise customers in software, SaaS, cybersecurity, data management, or related technology environments.
  • Ability to build relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, including executive-level contacts.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value.
  • Experience developing customer success plans and driving adoption, retention, and customer satisfaction.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience managing customer escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting digital transformation or migration initiatives, including transitions from on-premises to SaaS solutions.
  • Customer Success experience within a B2B software organization.
  • Familiarity with customer success platforms such as Gainsight or Totango and CRM tools such as Salesforce.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve productivity and customer engagement.

At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a truly global team of high-performing, passionate innovators.

Join us today: Careers | Quest

Quest is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:

Quest is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Quest are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, national, social, or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Quest will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Quest encourages applicants of all ages.

Come join us. For more information, visit us on the web at Quest Careers. Innovate. Collaborate. Grow.

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on quest.com/careers using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps like Telegram to communicate with applicants, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way and only interact with people claiming to be Quest employees if they have an email address ending in @quest.com.

raw.description:
About NFF

Since 1996, Networking For Future, Inc. (NFF) has been engineering the backbone of mission-critical systems for government and enterprise clients. With headquarters in Washington, DC, we provide expert technology consulting and design-build solutions that solve complex challenges and deliver measurable real-world results.

Our expertise includes solutions for Artificial Intelligence Enablement, Data Center & Cloud, Intelligent Networks, Secure, Connected IoT Technologies, Professional and Managed Services, Workforce Solutions and Zero Trust Strategies. NFF leverages a strategic portfolio of over 200 industry-leading technology brands to deliver precisely tailored solutions that align with each client’s unique requirements and mission objectives.

We are an accomplished technology consulting firm with a proven track record of delivering innovative, high-performance IT solutions to clients across government and commercial sectors. What sets us apart is our foundation as a hands-on, technically driven organization backed by deep industry partnerships and a broad portfolio of certifications – at both the company and individual levels. This combination of experience and credibility allows us to respond with confidence and precision to complex technical challenges.

Our greatest strength is our people. We are seasoned technologists who embrace a culture of innovation and continuous learning. We believe that meaningful solutions are built through collaboration, and we view every challenge as an opportunity to evolve – transforming problems into partnerships that deliver long-term value. This mindset shapes how we work: we hire top talent, provide them with the resources and mentorship they need to thrive, and recognize and reward excellence at every level. Our teams are empowered to lead with insight, deliver exceptional service, and build trusted relationships with every client.

NFF is an ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 9001:2015 certified company. Additionally, NFF is a Cisco Preferred Partner with numerous Specializations including Customer Experience, Advanced Security Architecture, IOT and others. NFF was a “Cisco Top-5 Mid-Atlantic SLED Partner” in 2019, 2020, 2022-2026 In addition to Cisco, NFF has key partnerships with many manufacturers and IT solution providers including, Palo Alto, Arista, Rapid7, Arctic Wolf, NetApp and others.

About this Position / Responsibilities

NFF Inc. is seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and Microsoft Azure cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting scalable, secure, and highly available enterprise applications.

The role involves working on real-time data processing, system integrations, cloud-native applications, and transit-related systems. Basic understanding of OpenTripPlanner (OTP), General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS), and GTFS-Realtime would be a great plus but not required.

Required Technical Skills

  • Java and Backend Development
    • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java.
    • Extensive experience with Java 11/17/21, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and RESTful API development.
    • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous processing.
    • Experience developing microservices and integrating distributed enterprise applications.
    • Experience with JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, and third-party API integrations.
    • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
    • Experience troubleshooting application performance, memory utilization, and production issues.
  • Microsoft Azure Cloud Technologies
    • Hands-on experience developing, deploying, and supporting applications hosted in Microsoft Azure.
    • Experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Container Registry.
    • Knowledge of Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, private endpoints, DNS, and application connectivity.
    • Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, and Azure Key Vault.
    • Familiarity with Azure Front Door, API Management, and Microsoft Entra ID authentication.
    • Experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics for application monitoring and troubleshooting.
    • Understanding of cloud security, scalability, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
  • DevOps and CI/CD
    • Experience with Git and GitHub for source code management, branching, pull requests, and release management.
    • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
    • Experience with Maven or Gradle for build automation and dependency management.
    • Knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployments.
    • Experience implementing automated testing, code quality checks, and deployment validation.
    • Familiarity with production releases, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting deployment failures.
  • Desired but optional: OpenTripPlanner (OTP) and GTFS – Basic Knowledge
    • Basic understanding of OpenTripPlanner (OTP) and its use in multimodal transit journey planning.
    • Familiarity with GTFS Static data structures, including routes, trips, stops, stop times, calendars, and schedules.
    • Basic understanding of GTFS-Realtime feeds, including Trip Updates, Vehicle Positions, and Service Alerts.
    • Understanding of how static schedules and real-time transit data are integrated into journey planning and passenger information systems.
    • Ability to troubleshoot basic GTFS data inconsistencies, feed integration issues, and API responses.
    • Willingness to develop deeper knowledge of transit scheduling, prediction systems, and real-time passenger information technologies.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Azure technologies.
    • Develop and support RESTful APIs, microservices, and integrations with internal and external systems.
    • Build and maintain cloud-native applications with an emphasis on reliability, security, performance, and scalability.
    • Support application deployments, production troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization.
    • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release management processes.
    • Integrate and process real-time data from APIs, messaging systems, and external data feeds.
    • Collaborate with business analysts, infrastructure teams, architects, and other developers to deliver technical solutions.
    • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical documentation, and development best practices.
    • Support transit-related applications, including OTP, GTFS data integration, and passenger information systems.

    Qualifications

    Required Qualifications

    • 7+ years of professional experience in software development.
    • 5+ years of experience developing in Java (11/17/21).
    • 5+ years of experience with Spring Boot and the Spring Framework.
    • 5+ years of experience developing RESTful APIs, microservices, and integrating distributed enterprise applications.
    • 5+ years of experience with object-oriented design, design patterns, multithreading, concurrency, and asynchronous processing.
    • 5+ years of experience with JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, and third-party API integrations.
    • 5+ years of experience with SQL and relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
    • 5+ years of experience troubleshooting application performance, memory utilization, and production issues.
    • 5+ years of experience with Git and GitHub, including branching strategies, pull requests, and release management.
    • 3+ years of experience developing, deploying, and supporting applications hosted in Microsoft Azure.
    • 3+ years of experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Container Registry.
    • 3+ years of experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
    • 3+ years of experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
    • 3+ years of experience with Maven or Gradle and Docker containerized deployments.
    • Required: Industry certifications in Azure, Java, or related cloud technologies.

    Desired Qualifications

    • 3+ years of experience supporting transit, transportation, public sector, or government organizations.
    • 2+ years of experience with Azure networking and platform services, including Virtual Networks, private endpoints, DNS, Front Door, API Management, and Entra ID.
    • 3+ years of experience with cloud security, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
    • Basic knowledge of OpenTripPlanner (OTP), GTFS, and GTFS-Realtime.

    NFF Disclosures

    NFF offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits and flexible paid time off options, for eligible employees:

    • Medical, Dental and Vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account
    • STD, LTD, Supplemental life insurance and ADD&D
    • Comprehensive 401k plan
    • Paid Time Off

    NFF is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

    Important Notice: All NFF Inc communications come from @nffinc.com. Emails from other domains claiming to be NFF are likely scams. Be cautious, verify senders, and report suspicious messages immediately.

raw.title: Clinical Database Programmer
raw.excerpt: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases.
raw.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials.

Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test and maintain clinical study databases within EDC systems.

  • Develop and configure eCRFs, edit checks and study-specific database requirements.

  • Support clinical data transfers, integrations and database validation activities.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and provide ongoing EDC study support.

  • Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery.

  • Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI.

  • Support multiple clinical studies and progressively take ownership of study builds.

  • Ensure database documentation, quality standards and study timelines are maintained.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Previous experience in clinical database development, EDC programming or clinical study builds.

  • Previous experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

  • Knowledge of eCRFs, edit checks, database testing and clinical data management processes.

  • Understanding of programming principles, logic and database development.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

  • Experience supporting EDC integrations, technical initiatives or bid defence activities.

  • Proactive team player with excellent communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave, including study builds and configuration.

  • Knowledge of C# programming and development of custom functions within Medidata Rave.

  • Experience with AI tools, automation or AI-assisted programming to improve study development and efficiency.

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

    • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
    • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
    • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
    • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
    • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
    • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
    • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
    • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

      • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
    Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to .
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

raw.title: Senior ABM Manager
raw.excerpt: Chainguard is the trusted source for open source.
raw.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We are hiring a full-stack, technical Sr. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to own our ABM program end-to-end. You'll start with bespoke 1:1 and 1:few programs against our most strategic enterprise and regulated accounts, then build the operating model and automation to extend what works to 1:many.

This is a builder role, not a project manager role. You'll launch your own ads, build your own pages and workflows, and pull your own data. You reach for an agent or automation before doing anything by hand, and you're a real partner to Sales, with the presence to shape account plans and the discipline to report on shared numbers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the ABM program. Set strategy and run execution for Chainguard's top enterprise and regulated accounts across the full lifecycle: new business, deal acceleration, and expansion. Design and launch 1:1 and 1:few campaigns yourself across paid digital, web, email, gifting, and executive events, with messaging built for CISOs, security engineering, and platform leaders.
  • Build the operating model. Define the playbooks, target account lists, tooling, and measurement framework for how ABM runs here, so programs stay repeatable and high quality as we scale from a handful of accounts to 1:many.
  • Operationalize AI for ABM. Build agents and workflows in Clay, HubSpot, Hightouch, and custom internal apps to research accounts, capture signals, personalize outreach, and orchestrate multi-channel plays. Experiment, productionize what works, and document it.
  • Partner with Sales, BDR, and Partners, and measure what matters. Develop joint account plans with Sales, sales leadership, the BDR team, and the Partner team, ensure coordinated follow-up on every program, and drive rep enablement. Define KPIs for pipeline, penetration, engagement, and acceleration, and report impact with Marketing Ops in Omni and BigQuery.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with 2+ years running ABM programs at a SaaS, security, or infrastructure company, and cross-channel campaigns you shipped end to end that produced pipeline.
  • Full-stack execution across paid media, web, email, and marketing automation, without waiting on a large supporting team. Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (or equivalents), familiarity with intent and comfort writing SQL against BigQuery to answer your own questions.
  • An AI builder's mindset: you've applied agents, LLM APIs, or advanced automation to real marketing problems and treat AI as the default way to scale.
  • Creative in the 1:1 tier, disciplined enough to run many programs at once, and credible with technical and security buyers and sales leadership alike.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience marketing into regulated industries or the public sector (FedRAMP, financial services, healthcare)
  • Familiarity with the cloud-native and open source ecosystem (Kubernetes, containers, software supply chain security)
  • Experience building and managing CDP-driven audience pipelines, including audience syncs, match rate optimization and suppression workflows.

We know not everyone will check every box on day one. If this role excites you and you've done most of this, we'd like to hear from you.

Base Salary Range
$140,000—$167,500 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Senior Technical Implementation Manager
raw.excerpt: Are you ready to trade your job for a journey?  Become a FlyMate!
raw.description:
Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!


Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.


What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!


Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.


Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.


With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.


The Opportunity

Flywire is seeking a Senior Technical Implementation Manager to join our high-growth B2B vertical. In this role, you'll serve as the strategic and technical lead on complex client implementations, driving measurable outcomes and owning end-to-end project success from kickoff through go-live. You'll partner with clients, engineering, and product teams to deliver transformative implementations while building deep relationships that drive long-term value.

This is an ideal role for someone who is passionate about payments, technology, and client success and who thrives as the single point of accountability for some of Flywire's most important B2B accounts. You'll take ownership of project outcomes, proactively manage risk, and drive continuous improvement across our implementation processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own project success: Drive the end-to-end implementation lifecycle, establishing clear milestones and managing scope, while delivering results on time and within budget. You are accountable for client satisfaction and go-live outcomes.
  • Strategic client partnership: Serve as the primary technical and strategic advisor to client leadership, translating business requirements into implementation roadmaps and identifying expansion opportunities.
  • Technical leadership: Configure and test the Flywire platform for complex invoicing, payment, and reconciliation workflows. Lead integrations with ERP/CRM systems (NetSuite, Intacct, Salesforce, QuickBooks, and custom platforms).
  • Project & change management: Manage multi-phase implementations with competing priorities. Guide clients through organizational change, adoption planning, and success metrics definition.
  • Data architecture & integration: Map data flows across systems, design validation protocols, troubleshoot file formatting/syncing/tokenization issues, and oversee payment routing configurations.
  • AI-powered efficiency: Build and manage custom AI agents to automate repetitive tasks (data validation, documentation generation, process automation), improving delivery speed and quality.
  • Technical problem-solving: Partner with engineering to scope customizations, troubleshoot blockers, and drive solutions for complex integration challenges.
  • Client enablement: Design and deliver training programs, documentation, and sandbox testing protocols that ensure clients are fully equipped at go-live.
  • Process improvement: Identify opportunities to improve tooling, documentation, and delivery methodology. Lead internal initiatives that scale our implementation capability.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work seamlessly with sales, client success, solutions, and engineering to ensure alignment and continuity throughout the client lifecycle.

Here's What We're Looking For

  • BA/BS degree
  • 5+ years of proven experience in:
    • Payments implementation, financial technology, or SaaS-based software implementations
  • Technical project management or change management (required)
  • ERP implementations (NetSuite preferred; Intacct, SAP, Workday, and/or F&O experience are also welcome) and technical configuration
  • Strong technical acumen:
    • APIs, SFTP, webhooks, JSON, and SQL
    • ERP systems (NetSuite, Intacct) and CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot)
  • Payment gateways and tokenization concepts
  • Comfortable learning new technical tools and systems quickly
  • AI & automation skills:
    • Experience building or managing AI agents, automation workflows, or scripting solutions
    • Comfortable iterating with AI tools to solve implementation challenges
  • Project management excellence:
    • Proven ability to manage multi-phase implementations with competing priorities
    • Strong risk management and stakeholder communication skills
    • Experience with SDLC methodologies and implementation frameworks
  • Client-facing leadership:
    • Comfortable presenting to C-suite and senior stakeholders
    • Excellent written and verbal communication
    • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes
  • Ownership mindset:
    • Demonstrated accountability for project outcomes and client success
    • Proactive problem-solver who takes initiative beyond assigned scope
    • Track record of driving continuous improvement and process optimization


What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Competitive time off
  • Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
  • Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
  • Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
  • Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)

Submit today and get started!


We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.


Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.


The base salary for this position is:

$105,071-$150,101

Our salary ranges are determined by role, position level, and location. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and several other factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education and training.

Job Summary:

The Market Quality Improvement Specialist II collaborates with department manager and other leadership to evaluate opportunity for HEDIS data and process improvement in new or existing projects with focus on measurable benefits.

Essential Functions:

  • Conducts business process and gap analysis to diagnose process improvement opportunities and to develop re-usable solutions using principles of process excellence and related tools
  • Directly responsible for improvement work teams, to include: working with management to identify the appropriate team members, coordination and facilitation of team meetings and management of improvement work team projects
  • Collaborates with management team to support necessary documentation of QIPs and PIPs and other quality activities
  • Trains, educates and deploys improvement tools, methods and processes throughout the departments assigned
  • Analyzes work processes using improvement tools and methodology to identify improvement opportunities
  • Works with management and the improvement team to establish and implement effective measurement and data collection methods
  • Reviews and measures progress with management and work team and takes appropriate action

Spreetail propels brands to increase their ecommerce market share across the globe while improving their operational costs. Learn how we are building one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies in history: www.spreetail.com.

Work Your Way:

At Spreetail, we believe in empowering our employees to work in the way that suits them best through our Work Your Way approach. Each team member has the flexibility to choose where they work most effectively each week—whether that's from home, a coffee shop, or the office. While flexibility is key, we also value the power of in-person connection. That’s why we bring our corporate team together in Lincoln each quarter for a week of intentional collaboration, team building, community engagement, and our All-Hands meeting. It’s the best of both worlds: the freedom to work your way, with meaningful opportunities to connect and grow together. Please scroll to the bottom of the job posting to confirm that your state qualifies for the Work Your Way program.

Spreetail is looking for a Director of Procurement, you will serve as the single accountable leader for ~$29M in annual addressable spend across our 8 fulfillment center locations. In this role, you will lead end-to-end operational sourcing strategies—including packaging, pallets, corrugate, business services, and facility supplies—while driving commercial negotiations, cost-saving initiatives, and vendor accountability.

You will lead the on-site non-inventory hourly teams responsible for staging and replenishment, design robust inventory controls, and build cross-functional alignment across Finance, Operations, and carriers.

How you will achieve success:

  • Network Spend Ownership: Serve as the single accountable owner of ~$29M/year in addressable spend across all 8 FC buildings (~$10M pallets and corrugate, ~$17M business services, ~$2M supplies).

  • Strategic RFP Execution: Lead the Q1 2027 pallet RFP across primary partners (KAMPS, 48forty, and emerging alternatives) to secure pallets and corrugate at the lowest total net cost.

  • Carrier S&OP & Credit Recovery: Establish S&OP-driven pallet demand forecasts and operationalize pallet return, regrade, and credit recovery programs with major carrier partners (FedEx, Roadie).

  • On-Site Team Leadership & Kanban Design: Directly lead on-site non-inventory hourly associates across the network who receive, stage, and replenish materials; design and implement lean kanban staging to eliminate fulfillment downtime.

  • Vendor Consolidation & Services Procurement: Negotiate master service agreements, consolidate redundant vendors, enforce rigorous SLA performance across ~$17M in business services, and streamline standard operating ordering flows for facility supplies and maintenance buys.

  • Systems, Approvals & Governance: Own procurement systems and operational controls (vendor onboarding, invoice reconciliation, and approval routing workflows), delivering monthly savings scorecard KPIs to executive leadership.

What experiences will help you in this role:

  • Network Spend Ownership: Serve as the single accountable owner of ~$29M/year in addressable spend across all 8 FC buildings (~$10M pallets and corrugate, ~$17M business services, ~$2M supplies).

  • Strategic RFP Execution: Lead the Q1 2027 pallet RFP across primary partners (KAMPS, 48forty, and emerging alternatives) to secure pallets and corrugate at the lowest total net cost.

  • Carrier S&OP & Credit Recovery: Establish S&OP-driven pallet demand forecasts and operationalize pallet return, regrade, and credit recovery programs with major carrier partners (FedEx, Roadie).

  • On-Site Team Leadership & Kanban Design: Directly lead on-site non-inventory hourly associates across the network who receive, stage, and replenish materials; design and implement lean kanban staging to eliminate fulfillment downtime.

  • Vendor Consolidation & Services Procurement: Negotiate master service agreements, consolidate redundant vendors, enforce rigorous SLA performance across ~$17M in business services, and streamline standard operating ordering flows for facility supplies and maintenance buys.

  • Systems, Approvals & Governance: Own procurement systems and operational controls (vendor onboarding, invoice reconciliation, and approval routing workflows), delivering monthly savings scorecard KPIs to executive leadership

In an effort to Make Spreetail Better, we hire people that are aligned with our values and are passionate about pursuing ecommerce excellence. We believe the right person can learn what is needed to succeed in their role, so we encourage job applicants to apply even if you don't meet all the qualifications listed. We are looking for diverse backgrounds and perspectives, so we don’t require college degrees and welcome non-linear career paths. If this role highlights your experience and gets you excited – please apply!
What you can expect from us:
• We provide the flexibility to take care of yourself. Spreetail operates in a work culture that promotes results and encourages taking time off when needed. In addition to a generous vacation policy, we also offer paid time-off for your wedding week, paid parental leave and support for parents of growing families.
• We celebrate accomplishments. Each year at Spreetail is a milestone with the opportunity to receive special gifts, swag store credit, or donations to a nonprofit of your choice. We also recognize people pursuing impacts with Spreetail Spotlight Awards.

We offer affordable medical, dental and vision plans with coast-to-coast coverage. We also provide free telehealth and on-demand mental health resources.
• We create the opportunity to revolutionize your community. We encourage Spreetailers to give back and make a social impact, and we offer paid time off to do it.
Spreetail is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Spreetail is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please email .

Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking an experienced Clinical Recruiter to lead full-cycle, in-house recruitment for our growing network of Registered Dietitians (RDs) and serve as backup coverage across our other clinical specialties. You’ll own the RD hiring pipeline from first outreach to signed offer, and step in to support searches for other clinical specialties so the Clinical Talent team never has a coverage gap. You’ll ensure a white-glove candidate experience at every step.

This is a fast-paced, high-growth environment, and we’re looking for someone with deep clinical recruitment experience who is resourceful, agile, and passionate about building a best-in-class clinical team. This is a full-time, W2 position that reports to the Director of Talent Acquisition.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Own full-cycle recruitment for Registered Dietitians, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing

  • Serve as cross-trained backup for the Clinical Talent team, providing coverage on searches for other clinical specialties during peak demand, recruiter transitions, and time off

  • Build and execute innovative sourcing strategies to attract top clinical talent, using professional networks, specialty associations and communities, referrals, and outbound outreach

  • Develop and maintain a deep, continuously refreshed RD talent pipeline for current and future needs, including specialty areas such as PMOS, metabolic health, and women’s health nutrition

  • Maintain working knowledge of the sourcing channels, market dynamics, and candidate expectations for each clinical specialty you cover, so handoffs and backfills are seamless

  • Leverage Allara’s employer brand to position us as a leading destination for women’s health professionals

  • Manage job postings, candidate tracking, and pipeline organization in Ashby, ensuring data accuracy, clean stage management, and process efficiency

  • Use Ashby reporting, scheduling, and automation features to improve speed, consistency, and visibility across the hiring funnel

  • Partner closely with clinical hiring leaders to align recruitment efforts with clinical priorities and state-level coverage needs

  • Deliver a white-glove candidate experience that reflects Allara’s mission and values, guiding candidates throughout the hiring journey

  • Collaborate with the Clinical Talent team to ensure hiring coverage, alignment, and seamless handoffs to credentialing and onboarding

  • Monitor and report on hiring metrics (time to fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, offer acceptance) and recommend improvements

  • Stay informed on licensure and hiring requirements across multiple states and clinical specialties, including state licensure variations and multi-state hiring considerations

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of clinical recruitment experience, with a demonstrated track record of hiring Registered Dietitians and other licensed healthcare professionals across multiple states

  • Proficiency in Ashby as an applicant tracking system, including pipeline management, reporting, and workflow configuration

  • Telehealth recruitment experience, with a clear understanding of remote clinical workflows and licensing nuances across states

  • Start-up experience and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities

  • Expert sourcing skills; you know how to go beyond job boards to uncover and engage top clinical talent

  • Ability to pick up and manage searches across other clinical specialties while keeping RD hiring on track as needed

  • Organized, proactive, and solutions-oriented; you see gaps and take initiative to close them

  • Strong communicator and relationship-builder who can engage candidates with authenticity and care

  • Passion for women’s health and excitement to contribute to a mission-driven clinical workforce

  • Data-driven, adaptable, and committed to continuously improving recruitment outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with RD credentialing, the CDR credential, and state dietetics licensure requirements

  • Experience recruiting across other clinical specialties

  • Experience recruiting for PMOS, endometriosis, or other hormonal and metabolic health programs

    • Equity

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes equity, comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision), generous paid time off, and additional wellness and professional development perks.

raw.title: Storage Systems Platform Engineer
raw.excerpt: Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models.
raw.description:
Aechelon Technology, a Shield AI company, is a leading producer of 3D simulator content, including Geospecific visual/sensor databases and realistic 3D models. We seek people who share our passion for real-time computer graphics and commitment to our mission of helping make our Nation’s pilots safer. We will give you a chance to work with some of the most talented people in the graphics industry.

Aechelon Technology — a Shield AI company — builds high-fidelity visual simulation systems. We're looking for a Sustainment Engineer to keep platform systems buildable, traceable, and releasable. This role owns production build issue resolution, engineering change control, image releases, spares planning, compliance, and operational metrics.

You'll work independently and partner with Platform Engineering, Production, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure, contract manufacturers, and suppliers. You'll turn production and lifecycle needs into clear engineering actions, accurate records, and better build and release processes.

This position’s work week is Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time (CT). Regular and reliable availability during these hours is required, regardless of the employee’s work location.

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to the following:

  • Own first-pass triage and resolution: independently diagnose and resolve factory and production build issues across Windows, Windows Server, and Ubuntu using Python and PowerShell, coordinating cross-team escalation as needed.
  • Drive engineering change control: initiate ECRs for buildability, sourcing, and new capabilities; lead ECOs for systemic production-yield issues; and contribute to impact analysis and disposition.
  • Coordinate controlled image releases: release approved OS, firmware, and BIOS updates to shipped systems, and support golden-image version control.
  • Plan spares and long-lead materials: own forecasts and provide sustainment input for inventory targets, safety stock, end-of-life planning, and last-time buys.
  • Complete per-unit handoff packages: maintain accurate as-built records, image versions, and test results, and coordinate acceptance with Systems Engineering.
  • Support qualification and compliance: review substitutions for compliance and support component qualification, production release readiness, and supplier-quality reviews. Obtain export compliance documentation for new components and, on a quarterly basis, maintain existing export compliance documentation as needed.
  • Own production sustainment metrics: define and report yield, cycle time, and time to qualify, then use the results to identify and track improvements.
  • Improve production tooling and workflows: partner with Infrastructure and Production teams on factory provisioning, imaging, test automation, traceability integrations, and released build and test procedures.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must have at least 5 years of experience sustaining hardware, software systems and product lifecycle management in a production, manufacturing, or lab environment.
  • Independent technical problem-solving skills for production build and configuration issues, with the ability to coordinate resolution across teams.
  • Working knowledge of engineering change control, including ECRs, ECOs, BOMs, configuration management, and technical impact analysis.
  • Experience releasing and controlling system software, including OS, firmware, BIOS, or comparable configurations.
  • Ability to interpret production tests and yield data and turn findings into practical process or design improvements.
  • Understanding of supply continuity planning, including spares, long-lead materials, inventory targets, end-of-life planning, and last-time buys.
  • Strong documentation and traceability skills, with experience maintaining accurate as-built records, configuration history, and test results.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineering, operations, contract manufacturers, and suppliers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with contract manufacturers or supporting complex hardware production.
  • Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or product traceability systems.
  • Familiarity with thermal, burn-in, or compatibility testing.
  • Experience with production test automation or operational reporting, including test-data capture, scripting, or dashboards.

Compensation and Benefits

$123,000 - $153,000 per year

The above range is specific to CALIFORNIA and may not be applicable to other locations. Final compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

We offer a very attractive compensation package including competitive base salary, company performance-based profit sharing, 401k, 100% employer paid health benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, std, ltd, and life insurance plans).

No relocation reimbursement provided.

This position description is not intended to be a complete listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee holding this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may be changed or others may be assigned at any time by the Company with notice to the employee.

Shield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing access and opportunities to individuals with disabilities. If you are an applicant who is unable to fully utilize/access our application process because of a disability, Aechelon Technology will provide a reasonable accommodation. Please send an email to to request that accommodation, and please be sure to include a detailed description of your requested accommodation, your name and preferred method of contact.

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description: Position Overview:The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision.

raw.title: Chief Strategy Officer
raw.excerpt: Position Overview:The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision.
raw.description:
Position Overview:

The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. This role requires strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans that deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Corporate Strategy Development

  • Lead the development of short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational goals.
  • Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.
  • Conduct strategic reviews and adjust plans based on market dynamics.

2. Business Planning & Execution

  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.
  • Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.
  • Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.
  • Provide insights on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

  • Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.
  • Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.
  • Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.
  • Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.
  • Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

  • Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.
  • Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.
  • Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.
  • Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate planning, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in developing and executing successful business strategies.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and business operations.

Key Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to drive change and organizational transformation.

Performance Metrics:

  • Achievement of strategic goals and business growth targets.
  • Success of strategic initiatives and transformation programs.
  • Market expansion and competitive positioning.
  • Efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.
  • Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction.

Choose To Make A Difference

Come care with us at West Coast University! As a Nursing Faculty member for a certified Great Place to Work, you will guide nursing students to do more than change their own lives – you will help change the lives of every patient they treat throughout their career in healthcare. At West Coast University you will have the opportunity to share your success story with the next generation of nurses as a key member of our student-centered, innovative community!

You will make an impact by:

  • Serving as a mentor, role model and facilitator who provides guidance and academic support for students.
  • Demonstrating enthusiasm for teaching, the teaching/learning process and for individual students.
  • Applying your skills and experience to your assigned teaching schedule.
  • Participating in and contributing to assessment activities of courses/curriculum and programs via a continuous improvement plan set forth by the University.
  • Regularly contributing to improvement of class materials and syllabi within prescribed shared governance culture.
  • Utilizing a variety of teaching methodologies to instruct students, always with intent to facilitate observable evidence of student fulfillment of prescribed learning outcomes.
  • Maintaining scholarly activities.
  • Participating in professional growth and service in accordance with university policies.
  • Advancing our commitment and focus on the students we serve, and their success as healthcare professionals.
  • Fully leveraging our innovative technologies and resources, such as our Simulation and Innovation Labs.
  • *If working with students in a Clinical setting you will:
    • Assume complete responsibility for students in clinical facilities.
    • Clarify clinical expectations with students.
    • Clarify student placement and expectations with clinical facility staff.
    • Utilize care planning time to direct students to available resources needed for clinical preparation.
    • Assess student knowledge and skill level to ensure safety and optimal care to patients.
    • Utilize pre- and post- conference to allow students an opportunity to share learned experiences, ensuring clarity of the correlation between weekly theory content with clinical objectives and experiences.
    • Provide feedback of clinical performance immediately after observation of event and of overall performance at midterm and end of semester.

Your Experience Includes:

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite Products, especially Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and other MS office products as needed.
  • Working with online learning management systems to further engage the student learning process.
  • Compliance with state, federal and local laws/regulations relating to programs, governmental compliance, and other regulatory standards such as state Board of Nursing.
  • Must have a minimum of five (5) year’s prior experience as a registered nurse providing direct patient care and have a minimum of three years experience in the field in which they teach.

Education: Education and experience must align with state regulations and comply with the rules and regulations of state authorization agencies.

  • MSN required
  • DNP or PHD required
  • Professional nurse licensure required.

Compensation is paid per course, depending on education and number of students.

  • $1571 - $3200 for an 8 week course.

Bonus Eligible

No

WCU Company Overview

Do you want a career that allows you to make a difference in other people’s lives? Discover what it means to truly believe in the work that you do at West Coast University.

At West Coast University, we have the privilege of educating students seeking careers in healthcare and guide them through their transformational journey from student to caregiver. Our associates are united behind that purpose and share a deep commitment to our values of teamwork, collegiality, transparency, and a student-centric approach to all we do. This focus creates an aligned, nimble, and consensus-driven culture that is solution-oriented and supports our associates’ professional growth.

WCU EEO Statement

West Coast University is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all associates.

Driving change throughout Builders FirstSource locations via ERP and technology strategies is key in our ability to continue to service our customers in the future. We are looking for individuals who want to be a part of this significant shift for our company. This role will be key in that change as we move from older, outdate ERP’s to one systematic platform.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivers complex technical trainings on a wide range of solutions areas/ technologies. Leads development of best practices and standards across Analysts. Creates and leads agile learning strategies and recommends effective training materials and priorities. Leverages subject matter expertise to review and create leadership training best practices, learning objectives and evaluation strategy. Collaborates with senior level cross functional stakeholders to understand business initiatives, challenges and priorities that can be incorporated into the learning experience. Conducts analyses on program effectiveness, reporting to functional or organizational leaders and providing insights or recommendations. Develops formal documentation of programs, curriculum, and outcome objectives. Serves as a deep technical resource.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university. 7+ years relevant work experience. Or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Understanding of ERP systems and integration with business processes

COMPETENCIES

Evaluates Problems: Evaluates and analyzes different types of information objectively to identify appropriate solutions; writes fluently, establishing the key facts clearly and interprets numerical data effectively. Technical Communication/ Presentation: Communicates with clarity and precision, presenting complex information in a concise format that is audience appropriate. Adjusting and Driving Change: Takes a positive approach to tackling work and embraces change; invites feedback relating to performance and deals constructively with criticism. Identifies the need for and drives change when required to achieve objectives. Focuses on Customers: Understands and anticipates customer needs and takes action to provide high-quality products and services to exceed expectations. Demonstrates Business Acumen: Demonstrates working knowledge of market, economic, legal, and regulatory environments and how they impact the business. Agile Best Practices: Understands how agility is leveraged in IT ways of working. Adopts agile best practices as appropriate throughout the assigned work lifecycle. Responds to feedback quickly based on comments of internal and external customers and needs of the market. Bias for Action: Takes initiative and identifies what needs to be done and acts without waiting to be asked. Executes work in a timely manner. Suggests improvements to current ways of working.

BFS COMPETENCIES

Business and Financial Acumen

Demonstrates depth of understanding for the P&L and financial analysis Teaches business and financial acumen to others. Understands KPIs and how BFS makes money. Knows the different business segments and how they relate to one another. Understands customer sales and engagement. Demonstrates functional and/or technical expertise. Understands complex issues and demonstrates problem solving skills. Understands how to maximize business results regardless of industry cycle.

Results Driven

Holds self and others accountable. Communicates and sets clear goals with plans to deliver. Manages competing priorities effectively. Demonstrates appropriate urgency. Drives to exceed expectations in alignment with our BFS SPICE values. Embraces and follows best practices. Demonstrates self-starter, can-do attitude.

Strategic Thinking and Decision Making

Leverages resources and teams around them to solve problems and create mutually beneficial outcomes. Demonstrates willingness and courage to make tough decisions in a timely manner. Balances short-and-long term priorities Demonstrates proactive versus reactive thinking. Asks questions to identify root cause and analyze situations more accurately.

Servant Leadership

Demonstrates humility by putting others first. Builds trust-based relationships. Leads by example with kindness and respect. Collaborates well across all areas of the business. Advocates for others Actively listens to understand the meaning and intent of what the other person is communicating. Demonstrates authenticity and encourages others to do the same.

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates situational awareness – knows when and how to adjust leadership style in different situations. Demonstrates self-awareness – understands strengths and weaknesses. Demonstrates empathy – puts themselves in other’s shoes. Assumes positive intent.

Develops and Leads Others

Drives alignment through clear communication of vision, goals, and expectations. Invests time on a regular basis in performance feedback and developmental conversations. Fosters a respectful and inclusive environment. Empowers, motivates, and inspires others. Coaches and mentor others for their development. Guides and persuades others to deliver positive outcomes.

Growth Mindset

Demonstrates a growth mindset; takes appropriate risks, fails fast and forward, learns from mistakes. Perseveres and champions growth, even in the face of resistance, ambiguity, or possible failure. Thinks like an owner with an entrepreneurial spirit. Demonstrates and encourages intellectual curiosity. Continuous learner; seeks opportunities and knowledge for personal and professional growth. Sees possibilities over problems – actively seeks solutions.

Innovation

raw.title: Senior Technical Artist (Unity3D | Shaders & Tools) Europe
raw.excerpt: Senior Technical Artist (Unity3D | Shaders & Tools)Location: Remote | International Team Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Artist with a strong understanding of real-time rendering, shaders, technical workflows, and game art production.
raw.description:
Senior Technical Artist (Unity3D | Shaders & Tools)

Location: Remote | International Team

Employment: Full-Time / Long-Term

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Artist with a strong understanding of real-time rendering, shaders, technical workflows, and game art production.

We believe great technical artists are creative problem-solvers. They understand artistic intent, recognize technical constraints, and develop elegant solutions that allow artists to produce exceptional results without compromising performance or production efficiency.

As part of our technical art team, you will work closely with artists, engineers, and creative leadership to develop shaders, improve workflows, troubleshoot technical challenges, and support the implementation of high-quality game art.

This is a senior, hands-on role with meaningful technical ownership and opportunities to contribute to both visual quality and production technology.

Key Responsibilities

Shaders & Real-Time Rendering

  • Develop and refine real-time shaders and materials that support the intended artistic direction.

  • Work with lighting, material properties, textures, transparency, and other rendering features.

  • Investigate rendering issues and develop practical technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with artists to achieve visually compelling results within target platform constraints.

  • Support the development and optimization of stylized rendering workflows.

Tools & Production Pipelines

  • Develop artist-friendly tools, scripts, validators, and workflow improvements.

  • Improve asset import, material setup, scene organization, and content validation.

  • Automate repetitive production tasks and reduce unnecessary manual work.

  • Collaborate with artists to identify recurring technical challenges and build reusable solutions.

  • Document tools and workflows to support consistency across teams.

Optimization & Technical Support

  • Profile and optimize real-time content, including geometry, materials, textures, shaders, and VFX.

  • Identify performance bottlenecks and work with engineers to resolve them.

  • Support platform-specific optimization requirements, including memory and GPU limitations.

  • Troubleshoot technical art issues and maintain reliable production workflows.

  • Help establish practical performance guidelines and technical quality standards.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Collaborate with Art Directors, 3D Artists, VFX Artists, Lighting Artists, and Engineers.

  • Translate artistic goals into efficient and maintainable technical implementations.

  • Participate in technical reviews and contribute improvements to existing systems.

  • Proactively identify technical risks and opportunities for workflow improvement.

  • Take ownership of assigned technical art features from prototype to production.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Technical Artist in game development.

  • Experience contributing to commercially released game productions.

  • Strong understanding of real-time rendering, materials, shaders, and graphics fundamentals.

  • Experience with Unity3D, or comparable real-time engines.

  • Practical experience with Shader Graph, HLSL, custom materials, or equivalent shader workflows.

  • Experience creating scripts, tools, or automation using Python, C#, or similar languages.

  • Strong understanding of game art pipelines, asset preparation, and in-engine implementation.

  • Familiarity with GPU and CPU profiling, optimization, and real-time performance constraints.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex artistic and technical issues.

  • Strong artistic judgment and understanding of the relationship between visual quality and technical limitations.

  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Bonus Skills

  • Strong Unity URP/HDRP or rendering experience.

  • Experience developing shaders and tools for stylized games.

  • Knowledge of mobile GPU optimization, draw calls, overdraw, and memory budgets.

  • Experience with Houdini or procedural content generation.

  • Familiarity with technical animation, VFX, or character production pipelines.

  • Experience with compute shaders or GPU-driven rendering techniques.

  • Previous experience working in a co-development environment.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful technical ownership over shaders, tools, and production workflows.

  • Opportunity to solve challenging artistic and technical problems.

  • Collaboration with experienced Artists, Engineers, and Technical Leads.

  • Remote-friendly international working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and flexible contract options.

  • Long-term collaboration and opportunities for professional growth.

  • Annual Beffio team retreats and a supportive studio culture.

Ready to Turn Creative Challenges into Technical Solutions?

Send us your portfolio, technical breakdowns, and a short introduction. We would love to see examples of shaders, tools, optimizations, or systems you have developed and how they improved visual quality or production efficiency.

As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end-to-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have 2+ years of digital marketing experience

You understand paid media and the types of content that converts

You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life

You are detail-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
