raw.description:
deine aufgaben

Als Technologie- und Innovationsmanager verantwortest du die technische Seite der Kundenbeziehung und führst mehrere parallel laufende Projekte und Anträge.

  • Du führst Interviews mit technischen Ansprechpartnern (z. B. Gründern, CTOs, Teamleads), verstehst Technologien, Risiken und Lösungsansätze und entwickelst strategische Konzepte.
  • Du strukturierst innovative Projektideen eng abgestimmt mit Gründern, CTOs und Senior-Developern führender Start-ups, meist in der Informatik und Softwareentwicklung.
  • Du erstellst deutschsprachige technische Unterlagen für Fördermittelanträge (z. B. zur Forschungszulage) – steuerliches Wissen ist nicht erforderlich.
  • Du koordinierst externe Spezialist:innen und Freelancer bei der Erstellung technischer Unterlagen.

dein profil

  • Du erschließt dir unbekannte Technologien und Branchen schnell und selbstständig, auch mit aktuellen Hilfsmitteln wie LLMs
  • Praktische Software- und Programmiererfahrung (Studium, Job oder Projekt), um Architekturen und Technologien zu verstehen und zu hinterfragen (keine eigene Entwicklung erforderlich).
  • Du kannst komplexe Themen mündlich und schriftlich verständlich und handlungsorientiert vermitteln.
  • Du bringst ein hohes Engagement und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit.
  • Du hast einen Master oder eine Promotion in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Fach (präferiert: Informatik, Physik oder Maschinenbau).
  • Zusätzlich hilfreich aber nicht gefordert
    • Erfahrung mit Fördermitteln: Antragstellung im Unternehmen, Arbeit in einer Fördermittelberatung oder bei einem Projektträger
    • Gründungserfahrung oder Arbeit im Startup-Umfeld
  • Du bleibst stets freundlich und professionell, auch wenn ein Kunde mal etwas anderes zeigt.
  • Du verfügst über ein hohes Sprachniveau in Deutsch (Wissenschaftlichkeit, treffende Wortwahl und Formulierungen, Vermeidung von Redundanzen) und sprichst fließend Englisch.

was wir bieten

  • Echte Verantwortung für Kunden, Projekte und Ergebnisse. Zusätzlich klare Ansprechpartner und ein unterstützendes Team statt Sprung ins kalte Wasser
  • Direkter Kontakt zu Gründern und C-Level, bei unseren Kunden und bei uns
  • 1.500 € Entwicklungsbudget pro Jahr nach der Probezeit, für Schulungen, Coaching und Zertifizierungen
  • 30 Urlaubstage und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Arbeitsort nach deiner Wahl: Berlin, Grünwald bei München oder remote. Berlin oder München sind uns lieber, weil unsere beiden Hubs davon leben
  • Urban Sports Club, ClassPass oder die Edenred-Sachbezugskarte, eines der drei nach deiner Wahl
  • Kita-Betreuungszuschuss von bis zu 150 € pro Kind und Monat
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Entgeltumwandlung mit dem gesetzlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • BahnCard 25 für die 1. Klasse
  • Hochwertige IT-Ausstattung und kurze Entscheidungswege

raw.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


As a Domain Consultant for SOC Transformation you will be the expert for our Cortex portfolio, a Next-Gen AI-powered security operations platform. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives. You evangelize our industry leading solutions in Security Intelligence and Automation, XDR, Attack Surface Management, SOAR and Incident Response that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

Your Impact


  • Collaborate with account teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization area
  • Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership
  • As the main technical point of contact for Cortex, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs.
  • Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition
  • Scope and lead Proof of Value (PoV) projects for prospective customers and partners based on best practices to ensure technical win in your assigned opportunities
  • Drive high technical validation and PoV win rates within your assigned specialization area
  • Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
  • Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
  • Document High-Level Design and Key Use Cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks Solutions
  • Help our customers build and develop further their services around Cortex solutions
  • Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape
  • Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative
  • Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
  • Initiate projects to improve individual team’s performance
  • Implement organizational policies & help others adopt
  • Act as a conduit for customer feedback to Product Management, Technical Marketing, competitor intelligence, and R&D to create requirements and deliver product features for our customers

Qualifications

Your Experience


  • 6+ years experience in Security Operations or pre-sales/sales engineering within SIEM, SOAR, SOC, and/or XDR/EDR environments
  • IBM QRadar design, deployment, and/or pre-sales experience highly desirable
  • Experience in working with customers, demonstrating problem-solving skills and a can-do attitude
  • Solid understanding of Security Operations Center processes
  • Advanced knowledge of SIEM and/or SOAR solutions
  • Scripting experience is a plus - Python preferred
  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
  • Proficient in English

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$206,400.00 - $283,800.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Infrastructure Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Infrastructure Automation Engineer
Job Title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $100K - $150K / Annum
Experience: 5+ years
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.
Employment Type: Full-time, direct W2 with Bright Vision Technologies (no C2C, no 1099, no third-party)
Engagement: Long-term, multi-year, aligned to the Bright Vision SOW delivery roadmap
Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.
Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.
However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.
Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.
  • Build a library of well-tested, reusable Terraform modules with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.
  • Manage Terraform state at scale with appropriate backend strategies, state locking, workspace organization, and disaster recovery patterns.
  • Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.
  • Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.
  • Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.
  • Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.
  • Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.
  • Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).
  • Familiarity with Terragrunt, Atlantis, Spacelift, or env0.
  • Experience with policy-as-code engines (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov).
  • Contributions to public Terraform modules or providers.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and tagging-driven cost governance.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
We recognize that our people are our strength, and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

Position offered by “No Fee Agency.”

raw.description:
Overview

The Solution Consultant (SC) is an integral member of the strategic implementation organization. The SC is responsible for successful Saas delivery, specifically the deployment of the RealPage solutions. This team member will work directly with customers as well as with internal stakeholders to architect scalable, flexible and resilient solutions that specifically address each customer’s business requirements. This team member will play a critical role in managing and providing strategic guidance on full life-cycle implementations. They will be responsible for understanding business strategy and use cases across the various workstreams within our customers' business, creating and delivering customized product implementations that solve customer needs. Working with service delivery, business units, and other stakeholders, they are responsible for the overall implementation of a customer’s RealPage solutions. Operating in a client-facing role, this team member must work collaboratively with people at all levels within customer organizations, tailoring communication to meet the needs of various stakeholders.

Responsibilities

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define customers business requirements and current state of operations.
  • Develop change management strategy to align current and future state of operations.
  • Track achievements of defined requirements and adoption success.
  • Develop ongoing customer partnership/trusted advisor status.
  • Connect business requirements with functional capabilities of RealPage products.
  • Formulate solution framework to drive a successful implementation.
  • Lead presale and implementation discovery discussions with key roles of customer.
  • Partner with the Engagement Management team in providing input for the larger implementation project plan.
  • Plan and manage system design, partnering with internal delivery teams for execution.
  • Plan and establish go-live activities relative to solution integration, including training and ongoing support.
  • Contribute to team and/or department initiatives.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years of Multifamily Experience.
  • Expert level knowledge of a few RealPage products and integrations.
  • Intermediate level proficiency in Consulting Processes.
  • Ability to engage and lead conversations with Directors and/or regional level contacts.
  • Limited Travel.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, research and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently, multi-task, achieve tight deadlines and take ownership on multiple projects.

Salary and Benefits

RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $85,200.00 - USD $145,200.00 /Yr.

raw.description:
NetSuite Functional Consultant (Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Advanced Manufacturing, WMS)

As a Seller Universe NetSuite Functional Consultant, you will play a crucial role in implementing and optimizing NetSuite's ERP system for clients. You will collaborate with stakeholders, including business users, IT teams, and project managers, to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective NetSuite solutions. You will be responsible for providing expertise and guidance on all aspects of NetSuite's manufacturing functionality.Your expertise in NetSuite's functionalities, configurations, and best practices will be vital in delivering successful implementations and driving business process improvements.

﻿

Responsibilities:

  • Manufacturing Process Optimization: Evaluate existing manufacturing processes, identify areas for improvement, and recommend strategies to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness using NetSuite's manufacturing capabilities.
  • Requirements Gathering and Analysis: Work closely with clients to understand their business processes, supply chain and manufacturing processes, including demand planning, inventory management, procurement, production planning, shop floor control, and warehousing, gather requirements, and identify opportunities for leveraging NetSuite's functionalities to streamline operations, improve efficiency, and achieve business goals.
  • Solution Design and Configuration: Design and configure NetSuite modules to meet client requirements, including Financial Management, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, CRM, Manufacturing modules, including Work Orders, Bill of Materials (BOM), Routings, Production Planning, Quality Control, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, Advanced Manufacturing, and Warehouse Management System (WMS), to meet client requirements. Utilize your expertise in NetSuite's capabilities to optimize manufacturing processes, enable advanced manufacturing functionalities, improve warehouse operations and optimize production processes and drive continuous improvement.
  • System Implementation and Customization: Collaborate with technical teams to implement NetSuite solutions, configure the system, perform data migration, and integrate NetSuite with other systems such as MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) and WMS, data migration, and integration with third-party applications, ensuring successful project delivery within defined timelines and budget.
  • Manufacturing Process Mapping and Optimization: Conduct thorough process mapping of the client's manufacturing operations and identify areas for improvement. Recommend and implement changes to streamline manufacturing processes, reduce costs, enhance product quality, and increase overall efficiency using NetSuite's manufacturing features.
  • Supply Chain Planning and Execution: Design and configure NetSuite's supply chain management modules, including demand planning, inventory management, procurement, and order fulfillment. Optimize supply chain processes, improve forecast accuracy, and enhance order fulfillment capabilities using NetSuite's features.
  • User Training and Support: Provide end-user training and support during system deployments, supply chain, manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, and WMS functionalities and ensuring users are proficient in utilizing NetSuite's functionalities to perform their daily tasks effectively. Offer ongoing support, address user inquiries, and troubleshoot issues related to these areas.
  • Business Process Improvement: Assess existing business processes, identify areas for improvement, and recommend and implement changes to optimize workflows, increase productivity, and enhance the overall performance of the organization using NetSuite's capabilities.
  • System Testing and Quality Assurance: Develop and execute test plans, perform system testing, and facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate system functionalities, identify and resolve issues, and ensure system stability and data integrity.
  • Documentation and Training Materials: Create comprehensive system documentation, including functional requirements, process flows, configuration guides, and user manuals, to support the implementation, training, and ongoing system maintenance, specific to supply chain, manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, and WMS processes. Develop training materials to support end-users in utilizing NetSuite's capabilities effectively.
  • Stay Updated with NetSuite Enhancements and Industry Trends: Continuously update knowledge on the latest NetSuite features, functionalities, and industry trends related to supply chain management, manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, and WMS to provide strategic guidance and recommendations to clients for leveraging new capabilities and maximizing the value of their NetSuite investment.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Significant experience 3+ years as a functional consultant or business analyst, specializing in NetSuite ERP implementations with expertise in supply chain, manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, and WMS.
  • In-depth knowledge of supply chain management processes, manufacturing operations, advanced manufacturing concepts, and warehouse management principles.
  • Strong understanding of NetSuite's modules, core business processes and experience with NetSuite modules such as Financial Management, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, CRM, etc. including Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing, Advanced Manufacturing, and Warehouse Management System (WMS), and their configurations, workflows, and best practices.
  • Experience in implementing and customizing NetSuite's supply chain and manufacturing functionalities, including demand planning, inventory management, procurement, production planning, shop floor control, and warehousing.
  • Ability to gather requirements, analyze complex supply chain and manufacturing scenarios, and propose appropriate NetSuite solutions.
  • Proficiency in NetSuite configurations, workflows, saved searches, reports, and other customization features.
  • Expertise in configuring and customizing NetSuite's manufacturing modules to meet specific client requirements and industry best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, design solutions, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze complex business scenarios and propose appropriate solutions within NetSuite's capabilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with clients, project teams, and end-users effectively.
  • Project management experience and familiarity with project methodologies is a plus.
  • NetSuite certifications, such as SuiteFoundation, ERP Consultant, or specific module certifications, are highly desired.

Location:

  • PH - Remote

  • Flexible working hours

RightMove is a virtual MSK care company built in partnership with Hospital for Special Surgery. We're hiring Virtual MSK Physical Therapists for a 1099 contract role, M-F during ET business hours.

About RightMove

RightMove is redefining how value-based musculoskeletal (MSK) care is delivered. Built in partnership with the Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS)—the world leader in MSK health trusted by elite athletes—we’re creating a new standard of coordinated, expert-led care that gets people moving better and faster.

We partner with PCPs, Orthopedic specialists, and health plans to deliver high-value, patient-centered MSK care. Our value-based care model includes patient engagement, virtual physical therapy, and care navigation to high-value imaging and specialty partners.

Our Mission & Values

We’re a high-performing team driven by one mission: to free people to move and thrive. At RightMove, we move fast, collaborate deeply, and deliver with precision. We’re a startup with enterprise-grade rigor—where talented operators, engineers and clinicians challenge conventions to improve patient outcomes.

We live our values every day:

  • Perform to Win – We bring our best to deliver measurable results, valuing impact over optics.
  • BeDirect with Respect – We communicate clearly, with honesty and care.
  • Move as One Team – We win together, across roles and functions.
  • Act with Agency – Our teams have high trust and high accountability, with the freedom to own and responsibility to deliver.
  • Choose Optimism – We bring energy and perspective, even when the work is hard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Physical Therapist who will be responsible for delivering virtual musculoskeletal evaluation, triage, and care planning. This individual will assess patients, determine the appropriate level of care, initiate and progress conservative management when indicated, identify red and yellow flags, and collaborate closely with Care Coordinators and medical partners to ensure appropriate escalation when needed He or she will report to the VP of Care Delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Virtual Triage & Care Delivery
  • Conduct virtual musculoskeletal triage and follow-up visits to assess symptoms, functional limitations, and clinical risk.
  • Apply strong clinical reasoning to determine appropriate clinical recommendations within a virtual care model.
  • Deliver evidence-based virtual physical therapy interventions focused on functional improvement and symptom management.
  • Care Planning
  • Develop individualized care plans aligned with patient goals, functional needs, and long-term outcomes.
  • Identify clinical needs requiring care coordination and route tasks to Care Coordinators
  • Partner with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) and other clinicians when medical escalation or specialty involvement is indicated.
  • Collaboration & Continuity of Care
  • Communicate and coordinate with patients, care coordinators, APPs, and external referral sources to support continuity across the episode of care.
  • Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant clinical documentation in accordance with regulatory, payer, and organizational requirements.
  • Adhere to established clinical protocols, escalation pathways, and quality standards within a value-based care environment.

Must-Haves

  • Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree from a CAPTE-accredited program.
  • Active, unrestricted physical therapy license in the state(s) where care will be delivered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience, with preference for 5 years.
  • Strong clinical reasoning skills and a patient-first approach to care.
  • Comfort practicing in a virtual environment, including remote evaluations and video-based patient education.

Preferred

  • APTA specialist certification (e.g., OCS, SCS).
  • Residence in PT Compact State
  • Experience delivering care in virtual or telehealth-based models.
  • Experience working in interdisciplinary or integrated care teams alongside medical providers.
  • Spanish language proficiency.

raw.description:
The ACLU seeks a Graduate Intern for theirAffiliate Support and Nationwide Initiatives Department's (ASNI) Organizational Management, Equity & Inclusion (OMEI) Team of the National ACLU Office in Washington D.C. This internship is remote and can be full-time or part-time.

Qualifying applicants must currently be matriculated Graduate students and must be based in the U.S. for the entire duration of the internship.

The Team:

The ASNI department builds state capacity and strengthens the connections between the ACLU and its network of 54 state affiliates and their 1,500 staff members across the country. The affiliates’ work constitutes an unparalleled bulwark defending and advancing our civil liberties and civil rights. ASNI staff lead efforts to build program, build organizations, and drive resources to key battles across the country, positioning the nationwide organization for future challenges. The Organizational Management, Equity & Inclusion (OMEI) team is a crucial partner to ACLU affiliates and other leaders in change management, leadership development and organization capacity-building.

Our team (OMEI) strengthens affiliates’ organizational health and impact by providing training, coaching, resources, and learning communities that advance strategic and financial management, governance, leadership, and EDIB-centered culture—while helping affiliates effectively leverage multi-year investments to build long-term capacity and belonging.

What You’ll Do:

The intern will be responsible for collaborating with the OMEI team to ensure that the needs of the affiliate staff are met through learning programs, tools, and resources.

This internship supports the following Focus Areas:  Affiliate Organizational Management, Equity, and Inclusion (OMEI)/Affiliate Equity, Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging (EDIB) Trainings/departmental goals, "Affiliate Equity Pipeline" (Recruitment and Talent Attraction), Southern Legal Internship Program (SLIP). In this internship you will engage in strategic discussions on a nationwide scale, contributing to our commitment to fostering equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging. You will research and share cutting-edge learnings to support a culture of learning and growth in the realm of Organizational Management, Equity, and Inclusion (OMEI)

Your Day to Day

  • Resource Creation and Management: Create, edit, organize and maintain resources for effective communication of OMEI/SLIP programs and tools. Maintain and update content on "the HUB," our intranet platform. Help analyze data related to Hub usage and Sharedrive file organization.
  • Administrative Support: Assist in coordinating learning calls and webinars, support virtual workshops administration. Support administrative tasks, such as taking notes for and assisting with the coordination of meetings related to working groups, learning communities, and other initiatives.
  • Communication: Draft preliminary language for deliverables, such as internal communications, brief summaries, and PowerPoint presentations, for different audiences. Written correspondence to stakeholders across the nationwide organization.
  • Virtual Meeting Involvement: Attend critical meetings with ACLU affiliate staff and board members, Draft follow-up summaries and communications, documenting key learnings. track next steps.
  • Data Analysis and Reporting: Identify and synthesis relevant data Excel and PowerPoint reports, analyze and report on priority programming and learning community effectiveness, support survey data collection and analysis of results.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Graduate student in related field
  • Word, PowerPoint and Excel proficiency
  • Interest in organizational management, equity, inclusion, and belonging
  • Experience with project management and building resources
  • Ability to take initiative, think creatively, contribute innovative ideas, problem solve, work well under pressure, and take ownership of projects and assignments
  • Experience assisting with administrative tasks in an office setting, preferably a nonprofit
  • A commitment to civil liberties, civil rights, and social justice 

Future ACLU-ers Will:

  • Be committed to advancing the mission of the ACLU
  • Center and embed the principles of equity, inclusion and belonging in their work by demonstrating commitment to diversity with an approach that respects and values multiple perspectives
  • Be committed to work collaboratively and respectfully toward resolving obstacles and conflict

Internship Logistics:

  • Location: Our internship program offers a limited number of remote or hybrid intern positions. This internship can be full-time or part-time and remote from our Washington D.C. office.
  • Time Commitment: Full-time (35 hrs/week) or Part-time (10,15 or 20hrs/wk)
  • Internship Duration: Full-time internships span 10 consecutive weeks and Part-time internships span 12 consecutive weeks. This internship has a start date of: Jan. 11th or Jan. 25th, 2027
  • Stipend: A stipend is available for students who are lawfully authorized to work. Arrangements can be made with educational institutions for work/study or course credit.
    • Below is the stipend rate:
      • $24/hr for graduate and law students or equivalent experience

Priority Application Deadline: Friday, November 13, 2026.

While there is a priority deadline, our project is committed to reviewing all applications on a rolling basis until the closing of posting.

Why the ACLU:

For over 100 years, the ACLU has worked to defend and preserve the individual rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States. Whether it’s ending mass incarceration, achieving full equality for the LGBTQ+ community, establishing new privacy protections for our digital age, or preserving the right to vote or the right to have an abortion, the ACLU takes up the toughest civil liberties cases and issues to defend all people.

Our Commitment to Accessibility, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion
Accessibility, equity, diversity, and inclusion are core values of the ACLU and central to our work to advance liberty, equality, and justice for all. For us diversity, equity and inclusion are not just check-the-box activities, but a chance for us to make long-term meaningful change. We are a community committed to learning and growth, humility and grace, transparency, and accountability. We believe in a collective responsibility to create a culture of belonging for all people within our organization – one that respects and embraces difference; treats everyone equitably; and empowers our colleagues to do the best work possible. We are as committed to anti-oppression and anti-racism internally as we are externally. Because whether we’re in the courts or in the office, we believe ‘We the People’ means all of us. 

With this commitment in mind, we strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status and record of arrest or conviction, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

To maintain the integrity of our assessment process, please refrain from using AI-powered chatbots, search engines, or real-time assistance tools to generate your CV, cover letter or writing sample (if required). We want to better understand your individual skills and thought processes. If you require AI tools or other assistive technology as a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please complete the Accommodation Request Form so that we can support an accessible and equitable experience.

If you are selected for an interview, you will receive additional information regarding how to request an accommodation for the interview process.

In order to be considered for this position, all candidates must formally submit an application. The ACLU does not accept unsolicited calls or emails from candidates regarding their application status.

Job Title -Bilingual Grants Specialist

Company -Zero To One Strategic

Location -Remote, Canada-based

Position Type -Full-time

Start date -Immediate

Salary - $75,000 - $80,000 / yr


About Us

Zero To One Strategic is a specialized consultancy that helps innovative companies maximize revenue from Canadian R&D and innovation programs. We work with startups and scale-ups across multiple sectors and take a long-term, outcomes-driven approach to non-dilutive funding, including grants, subsidies, and tax credits.

The Grants team works closely with founders and technical leaders to design and execute integrated funding strategies that support R&D, commercialization, and scale. To date, we have helped clients secure millions of dollars in non-dilutive funding and continue to grow as demand increases. We support clients end-to-end, from identifying and matching to the right funding opportunities, through grant writing and submission, to post-award support, delivering a well-rounded, non-dilutive funding experience.

We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are passionate about supporting Canadian innovation and entrepreneurship. Our team works across disciplines and in close partnership with founders to help translate key milestones, technical ideas, and growth plans into funded, scalable outcomes. We look for team members who are equally excited to work alongside founders to help bring ambitious ideas to life.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Bilingual Grants Specialist to manage and execute grant strategies across a large portfolio of active clients. This role focuses on client management, opportunity oversight, and ownership of funding outcomes, not grant writing alone.

You will be responsible for managing 50+ client accounts, staying ahead of new and existing funding opportunities, coordinating contractors and internal resources, communicating with funding agencies, reviewing and editing submissions, and ensuring applications are delivered on time and to a high standard.

This integral role on our Grants team suits someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, comfortable operating at scale, and confident managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

Client / Portfolio Management

  • Own a portfolio of 50+ active clients with ongoing grant strategies
  • Serve as the primary point of coordination for grant-related work
  • Work directly with founders and their leadership teams to translate business priorities, projects, and technical roadmaps into fundable grant strategies
  • Ensure clients are informed of relevant opportunities and timelines
  • Manage active, submitted, and awarded opportunities through to final outcome & reporting

Grants Opportunity Management

  • Monitor federal and provincial funding programs relevant to assigned clients
  • Assess eligibility, effort, timing, and likelihood of success
  • Advise clients on which opportunities to pursue or deprioritize based on eligibility, past success, etc.
  • Maintain visibility across the full grants pipeline for each client
  • Proactively flag risks, dependencies, and resourcing needs

Contractor and Workflow Management

  • Coordinate internal and external grant writers and subject matter experts
  • Provide clear briefs, context, and deadlines
  • Review, edit, and quality check all submissions before final delivery
  • Ensure alignment with client positioning and funder requirements
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, SR&ED, and other internal teams to ensure a well-rounded, client-first funding experience.

Writing Support

  • Contribute to writing full applications, where appropriate
  • Edit and strengthen drafts written by others for QC, clarity, compliance, and impact
  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude to support research and drafting with strong human oversight

Process, Documentation, and Follow Up

  • Track deadlines, submission status, and outcomes across your portfolio
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation
  • Support post submission follow ups and funder questions

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of experience in grants, funding advisory, or related roles
  • Experience managing a high volume of clients or projects simultaneously
  • Strong editing, review and QC skills
  • Solid understanding of Canadian government funding programs (e.g., federal, provincial, municipal, sector-specific)
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using tools such as G Suite, CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot), and modern AI-assisted productivity tools
  • Excellent organization and time management skills
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication
  • English and French speaking and writing skills are required
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong plus
  • Exposure to software, AI, med tech, cleantech, or advanced manufacturing is beneficial
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced consulting environment with evolving priorities
  • Experience working with startups or scale-ups is a strong asset

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive full-time salary based on experience
  • Remote first work environment
  • Opportunities for growth as the grants function scales
  • Work closely with a senior team in the innovation funding space
Salary: $75,000 – $80,000 / year

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

Who We Are:

Are you a passionate innovator looking to harness the power of technology to do more good? You've come to the right place. At Bonterra, our purpose is to power those who power social impact. To that end, we serve the people who make social good possible—the doers behind the scenes across nonprofits, public agencies, corporations, philanthropic organizations, and foundations.

As the second-largest and fastest-growing social good software company in the world, Bonterra brings together leading solutions from CyberGrants, EveryAction, Network for Good, Social Solutions, and their respective entities. By bringing our intuitive technology and expertise together, Bonterra will enable unprecedented connectivity between social good organizations and their community of supporters and constituents. This will reshape philanthropic giving, empower digital transformation, and bring the social good sector the technology it needs to accelerate lasting social change.

We are a globally distributed team with team members across the US, Mexico, and beyond. This is a fully remote position based in Mexico. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Mexico.


About the Role:

The Procurement Specialist, Source-to-Pay (S2P) supports end-to-end procurement operations, including sourcing support, supplier coordination, contract administration, procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, and process documentation. The ideal candidate brings foundational procurement experience, familiarity with SaaS vendor relationships, strong organizational skills, and a detail-oriented mindset to help drive compliance, efficiency, and cost awareness across the organization. This role works closely with US-based teams across Finance, Legal, and Operations, with all communications conducted in English and core hours aligned to US time zones.


Key Responsibilities:

Source-to-Pay Operations

  • Support and execute day-to-day S2P processes, ensuring smooth coordination between sourcing, contracting, purchasing, and payment functions
  • Follow and help document procurement policies and controls aligned to corporate standards
  • Serve as an active user of S2P platforms, maintaining data integrity, supporting workflow execution, and assisting with user adoption across business units

Contract Administration

  • Assist with contract lifecycle activities including tracking, renewals, and supplier off-boarding
  • Maintain the centralized contract repository, ensuring all agreements are current, compliant, and auditable
  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather required documentation and support contract execution
  • Monitor key contract milestones and flag upcoming renewals, expirations, and compliance gaps

Procurement Operations & Supplier Coordination

  • Support RFx processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP), vendor evaluations, and supplier onboarding
  • Assist in coordinating supplier reviews and tracking performance against SLAs, quality, and cost metrics
  • Help identify cost-reduction opportunities and support reporting on savings initiatives
  • Ensure compliance with three-way matching, approval workflows, and internal audit requirements within the P2P cycle

Technology & Reporting

  • Maintain and update procurement dashboards tracking spend, savings, cycle times, and compliance metrics
  • Support S2P platform administration tasks and assist stakeholders with platform navigation and usage
  • Identify and flag opportunities for process automation or manual effort reduction

Stakeholder Support

  • Serve as a point of contact for procurement-related questions from US-based teams including Finance, Legal, Operations, IT, and HR
  • Prepare data summaries, reports, and documentation to support procurement decisions and leadership updates
  • Communicate clearly in English with US-based stakeholders at all levels to resolve issues and gather information

Who You Are:

You are a detail-oriented, organized procurement professional who enjoys supporting complex operational processes and building strong working relationships. You are comfortable navigating procurement systems, coordinating with vendors, and collaborating with US-based teams in a fully remote environment. You take ownership of your work, communicate proactively in English, and are eager to grow within a procurement function.


Required Qualifications:


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (Licenciatura in a relevant discipline accepted)

Experience

  • 2–4 years of relevant procurement, purchasing, or vendor coordination experience
  • Hands-on experience supporting CLM and/or P2P processes — direct system usage and workflow execution required
  • Familiarity with supplier coordination, requisition-to-PO workflows, invoice matching, and audit compliance
  • Experience working with at least one Source-to-Pay platform such as Zip, Ivalua, Ariba, Coupa, or Jaggaer
  • Exposure to SaaS vendor management, including subscription tracking, license coordination, or contract renewals
  • Solid Excel and data skills; ability to build and maintain reports and support business case preparation
  • Full professional-level English required — written and verbal — for daily collaboration with US-based teams
  • Core working hours align with US Central or Eastern time zones; overlap of at least 6 hours with US business hours required
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection required
  • Bilingual English/Spanish required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Zip (intake orchestration, approval workflows, sourcing, CLM, P2P, or supplier management modules)
  • Familiarity with category management concepts
  • Background in technology or SaaS companies where software spend is a significant part of the procurement portfolio

At Bonterra, we’re building AI-powered tools to solve real human challenges—and we want teammates who share that enthusiasm. We value people who will champion AI and bring diverse perspectives from different industries, backgrounds, and cultures. Together, we create AI that breaks down barriers, empowers communities, and delivers better outcomes

At this time, we are unable to consider candidates who require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization.


Our Culture

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. At Bonterra, we foster an inclusive, equitable culture where every team member belongs and contributes to meaningful impact. Read more about our values and culture here.


Compensation & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being and growth - explore full details here.


Compensation and benefits for this U.S. role apply to regular full-time and part-time employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours a week. Pay reflects location, skills, experience, and education, and is one part of Bonterra’s total rewards package, which may include bonuses, incentives, and equity. Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance with employer-subsidized premiums, unlimited Flexible Time Off (FTO), paid holidays, and dedicated time off to volunteer. All regular and part-time employees are eligible for the Bonterra 401(k) plan with a 3% company match.

Job Posting:

Since 1993, Jones Stephens has been a trusted source of quality plumbing products and solutions for professional contractors and the wholesale distribution channel. We help our customers complete complex projects simply and successfully by combining practical product expertise with responsive service and support.


Business Development Manager - Gas Piping Systems


Role Summary


Jones Stephens is seeking a Business Development Manager to lead strategy and execution for gas piping systems. This role will build demand with contractors and expand adoption across the wholesale distribution channel. A primary near-term priority is growing share by converting incumbent business through alignment with wholesale branch leadership, sales associates, inventory, pricing, training and contractor pull-through. The successful candidate will be a high-energy, solutions-oriented sales leader who can translate market strategy into measurable revenue, margin and share growth.


Location: This role is approved to be Remote anywhere in the US. Our ideal candidate would be located in the Mid-South i.e. Tennessee, etc.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop and execute a national growth plan for gas piping systems across targeted wholesale distribution channels.
  • Lead the wholesale branch adoption strategy for gas piping systems including opportunity sizing, target prioritization, local action plans and conversion tracking.
  • Create contractor demand and pull-through by targeting plumbing, HVAC, gas distribution, multifamily and generator-installation customers; secure initial projects and drive repeat adoption.
  • Concentrate sales activity in select markets, using statewide and municipal approvals, branch inventory and stocking partners to build dense, repeatable revenue.
  • Partner with wholesale branch, district and regional leaders, along with Brand leadership, to align product strategy, stocking, pricing, sales activity and accountability.
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of contractors, projects, branch conversions and wholesale opportunities in CRM; provide accurate forecasts and concise progress reporting.
  • Deliver product, application and sales-strategy training to contractors and other market influencers.
  • Develop relationships with code officials, trade associations, builders, developers, engineers and other specification influencers to expand product acceptance and adoption.
  • Own system-based quoting and coordinate pricing, programs and proposals that protect margin, reduce substitution risk and accelerate closure.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity and customer feedback—particularly related to competitors—to refine positioning and identify product, inventory and marketing needs.
  • Serve as the field liaison across Brand Leadership, Category Management, Product Development, Marketing, Legal/Regulatory, Supply Chain and Sales to remove barriers and execute the go-to-market plan.

Measures of Success


  • Revenue, gross margin and market-share growth for gas piping systems.
  • Competitive conversions completed across targeted wholesale locations and contractors.
  • Active contractors, repeat projects and adoption in focus markets.
  • Stocking locations and qualified wholesale partners established in priority geographies.
  • Pipeline quality, forecast accuracy, training completion and execution against market plans.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Five or more years of business development, field sales, product management or channel-growth experience; gas piping, plumbing, HVAC or building-products experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success converting incumbent products, launching new categories and growing revenue through multi-location distribution networks.
  • Working knowledge of two-step wholesale distribution, contractor pull-through and independent manufacturer representative models.
  • Ability to communicate technical product value and deliver credible presentations to contractors, branch teams, executives, code officials and trade groups.
  • Strong commercial judgment in pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, negotiation and profitability.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and field leaders without direct authority while maintaining clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Self-directed, data-driven and comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial growth environment with frequent travel.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to travel extensively based on market and customer needs.

raw.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

The Enterprise BDR in the LATAM team is the engine behind Braze's large company growth. You'll partner with Account Executives to identify, engage, and qualify prospects at companies with 5,000+ employees, helping leading B2C brands discover how Braze can transform their customer engagement.

This is a high-impact, remote role where you'll blend volume-driven outreach with personalized, consultative prospecting. You'll research strategic accounts, craft relevant messaging, and create opportunities that directly fuel Braze's regional pipeline across LATAM.

Main responsibilities:

  • Enterprise Outbound Prospecting: Prospect into Enterprise (5,000+ employees) target accounts across key industries such as retail, media, fintech, and travel.

  • Pipeline & Meeting Generation: Generate qualified meetings for the Enterprise AE team through multi-channel outbound outreach (email, phone, LinkedIn, video).

  • Account Research: Research accounts to identify pain points around customer engagement, cross-channel messaging, and data activation.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Executives and marketing to develop territory strategies and prioritize high-potential accounts across the region.

  • CRM & Data Hygiene: Maintain accurate activity, prospecting notes, and pipeline data in Salesforce.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Consistently hitting or exceeding monthly qualified meeting and pipeline targets.

  • Building a repeatable outreach motion that balances efficiency, volume, and thoughtful personalization.

  • Developing strong product and industry knowledge to speak credibly about Braze's value proposition to executive prospects.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Prospecting & Sales Background: Proven track record in outbound prospecting within sales, business development, or high-activity customer-facing roles. Experience in Enterprise SaaS or complex sales environments is a plus.

  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal) is required to engage prospects and collaborate with global stakeholders. Fluency in Portuguese is a plus.

  • Remote Discipline & Autonomy: Highly organized and self-motivated, with the ability to manage high-volume outreach, prioritize tasks, and maintain strong performance in a remote environment.

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication; ability to craft compelling, concise outreach and articulate value clearly.

  • Coachability & Growth Mindset: Eager to learn, open to feedback, and driven to iterate quickly to improve sales techniques.

  • Resilience: Comfortable with rejection, persistent, and motivated by ambitious targets and healthy competition.

  • Domain & Tool Familiarity: Genuine curiosity in MarTech, SaaS, and customer engagement. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar sales tech is preferred.

WHY JOIN

  • Clear Career Path: Structured progression toward Senior BDR and Account Executive (AE) roles with dedicated leadership coaching and enablement.

  • High Impact & Visibility: Partner directly with regional AEs and GTM leadership; your contribution directly impacts Braze's growth in LATAM.

  • Collaborative Culture: Inclusive, supportive team environment focused on shared wins, continuous learning, and peer development.

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied directly to qualified meetings and pipeline generation.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation that may include equity
  • Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
  • Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
  • Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

  • To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.
  • To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at .

Please contact us at with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here.

At Kindbridge, you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise into a highly specialized area of behavioral health while helping individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related behavioral challenges.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS:


As a Data Technical Architect (Consultant) in Kainos, you’ll be responsible for designing and delivering technical components as part of a larger data solution. You will work closely with Solution Architects and Customer Architects to integrate these components into quality data solutions

Desirable:

Title: Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement

Location: Remote

Reports to: SVP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms

Salary Range: $180,000 - $220,000/yr + $40,000 performance bonus

About The Fedcap Group

Founded in 1935, The Fedcap Group is a $425M global nonprofit organization focused on advancing economic well-being for individuals facing barriers to employment. Headquartered in New York City, Fedcap operates across 106 locations in 29 U.S. states, the U.K., Canada, and Australia serving nearly 332,000 people annually. Fedcap’s mission is to create opportunities for people facing barriers to achieve economic independence, dignity, and become contributing members of society. Through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, workforce development initiatives, and community-based services, Fedcap helps individuals build sustainable pathways to employment and long-term success.

Position Summary

The Fedcap Group (TFG) is seeking a strategic, business-oriented Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement to lead the management, optimization, and lifecycle of all software systems across TFG’s international footprint. This role will ensure our platforms are reliable, well-governed, cost-effective, and positioned to harness innovation and AI so the business can operate efficiently and scale.

Reporting to the SVP, Enterprise Applications & Digital Platforms, the Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement will serve as the bridge between business operations and technology, partnering with business leaders and technology peers to translate business needs into sustainable system capabilities.

Additionally, the Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement, will own a portfolio of 300+ systems and vendors, drive rationalization, adoption, and lifecycle discipline, while shaping the team needed to deliver.

Goals of the Position

The Head of Software Systems & Business Enablement will:

  • Maximize Business Value Through Innovation & AI
    Ensure software systems are configured, adopted, and continuously improved, and identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging capabilities that improve efficiency, service delivery, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Establish Strong System Ownership & Lifecycle Management
    Create disciplined ownership and lifecycle standards across the software portfolio, from selection through consolidation and retirement.

  • Build a Business-Facing Partnership Model
    Establish trusted partnerships with business units, proactively identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase adoption, reduce manual work, and use technology more effectively.

  • Strengthen Architecture, Integration & Standardization
    Lead the systems and application architecture function, aligned with enterprise-wide standards. Partner with Software Engineering and Data & Analytics to strengthen interoperability, API enablement, and data flows while reducing redundant or fragmented systems.

  • Drive Adoption, Change & Service Excellence
    Establish consistent practices for onboarding, training, change management, service levels, user communications, and feedback so technology changes translate into sustained operational improvement.

  • Cultivate a High-Performing, Business-Focused Team
    Invest in the capabilities and growth of a distributed, high-performing team. Foster a culture of business partnership, accountability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Systems Strategy & Leadership

  • Partner with the SVP to define and execute a multi-year systems roadmap aligned with TFG’s growth.
  • Drive platform rationalization and consolidation in alignment with enterprise architecture and technology strategy.
  • Identify, evaluate, and scale AI, automation, and emerging capabilities within TFG’s software platforms, in alignment with enterprise AI governance and security standards.

Systems Oversight

Software Portfolio Management

  • Lead system administration, configuration, and functional support across TFG’s software portfolio, including Oracle Fusion ERP and platforms supporting CRM, case management, student management, electronic health records, and fundraising.
  • Own a portfolio of 300+ systems and vendors with named business and technical owners, documented business purpose, criticality, cost, dependencies, and lifecycle status.
  • Establish standards for configuration, release management, testing, change control, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Design and maintain application role and permission models in partnership with Security and Compliance.
  • Coordinate application vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patches, and vendor-supported maintenance.
  • Execute data archival and destruction in line with retention policy and ensure continuity and disaster recovery requirements for critical applications are documented and tested.

Business Partnership & Service Management

  • Build and lead a business partnership function that serves as the primary relationship layer between technology and business operations.
  • Create a consistent engagement model to understand business processes, pain points, and automation opportunities, and translate them into configuration, workflow, integration, reporting, or development needs.
  • Establish a systems service catalog with standardized intake, prioritization, escalation paths, and measurable satisfaction targets, prioritizing requests with the SVP and business leaders by value, risk, cost, and capacity.

Implementation, Adoption & Change Management

  • Lead software implementations, upgrades, and migrations from requirements through stabilization, including UAT, deployment readiness, training, and post-launch support.
  • Drive change management so new capabilities are embedded in day-to-day operations, not treated solely as technology deployments.
  • Monitor utilization and adoption and develop remediation plans where systems are underused or processes remain manual.

Architecture & Integration

  • Lead the systems and application architecture function, including the systems landscape, application architecture, and integration patterns.
  • Represent the systems domain on the Enterprise Architecture Review Board, providing systems-domain review and sign-off within delegated authority.
  • Own business application integration requirements and interoperability standards, partnering with Software Engineering on technical delivery.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics to improve data quality at the source and enable reliable enterprise reporting.
  • Ensure system changes account for downstream data, reporting, identity, security, and infrastructure dependencies.

Vendor, Licensing, Financial & Compliance Oversight

  • Manage the software vendor lifecycle, including onboarding, performance, licensing, and service levels.
  • Manage the approved systems and software vendor budget in partnership with the SVP and Finance, including forecasting, analysis of license utilization, overlapping functionality, and total cost, and reporting realized savings separately from cost avoidance.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews with strategic vendors and hold vendors accountable to contractual commitments.
  • Partner with Procurement, Finance, and Legal on software negotiations, renewals, and purchasing decisions.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance on logging and audit readiness to meet standards such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PIPEDA, GDPR, and ISO 27001.

Growth, RFP & M&A Support

  • Provide systems expertise and solution architecture input to business proposals and RFP responses.
  • Assess systems, applications, data dependencies, and contracts during pre-acquisition due diligence.
  • Lead post-acquisition systems onboarding, migration, and harmonization using a repeatable integration playbook.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team, shaping the roles and capabilities needed to deliver the systems strategy.
  • Establish clear ownership, service standards, priorities, and performance measures across the team.
  • Develop team capability across business applications, business analysis, change management, and vendor management.

Qualifications

Education & Certification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • ITIL, PMP, Prosci, business analysis, TOGAF, and/or relevant platform certifications preferred.

Professional Experience

  • 10+ years in enterprise applications, business systems, or digital transformation roles, including 5+ years in leadership.
  • Proven success leading major system implementations, migrations, adoption programs, and platform rationalization across multiple business units or entities.
  • Experience managing distributed teams, business-facing technology functions, and third-party software vendors.
  • Experience leading application architecture, integration standards, and architecture reviews across a complex, multi-entity organization preferred.

Technical Competencies

  • Strong working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP and enterprise platforms spanning CRM, case management, student management, and EHR, with demonstrated depth in one or more major platforms and familiarity with modern SaaS administration.
  • Understanding of application integrations, APIs, identity and access management, role-based permissions, release management, application security fundamentals, and AI and automation capabilities within software platforms.
  • Strong capability in application portfolio management, software licensing, service management, and technology financial optimization.

Leadership & Communication

  • Business-first leadership style with strong customer orientation and a focus on measurable operational outcomes.
  • Adept at building trusted relationships with executives, operational leaders, technical teams, vendors, and end users.
  • Comfortable operating in a federated, international organization undergoing significant transformation.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision | Life/AD&D & Long-Term Disability | Flexible Spending Account (FSA) | Commuter Benefits | 403(b) | Wellness Program

  • May vary by location and business unit

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Fedcap Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, provincial, or local law.
