raw.description:
Growth Marketer heißt bei uns nicht "ein bisschen von allem".

Es heißt: Du treibst das Wachstum unserer Kunden über den Kanal, der es trägt - Meta Ads. Kein Kanal-Hopping, kein "wir machen jetzt auch TikTok". Wir sind eine Boutique-Agentur für hochpreisigen E-Commerce: Produkte ab mehreren hundert Euro AOV, erklärungsbedürftig, mit Kaufentscheidungen, die Wochen bis Monate dauern. In dieser Nische wollen wir die Besten in Deutschland sein. Dafür suchen wir Leute, die lieber eine Sache auf Weltklasse-Niveau machen als fünf Sachen auf LinkedIn-Niveau.

Zweiter Punkt, bevor du weiterliest: Wir arbeiten AI-nativ. Das schreibt inzwischen jede zweite Agentur, deshalb konkret: Wir bauen eigene AI-Werkzeuge. MCP-Anbindung an unsere Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits, Anomalie-Erkennung, eigene Skills für Angle- und Skript-Entwicklung. AI ist bei uns Standard-Werkzeug, nicht Notnagel. Wer 2026 noch jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer umgekehrt jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, liefert denselben Output wie jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell. Wir suchen die Mitte: Du steuerst, AI beschleunigt.

Wenn dich beides anzieht - Fokus statt Bauchladen, AI als Hebel statt als Ersatz fürs Denken - lies weiter.

Wer wir sind: Divinely, eine Meta-Ads-Boutique für High-AOV E-Commerce mit bewusst kleinem Kundenportfolio. Unsere Kunden kaufen kein Button-Pushing, sondern Urteilsvermögen: dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen - Marge, Customer Journey, Liquidität - und daraus die richtigen Wachstumsentscheidungen ableiten. Das heißt auch: Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft des Kunden wächst. Und das ist dann genau richtig. Wer in Tages-ROAS denkt, wird bei uns unglücklich.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst das Wachstum deiner Accounts über Meta Ads - von Audit über Hypothese und Test-Roadmap bis Skalierung und Reporting. Strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers (Net Revenue, CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER) und inkrementellen KPIs, nicht nach Plattform-ROAS allein.
  • Du denkst über die Anzeige hinaus: Wenn der Wachstums-Bottleneck nicht in den Ads liegt (Offer, Landingpage, Produkt, Pricing), sagst du es dem Kunden klar und lieferst einen Alternativweg.
  • Du reverse-engineerst die Customer Journey hochpreisiger Produkte: Micro-Conversions als Algo-Futter, Post-Purchase-Surveys, Time-Lag-Messung.
  • Du baust deine Test-Roadmaps mit AI-Unterstützung. Unser Stack liefert dir Audits, Breakdowns und Anomalie-Signale; du lieferst die Hypothese und prüfst den Output, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen.
  • Du entwickelst Wachstums-Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → fehlendes Set-Piece) und liest Creative-Performance jenseits der Vanity-Metriken.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du hast Meta Ads operativ und strategisch im Griff - Kampagnenarchitektur, Optimierungsziele, Creative-Testing - und kannst deine Entscheidungen einem Founder in Geschäftszahlen erklären.
  • Du denkst in Systemen: Hypothese → Test → Learning → nächster Test.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI - eigene Prompts und Workflows, idealerweise schon mal Tool-Anbindungen oder Automatisierungen genutzt - und kannst konkret erzählen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust.
  • Du verstehst Inkrementalität (New-Customer-Steuerung) und warum Last-Click bei langen Journeys täuscht. Oder du willst genau das in den ersten 90 Tagen bei uns lernen und belegen.
  • Du bist konfrontationsfähig: Du nickst "morgen 5x skalieren" nicht ab, sondern führst den Kunden.

Benefits

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem AI-Werkzeuge nicht beantragt, sondern gebaut werden.
  • Ein kleines, hochwertiges Kundenportfolio statt Fließband. Jede deiner Entscheidungen bewegt echtes Budget und echtes Geschäft.
  • Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt.
  • Kompetitiver Gehalt basierend auf deiner Performance.
  • Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht.
  • Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work sind bei uns keine Fremdwörter.
  • Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten.
  • Nette, professionelle und sorgfältig ausgesuchte Kunden - die dein Leben definitiv NICHT zur Hölle machen. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden auf Augenhöhe.

So läuft die Bewerbung:

  1. Kurzbewerbung - Im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: Ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon.
  2. 2 x Gespräche - 1x mit Geschäftsführer & 1x mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung.

Was dich bei AbbVie Oncology erwartet

In unserer ONEcology-Kultur arbeiten Medical, Commercial und Market Access eng zusammen und jede*r bringt die eigene Expertise ein. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir eine Mission: die Grenzen bei Krebs zu verschieben.

Hier bringst du viel in Bewegung

  • Du führst einen fundierten, nicht-werblichen wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit medizinischen Expert*innen und baust langfristige wissenschaftliche Beziehungen zu Kliniken, Zentren und Netzwerken auf.

  • Du analysierst die regionale Therapielandschaft, identifizierst wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und medizinische Bedarfe und leitest daraus Prioritäten für deine Gebietsplanung ab.

  • Du gewinnst Medical und Field Insights, ordnest diese wissenschaftlich ein und bringst sie strukturiert in die medizinische Strategie ein.

  • Du begleitest die Einführung innovativer Therapieoptionen aus medizinisch-wissenschaftlicher Perspektive.

  • Du initiierst und betreust medizinisch-wissenschaftliche Projekte und unterstützt Studien, Forschungsaktivitäten und die Zusammenarbeit mit ausgewählten Zentren.

  • Du planst Medical-Education-Aktivitäten, Fachvorträge, Advisory Boards und weitere wissenschaftliche Austauschformate und vertrittst AbbVie auf Fachkongressen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Medical-Kolleg*innen und relevanten Infield-Funktionen zusammen, wahrst die medizinische Unabhängigkeit und hältst alle geltenden Anforderungen ein.

So machst du den Unterschied

  • Du hast ein medizinisches oder naturwissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium abgeschlossen; eine Promotion ist von Vorteil.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, in Medical Affairs als Medical Sciene Liasion mit

  • Wissenschaftliche Kenntnisse in der Onkologie, Hämato-Onkologie oder im Bereich solider Tumoren sind von Vorteil.

  • Du kannst komplexe klinische Daten kritisch einordnen, verständlich vermitteln und wissenschaftliche Integrität mit einem klaren Blick für medizinische Bedarfe verbinden.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und strategisch und bringst Erfahrung in der Umsetzung wissenschaftlicher Projekte mit.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän im klinischen, wissenschaftlichen und cross-funktionalen Umfeld, bist neugierig, gestaltungsorientiert und innovationsbereit.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bist reisebereit.

Wie wir gemeinsam Großes bewegen:

  • mit einem diversen Arbeitsumfeld, wo du Wirkungen erzielen kannst

  • mit einer offenen Unternehmenskultur

  • mit einer attraktiven Vergütung

  • mit einem intensiven Onboarding durch eine*n Mentor*in

  • mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen für eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance

  • mit einem betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement mit umfassenden Gesundheits- und Bewegungsprogrammen

  • mit betrieblichen Sozialleistungen

  • mit vielfältigen Karrieremöglichkeiten in einer internationalen Organisation

  • mit hochkarätigen, attraktiven Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • mit einem starken, internationalen Netzwerk

AbbVie setzt sich für Chancengleichheit ein und verpflichtet sich, mit Integrität zu arbeiten, Innovationen voranzutreiben, Leben zu verändern und unserer Gemeinschaft zu dienen. Chancengleichheit bei Arbeitgeber/Veteranen/Behinderten.

Die konkrete Gebietsaufteilung befindet sich derzeit noch in der Finalisierung. Bewirb dich daher gerne auch, wenn dein Wohnort nicht unmittelbar dem ausgeschriebenen Standort entspricht.

Herzlich willkommen bei AbbVie! Als Teil eines internationalen Unternehmens mit ca. 53.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit und rund 3.000 Mitarbeitern in Deutschland hast du die Möglichkeit, eng mit uns zusammenzuarbeiten, um die gesundheitlichen Herausforderungen von morgen zu meistern. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung auf der ganzen Welt? Du möchtest dein Fachwissen einsetzen, um die Lebensqualität von Patienten zu verbessern? In einem herausfordernden Arbeitsumfeld, dass dir die Möglichkeit bietet, deine eigenen Fähigkeiten zu erweitern und zu entwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns richtig!

AbbVie Oncology. Das nächste Kapitel beginnt jetzt.

In den letzten 10 Jahren hat sich AbbVie Oncology vom Newcomer zu einer festen Instanz und einem verlässlichen wissenschaftlichen Partner in der Onkologie entwickelt. Als Medical Science Liaison gestaltest du den nicht-werblichen medizinisch-wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit Expert*innen und relevanten Institutionen. Du leitest aus wissenschaftlicher Evidenz, medizinischem Bedarf und Erkenntnissen aus dem Versorgungsgeschehen relevante Impulse ab und bringst diese in unsere medizinische Strategie ein.

raw.title: Enterprise Terafina Business Analyst
raw.excerpt: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward.
raw.description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

Summary


The Enterprise Terafina Business Analyst supports strategic Terafina initiatives across digital account opening, onboarding, account maintenance, workflow enhancements, integrations, and enterprise operational improvements. This role leads business analysis activities for high-priority projects by defining business needs, eliciting and documenting requirements, analyzing processes and impacts, supporting solution decisions, and maintaining clear visibility into scope, risks, dependencies, decisions, and outcomes.


This position partners with cross-functional business, technology, risk, and vendor teams to ensure strategic Terafina projects are clearly defined and aligned with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations, and platform capabilities. The Business Analyst owns requirements definition, validation, and ongoing business alignment, while intake administration, cross-functional coordination, test management, and strategic roadmap administration are managed separately within the Enterprise Terafina team.


The ideal candidate is an analytical, highly organized, and collaborative problem-solver who can translate complex strategic needs into actionable business and functional requirements, facilitate decisions across multiple workstreams, identify impacts and gaps, and drive follow-through from discovery through implementation and post-release validation.


Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead requirements discovery and business analysis for strategic Terafina projects by clarifying business objectives, defining problems and opportunities, identifying impacted capabilities and stakeholders, and establishing measurable outcomes and analysis plans.
  • Elicit, analyze, validate, and document enterprise business, functional, data, integration, workflow, control, and reporting requirements using meetings, workshops, process reviews, and other appropriate analysis techniques.
  • Translate strategic objectives into clear scope, current- and future-state processes, user stories or requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, traceability, and implementation considerations that guide solution design and delivery.
  • Perform enterprise impact, gap, dependency, and risk analysis across Terafina capabilities, processes, integrations, controls, data, operating procedures, and customer or associate experiences; recommend options and mitigation considerations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions and decision forums to align enterprise stakeholders on requirements, priorities, assumptions, tradeoffs, solution options, ownership, and next steps for strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain business analysis artifacts and requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring approved changes, decisions, dependencies, issues, and open questions are documented and communicated.
  • Partner with Enterprise Team, project managers, product owners, technology teams, developers, vendors, risk, compliance, and operations to evaluate solution feasibility, support planning, resolve requirement gaps, and keep strategic projects aligned to expected business outcomes.
  • Support testing and implementation readiness by defining acceptance criteria, coordinating business validation and UAT inputs, triaging LOB requirement-related defects, confirming stakeholder signoff, and partnering with Test Manager to ensure delivered outcomes meet approved requirements.
  • Assess change impacts and operational readiness for strategic initiatives, including procedures, controls, training, communications, support models, data or reporting needs, and post-implementation monitoring; coordinate handoffs to accountable owners.
  • Provide concise, audience-appropriate analysis and updates for leadership and project stakeholders, including scope and requirements status, key decisions, risks, dependencies, readiness, expected benefits, outcome measures, and recommendations.
  • It is the responsibility of this role to take ownership of all tasks and challenges that they encounter in the operation of their assigned position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Education Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Project Management, or a related field required, or equivalent banking and business analysis experience
  • Business analysis or project management certification, such as CBAP, CCBA, ECBA, or PMP required

Minimum Experience

  • 5+ years of banking, financial services, digital platform, or related business experience required
  • 3+ years of business analysis experience supporting complex, cross-functional, or enterprise strategic projects required
  • Experience eliciting and documenting business and functional requirements, process flows, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, impact assessments, and requirements traceability required
  • Experience supporting solution evaluation, testing, UAT, implementation readiness, change impacts, and post-implementation validation preferred
  • Experience working with enterprise business, operations, technology, risk, compliance, data, architecture, project management, and vendor teams preferred

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Advanced business analysis, requirements elicitation, process modeling, facilitation, and requirements management skills
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, option assessment, and decision-support capabilities
  • Ability to connect strategic objectives to business capabilities, processes, requirements, risks, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, workshop facilitation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, and drive decisions without direct authority
  • Knowledge of banking account origination, onboarding, servicing, workflow, integration, data, risk, and control concepts
  • Proficiency with business analysis, requirements, process mapping, collaboration, testing, and project tracking tools

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Physical Demands

  • Ability to communicate in person, on the phone, and through electronic channels
  • Ability to use a computer on a frequent basis, including typing and sustained attention to a monitor
  • Ability to sit, walk, and/or stand for extended periods of time
  • Ability to bend and reach

Work Environment

  • Office: If the position reports to a physical Company location, the setting will be a typical office environment.
  • Remote or hybrid:For remote or hybrid positions, a secure and distraction-free setting is required, with a reliable internet connection (cable or fiber preferred, mobile hotspots not acceptable). Hybrid positions will report to a physical Company location, as directed by the manager, and that setting will be a typical office environment.
In accordance with Colorado and Virginia law: Pay for this position is anticipated to be between $87,282.00 - $139,425.00 , actual offers to be determined based on applicant’s skills, experience and education.While the anticipated deadline for the job posting is 11-28-2026, we encourage you to submit your application as we may still consider qualified candidates beyond this date.

Benefits | SouthState Careers

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

Role Overview

Seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and proactive manager to support our team in EPR program planning and regulatory compliance within the state of Minnesota. This position includes administrative management and tracking of program plan submissions and amendments, data analytics, compliance and circular economy initiatives, strategic partnerships within the state, and ensuring alignment across teams within the organization. This role will also help maintain records, assist with reports, and support the team in various administrative tasks that drive our mission forward.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic and Organizational Planning Support:

  • Help establish and carry out Minnesota initiatives, plans, and work groups.
  • Manage internal team meetings and cross team initiatives forMinnesota
  • Help identify and streamline operational processes to improve efficiency within the team.
  • Onboard all new team members and ensure base understanding of systems, processes, and tools.
  • Manage the ongoing training and learning initiatives for the team including lunch and learns and EPR training initiatives.
  • Assist the Minnesota Program Manager in the management of regulatory meetings and coordination with CAA teams
  • Manage logistics, meeting planning and facilitation of in-state meetings and events.

Manage the process for all Minnesota Program Plan submissions including:

  • Manage the process for Minnesota Program Plan submissions including the workflows for program plan submission and all amendment submissions.
  • Ensure all documents are developed, reviewed internally within the governance structure, and are submitted on time to comply with the plan submission deadlines.
  • Monitor the schedule and process for internal and interest holder reviews of the program plan prior to submission.
  • Manage the pre and post-submission review and approval process and timelines for all draft plans, amendments and final program plan submission to regulator. Includes ensuring Advisory Board and subcommittee(s) and ad hoc discussions and continued engagement until the program plan or amendment is approved.

Cross-Functional Coordination and Collaboration with Interested Parties:

  • Coordinate closely across the various departments within CAA ensuring Emerging States regulatory topics and issues are raised and addressed between the departments to achieve broader team goals.
  • Coordinate strategic partnerships with consultants and business partners providing services to the Emerging States team and Minnesota team.
  • Manage contracts and SOWs, ensuring projects are completed on time and on budget.
  • Create meeting agendas, host meetings and track follow ups with consultants and internal staff to ensure deliverables meet the team’s needs and are completed on time.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between tracking systems.
  • Assist in preparing materials for meetings with government agencies (MPCA), businesses, and community organizations involved in recycling, composting, reuse, and waste reduction.

Data Analytics & Internal KPI management:

  • Ensure key performance indicators (KPIs) in the Company Dashboard are on track.
  • Assist in preparing regular reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders, highlighting performance metrics, trends, and areas for improvement.
  • Monitor and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to waste diversion and recycling, compost, and reuse program obligations.

Tracking & Documentation:

  • Coordinate with CAA’s compliance team to maintain accurate records of all Minnesota compliance documents, tracking forms, and other paperwork related to Minnesota EPR statute and regulations.
  • Ensure that all data and paperwork are up-to-date and compliant with applicable laws and internal standards.
  • Assist in updating spreadsheets, databases, and tracking systems to ensure efficient workflow.

Program Support and Meeting Management:

  • Assist with the coordination and implementation of various programs and projects aimed at supporting service providers, local governments, and interest holders in compliance with EPR laws.
  • Support the team in maintaining communication with producers to ensure timely submission of required reports and documentation.

Assist the Emerging States team as needed for the onboarding of new state programs.

  • Assist the Emerging States division as needed for the readiness of new state programs
  • No more than 10% of time available.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Minnesota’s packaging EPR law (House File 3911 / Minn. Stat. §§ 115A.144—115A.1463), including requirements for PROs, service providers, partners and the Minnesota Advisory Board.
  • Preferred understanding of EPR and packaging sustainability
  • Basic data analytical skills, experience with Power BI
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, with Expert skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Project management principles and techniques and project management software.
  • Effectively coordinating resources and meeting timelines.
  • Coordinating activities with internal departments and external organizations.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Proactive and results-driven mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or institution in an applicable field.
  • 5+ years’ experience in an operations or administrative role.
  • Management experience preferred.
  • Must possess or be able to obtain a valid Driver's License with clean driving history.

Compensation & Other Information

  • Location: Remote from Minnesota
  • Residency: In-state, Minnesota. Must reside in Minnesota or be willing to re-locate to the state.
  • Pay Rate: Based on a variety of factors in accordance with applicable law including the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and experience.
  • Reports To: Minnesota Program Manager

All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. raw.description:
Inbound Sales Specialist (Part Time Internship, Remote)

Storage Scholars is a high-growth company that’s undergone 100% year-over-year growth since its inception in 2017. Our goal is to change the way college students across the country move in and out of residence halls with our all-inclusive moving, storage and shipping service. Storage Scholars is fast-moving, tenacious, innovative, and core-product-focused. We strive to be the premium option among the competition by offering the best user experience available, which is dependent on continuously improving our technology. We expect passion and buy-in from every team member, no matter the role. We believe everyone, regardless of their position, brings unique knowledge, skills, and perspective that makes us who we are. All voices are not just welcomed but encouraged to be a part of the decisions and direction of the organization. At Storage Scholars, egos are left at the door, wins are celebrated as a team, and learning never stops.

As an Inbound Sales Specialist (Part Time Internship) at Storage Scholars, your primary responsibility is being a consultative guide for customers seeking solutions for student move-in, move-out, storage, and shipping. As a member of the greater Customer Experience Team, you will be a crucial link between the customer and their understanding and adoption of the services that we offer.

What you’ll do:

  • Field inbound leads from both lead form submissions and inbound calls.
  • Make proactive phone calls to existing and former customers to promote service usage.
  • Provide service estimates for customers via call, SMS, and email.
  • Guide customers through their order flow in our online portal to book their moves.
  • Promote additional services and service upgrades to customers, as well as generate referrals.

Required:

  • Exceptional communication with strong sales aptitude.
  • Strong critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced changes and intense workloads.
  • Strong phone presence.
  • High emotional intelligence to understand fellow team members and clients alike.
  • Technologically savvy, with the ability to learn new software rapidly.

Preferred:

  • 1–2 years of customer-facing experience (such as retail, hospitality, or customer service).

Scope:

  • Part time, seasonal role: 15–25 hours/week on average, up to 40 hours/week during March - May.
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule on evenings and weekends as necessary during our peak season (March - September).
  • Preferred Start Date: 1/25/27
  • Tentative End Date: 8/1/27

Compensation:

  • Estimated seasonal earnings: $4,500 – $10,000+
  • Base pay plus per-customer commission. Earnings depend on hours worked (15–25 hrs/week) and monthly sales performance.

Other Benefits:

  • Fully Remote
  • Ability to grow with our rapidly growing company and team.

Location:

  • Remote

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. The student packs their items, uploads a few photos to our portal, selects their desired insurance, locks it in their room, and can leave at will. Thanks to our partnership with the university, our staff comes in once the campus is vacant and moves all of the student belongings into a storage facility for the summer. The best part is that the items will be ready and waiting in the customer’s new housing assignment whenever they return.

Storage Scholars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: $4,500 – $10,000 / year

raw.title: Senior Credit Risk Review Manager I-Virtual
raw.excerpt: Make banking a Fifth Third better® We connect great people to great opportunities.
raw.description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

Individual is responsible for managing the development, execution and leadership of the Credit Risk Review (CRR) Continuous Review program for assigned CRR team and/or line of business units. Primary components of the CRR Continuous Review program include (i) the critical and independent evaluation of the accuracy and effectiveness of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp through an assessment of risk identification/rating, underwriting, new origination, borrower selection and portfolio management practices; compliance with Bancorp loan policies, procedures and applicable laws and regulations; problem asset administration and loan impairments/charge-offs; (ii) a review of credit quality and related trends on a portfolio, industry sector and/or product basis; and (iii) the identification of emerging risks. Attend (as required) regular meetings with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors and first and second line business personnel.

Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues, and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Display an advanced background, understanding and technical proficiency in all pertinent lending and credit risk topics, including risk appetite and framework, Bank policies and procedures, and risk monitoring and mitigation practices for assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Maintain awareness of general economic conditions, industry trends and product specific issues. Display an advanced working knowledge of pertinent regulatory issues and sound lending practices and their relative impact on credit risk. Assist CRR management team in ensuring CRR meets regulatory heightened standards expectations.
  • Demonstrate the ability to analyze and assess credit risk in highly complex Commercial borrowers and portfolios and adequately support all conclusions.
  • In conjunction with CRR leadership team, establish key annual goals and risk-based business plans for assigned areas of responsibility and update as necessary throughout the year. Identify, elevate and promptly address variances to plan. Assist in ensuring CRR procedures remain current and correctly reflect actual/desired practices.
  • Complete or ensure the completion of all aspects of required continuous review activities for assigned Commercial portfolios with minimal supervision and in accordance with CRR procedures, deadlines and performance/financial plan objectives. Manage, lead and/or participate in horizontal, targeted and other portfolio review activities.
  • Present CRR activities and results (as required) at regular meetings with executive management, senior leaders, regulators, external auditors and first and second line business personnel. Complete or assist in the preparation and dissemination of all related and required quarterly/ annual summaries of results in an accurate and timely manner, including an annual assessment of credit risk and the overall quality of assigned portfolios.
  • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of key line of business strategies, risk considerations, portfolio quality trends and open issues and observations for assigned portfolios, while maintaining current and forward-looking views on aggregate portfolio risk levels. Attend applicable Committee, portfolio review, problem asset review and business controls meetings, and hold routine informational meetings with first and second line senior business leaders and personnel to gain and share perspectives on these matters.
  • Effectively challenge and provide consultative advice to first and second line senior business leaders and personnel on risk ratings, credit risk management practices, emerging risks, borrower/portfolio credit quality trends, strategies, policies, organization design and/or staffing levels and expertise.
  • Work in a balanced and consultative manner with the first and second lines of defense to develop positive working relationships and to provide feedback on the results of continuous review activities. Ensure the timely socialization and publication of concise and well-written reports that summarize review results, meet the information needs of report recipients, and include issues, observations and recommendations for improvement (as appropriate).
  • Manage a system of accountability for open CRR issues, observations and recommendations under assigned areas of responsibility. Solicit appropriate action plans and responses from responsible management that address root causes, resolve CRR’s concerns and mitigate the overall risk to the Bancorp. Assist CRR management team in promptly resolving any matters requiring attention (MRAs) or issues assigned to CRR with sustainable improvements to business practices.
  • For Commercial roles, manage and execute work processes that review the accuracy of assigned risk ratings (i.e. regulatory, probability of default and loss given default ratings) and accrual status utilizing knowledge of Bancorp policies, risk rating models and definitions. Effectively convey rating changes to first and second line business leaders and personnel with minimal assistance from manager and promptly escalate any unresolved disagreements to their manager and/or CRR Director.
  • Complete quality assurance review activities (i.e. active engagement in effective challenge meetings, secondary reviews of work papers and supporting review process documents, proficiency in providing peer-to-peer feedback, etc.) and assist in sustaining a strong CRR quality assurance program to ensure the consistency and accuracy of CRR work products and review results. Use quality assurance results constructively for employee and personal development and to make recommendations for program enhancements.
  • Assist in driving a continuous improvement approach to process management within CRR, including making appropriate recommendations for change, in order to gain efficiencies and ensure the effectiveness, consistency and relevance of CRR processes. Benchmark best practices with peer institutions and incorporate into CRR procedures as appropriate.
  • Share review findings and emerging risks with Internal Audit and other Risk functions and coordinate work efforts to ensure appropriate coverage and independent oversight of credit risk management processes across the Bancorp.
  • Assume leadership roles and/or participate in due-diligence reviews of potential Bank acquisitions and other special projects as requested.
  • Recruit qualified candidates to fill open positions and maintain a pipeline of qualified potential talent to ensure appropriate staffing levels, expertise and bench strength are maintained. For employee manager roles, maintain a succession plan for all critical CRR positions under your supervision.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES (AS APPLICABLE):

Individual is responsible for developing and managing direct reports to ensure optimal performance to achieve CRR’s goals and performance objectives. Ensure employees have performance and developmental goals in place and are (i) provided with timely, candid and constructive performance feedback; (ii) developed to their fullest potential and provided with training opportunities and challenging job assignments that enhance their career growth; and (iii) recognized and rewarded for their accomplishments.


MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in a business related field. Graduate degree in relevant field (Business, Finance or Economics) preferred.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
raw.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion, and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

CHAI’s Analytics and Implementation Research (AIR) Team is a results-driven team of public health experts strategically positioned at the center of CHAI’s geographic and disease priorities, maximizing health systems, and bringing innovations to scale. AIR has years of experience tackling problems within real-world health systems in resource-limited settings and a long history of well-regarded collaboration with partner governments and CHAI country and global teams.

CHAI is seeking a highly motivated individual with public health experience and analytical skills to work with CHAI’s program and country teams and government counterparts to conduct epidemiological analysis, model program impact and cost-effectiveness, and monitor and evaluate the success of ongoing efforts,. The Research Associate will be responsible for developing and refining cost-effectiveness analyses for candidate programs across CHAI's portfolio; conducting rigorous pressure-tests of program theories of change by critically reviewing literature; and applying quantitative methods to help CHAI country teams identify priority programs, efficiencies, and geographic targeting opportunities.

This role is a unique opportunity to apply advanced epidemiological and quantitative analytics to high-impact health interventions in some of the world's most challenging contexts. You will have the chance to work across CHAI's diverse health programs, contribute to complex analytical work, and directly influence how resources are allocated to save lives at scale.

This role is open to candidates based in any CHAI program country, pending leadership approval and appropriate work authorization. Candidates should be able to accommodate overlapping working hours with US Eastern Time (ET) to facilitate team collaboration.

Responsibilities

Analytics and modelling

  • Apply quantitative and geospatial methods to support CHAI country teams in identifying high-priority programs, geographic targeting opportunities, and health system efficiencies
  • Support creation of cost-effectiveness models to enable evidence-based program decision-making to achieve maximal impact
  • Appropriately utilize large-scale datasets (e.g., GBD, DHS, national surveys, IHME datasets, implementation cost data) to inform program design and prioritization decisions
  • Collaborate across CHAI's disease and geographic programs to gather inputs, validate analytical assumptions, and ensure models reflect on-the-ground program realities
  • Support CHAI's engagement with major funders by preparing evidence-based materials that inform prioritization decisions and funding conversations

Evidence-based program development and technical leadership

  • Support the design and implementation of new pilot programs, leveraging existing evidence and data to ensure interventions are both impactful and cost-effective
  • Conduct rigorous pressure-tests of program theories of change, including critical review of evidence, interrogation of key assumptions, and assessment of causal pathways and counterfactual scenarios
  • Collaborate with CHAI country teams and government partners to ensure feasibility and alignment of interventions within national health systems

Qualifications

Education and experience

  • Postgraduate degree in epidemiology, economics, or related quantitative discipline
  • 3+ years of experience applying quantitative methods to global health or development challenges, including cost-effectiveness analysis, impact evaluations, and mathematical modeling

Technical

  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills, with proven capacity to pressure test complex theories of change
  • Excellent skills in data management and statistical analysis, including use of software such as Stata, R, or SAS
  • Experience in cost-effectiveness modeling and evaluation design (including causal inference using observational data), tailoring methodologies to diverse contexts to generate actionable insights
  • Experience assessing and reconciling data quality issues across large survey and administrative datasets, particularly in multi-country settings
  • Strong understanding of the LMIC health systems context, including data limitations, operational constraints, and the role of government and partner ecosystems

Operational

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex quantitative findings to donors, government stakeholders, and other diverse audiences
  • Demonstrated fluency in using AI tools to synthesize information and produce high-quality analytical outputs, paired with the judgment to critically evaluate AI-generated work, identifying where it falls short or gets things wrong, and applying sound human reasoning to correct, refine, and strengthen the final product
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to collaborative work with a remote, geographically dispersed team across multiple time zones
  • Fluency in English

Preferred

  • Experience using geospatial methods to support budget optimization, program targeting, or subnational prioritization analyses is an advantage
  • Proficiency in one or more languages spoken in CHAI countries

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Senior Account Executive in the Southwest region, you’ll report directly to the VP, Employer Sales - Southwest.

The Senior Account Executive will deliver strong sales results within the Southwest market in the 200-999 life segment. raw.description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings an AI and Machine Learning curriculum to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the model and system review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside them. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.

This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real engineering feedback on student ML deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually built and shipped AI systems in production, has opinions about what a sound ML system looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: An experienced developer or engineer – SWE, data engineer, data analyst, DevOps/SRE, or quant – who wants to move into an adjacent AI/ML role (MLE, AI engineer, MLOps, data scientist) and carry their existing experience across, not start over.

Format: Live sessions, office hours, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 10 to 15 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Host live sessions focused on the design of ML systems: agentic architectures, orchestration, evaluation, and reliability of LLM-based systems.
  • Run group office hours, 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional ML engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff ML Engineer, AI Engineer, or ML/AI Systems Architect).
  • Has built and shipped AI or ML systems that ran in production in a real company, not just notebooks or side projects.
  • Depth across the AI engineering spine: agentic systems (L3, LangChain/CrewAI/ADK frameworks, orchestration, self-correction), agent reliability and guardrails, MCP; LLM evals (eval harness, LLM-as-judge, hallucination metrics), applied fine-tuning (SFT/LoRA); AI coding tools in the SDLC, LLM observability, A/B experiment design.
  • Can explain why a modeling or architecture decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.

Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, ADK) and MCP-based tool integrations.
  • Hands-on ownership of an eval or observability stack in production, not just usage.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

Overview

About NSC Global

NSC Global delivers global network implementation, IT infrastructure and support solutions to world-class organizations, helping customers simplify operations, reduce costs and transform their IT environments.

As a Cisco Global Gold Certified Partner, we design, deploy, support and manage global IT communications and technology services for leading enterprises worldwide.

The Role

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Sales Executive / Business Development Director to accelerate NSC Global’s growth across the US market.

This is a new business-focused role, with responsibility for identifying, developing and converting new revenue opportunities across enterprise customers, Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), Data Center Providers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Direct Customers.

You will be responsible for opening new accounts, creating demand, building a strong sales pipeline and converting opportunities into profitable, long-term customer relationships. You will proactively identify target organizations, develop relationships with senior decision-makers and create opportunities from the initial conversation to commercial close.

  • Lead commercial negotiations and structure agreements that deliver value for both the customer and NSC.

  • Manage opportunities ranging from tactical projects and professional services to large-scale, multi-year managed services and outsourcing engagements.
  • Maintain accurate CRM activity, forecasting, pipeline and opportunity reporting

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of winning new business and generating revenue within the IT services or technology sector.
  • Strong business development experience, with demonstrable success opening new enterprise accounts from a cold or limited relationship base.
  • Experience selling complex IT services, managed services, outsourcing, network, infrastructure or professional services solutions.
  • Strong existing network and ability to engage senior decision-makers within enterprise organizations, GSIs, MSPs, VARs, data center providers, OEMs and/or direct customers.
  • Demonstrable experience managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting and opportunity creation to negotiation and close.
  • Strong understanding of the IT services landscape, including managed services, professional services, field services, network and infrastructure solutions.
  • Ability to identify customer pain points and develop a compelling business-value proposition rather than relying on product-led selling.
  • Executive presence with the ability to build credibility and influence at C-suite and senior stakeholder level.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with pricing, margin, negotiation and complex contractual arrangements.
  • Highly proactive and entrepreneurial, with a genuine hunter mentality and appetite for opening new doors.
  • Strong pipeline discipline, forecasting and CRM management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to pursue opportunities ranging from smaller entry-point projects to large strategic engagements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven experience selling high-value IT services or technology solutions into Fortune 1000 and large enterprise organizations.
  • Demonstrable new-logo acquisition and business development success.
  • Experience working for a systems integrator, managed service provider, technology services organization or similar environment is highly desirable.
  • Existing relationships across enterprise technology, infrastructure, networking or managed services markets would be advantageous.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will be measured by your ability to:

  • Open new enterprise relationships and accounts
  • Build a strong and sustainable US sales pipeline
  • Generate and convert qualified new business opportunities
  • Win profitable new customers and contracts
  • Expand initial engagements into broader NSC relationships
  • Build long-term executive-level customer relationships
  • Deliver against revenue, margin and new-business targets

raw.excerpt: What is this position about? We are looking for a Data Quality Engineer with strong experience in Azure and Databricks to ensure data quality, reliability, and consistency across modern data platforms.
raw.description:
What is this position about?

We are looking for a Data Quality Engineer with strong experience in Azure and Databricks to ensure data quality, reliability, and consistency across modern data platforms. This role focuses on validating data pipelines, implementing automated quality checks, and collaborating closely with Data Engineering and business teams to guarantee accurate and production-ready data assets.

  • Design and implement a data quality framework across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers — defining validation rules, threshold tolerances, and alerting standards
  • Build and maintain automated data quality checks within Databricks pipelines — row counts, null checks, referential integrity, schema validation, and business rule assertions
  • Own reconciliation between source systems and Databricks layers — ensuring source data lands accurately and transformations produce expected outputs
  • Validate identity resolution outputs in the Silver layer — reviewing match rates, investigating false positives and false negatives, and ensuring enterprise identifiers are being assigned correctly across source populations
  • Perform end-to-end pipeline testing — validating that data flows correctly from ingestion through to the Gold layer and that downstream reporting outputs reflect accurate data
  • Partner with Data Engineers to define acceptance criteria for each sprint’s pipeline and data model deliverables before they are promoted to production
  • Support UAT with client business stakeholders — helping them validate that Gold layer outputs meet their reporting requirements
  • Document all QA processes, test results, and data quality findings in a format that can be handed off to the client team at engagement close
  • Monitor pipeline health post-deployment — investigating and triaging data quality incidents and working with engineers to resolve root causes quickly
  • Experience working with Azure-based data platforms, including Databricks.
  • Strong understanding of data quality frameworks and testing methodologies for data pipelines.
  • Experience validating ETL/ELT processes and working with layered architectures (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets.
  • Experience implementing automated data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to collaborate with Data Engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Experience documenting QA processes and results in a structured manner.

What about languages?

  • English: Advanced (required for effective communication with global teams).

How much experience must I have?

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or Data Quality roles.

Our Perks and Benefits:

📚Learning Opportunities:

  • Certifications in AWS (we are AWS Partners), Databricks, and Snowflake.
  • Access to AI learning paths to stay up to date with the latest technologies.
  • Study plans, courses, and additional certifications tailored to your role.
  • Access to Udemy Business, offering thousands of courses to boost your technical and soft skills.
  • English lessons to support your professional communication.

👨🏽‍💻Travel opportunities to attend industry conferences and meet clients.

👩‍🏫 Mentoring and Development:

  • Career development plans and mentorship programs to help shape your path.

🎁 Celebrations & Support:

  • Special day rewards to celebrate birthdays, work anniversaries, and other personal milestones.
  • Company-provided equipment.

⚖️ Flexible working options to help you strike the right balance.

Other benefits may vary according to your location in LATAM. For detailed information regarding the benefits applicable to your specific location, please consult with one of our recruiters.

So what are the next steps?

Our team is eager to learn about you! Send us your resume or LinkedIn profile below and we’ll explore working together!

Sales & Business Development

Account Management

Cross-Functional Leadership

Sales Reporting & Forecasting

  • Monitor key KPIs, profitability, and pipeline activity using PBI and sales tools.
